# Event 014 Cannibalism scripted effects
# Consolidated by loader surface. Identifiers, ordering, and gameplay content are preserved.

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source section: 014_cannibalism_achievement_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 ACHIEVEMENT, COUNTERPLAY, AND AFTERMATH EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Maintains irreversible campaign history for all eighteen achievements,
# executes paid international counterplay, preserves player eligibility across
# Event 14 tag transfers, and administers the eligible global-defeat recovery.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Campaign ledger initialization and irreversible history
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_initialize_achievement_runtime = {
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_second_country_infected
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_commune_ever_formed
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_warlord_ever_formed
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_silent_larder_ever_reached
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_wendigo_merge_occurred
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_all_wendigo_anchors_broken_prelock
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_visibility_open
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_island_host_visibility_open
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_evolution_ii_visibility_open
	clr_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_convergence_visibility_open
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_aftermath_all_states_reconstructed
	set_variable = { global.achievement_cannibalism_warlords_formed = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.achievement_cannibalism_former_feeding_states = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.achievement_cannibalism_reconstructed_states = 0 }
	clear_array = global.cannibalism_former_feeding_states
	clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_achievement_likely_host
}

cannibalism_achievement_mark_initial_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_first_host_recorded } }
		set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_first_host_recorded
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_first_host
			set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_event_participant
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_record_exploitation = {
	set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_visibility_open
	set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_ever
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_clean_route_disqualified
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_renounced }
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_repeated
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_reinfection_faced }
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_reinfection_exploitation
	}
}

cannibalism_renounce_terror_exploitation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_ever
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_public_court_martial_held
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_terror_battalion_in_field }
		}
		cannibalism_clear_current_policy = yes
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_ritual_response_appropriation
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_network_response_exploitation
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_open_emergency
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_humane_response_active
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_ritual_response_purge
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_ritual_prosecution_open
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active }
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_network_response_disclosure
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_international_tracking_open
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_joint_suppression_open
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_policy = constant:cannibalism_policy.open_emergency }
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_renounced
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_terror_battalion_deployed } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_terror_battalion_deployed } }
		cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_record_current_state_as_former_feeding_state = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state }
				check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.silent_larder }
			}
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_former_feeding_state }
		}
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_former_feeding_state
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_former_feeding_states value = THIS }
		add_to_variable = { global.achievement_cannibalism_former_feeding_states = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.silent_larder } }
		set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_silent_larder_ever_reached
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_record_warlord_formation = {
	set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_warlord_ever_formed
	add_to_variable = { global.achievement_cannibalism_warlords_formed = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_island_host
			has_variable = cannibalism_warlord_origin_state
		}
		set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_island_host_visibility_open
		var:cannibalism_warlord_origin_state = { set_state_flag = cannibalism_former_island_host_origin }
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_record_domestic_commune = {
	set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_commune_ever_formed
	OWNER = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_commune_formed_domestically
		}
	}
}

# State scope. Credit is unique by the source country whose cell was removed.
cannibalism_achievement_record_cell_suppression = {
	CONTROLLER = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_achievement_suppression_actor }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_achievement_suppression_actor
			event_target:cannibalism_achievement_suppression_actor = { is_ai = no }
			has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country
			country_exists = var:cannibalism_node_source_country
		}
		var:cannibalism_node_source_country = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_suppression_credit_claimed } }
				set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_suppression_credit_claimed
				event_target:cannibalism_achievement_suppression_actor = {
					add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_countries_suppressed = 1 }
					set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_event_participant
					set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_decisive_aid
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# State scope. A coastal or island recovery only counts if its controller keeps
# the required convoy/train and support reserves for every recovery stage.
cannibalism_achievement_begin_supply_recovery_tracking = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_state_recovery_supply_is_maintained = yes }
		set_state_flag = achievement_cannibalism_supply_recovery_maintained
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_check_supply_recovery_tracking = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = achievement_cannibalism_supply_recovery_maintained
			NOT = { cannibalism_state_recovery_supply_is_maintained = yes }
		}
		clr_state_flag = achievement_cannibalism_supply_recovery_maintained
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_finalize_supply_recovery_tracking = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = achievement_cannibalism_supply_recovery_maintained
			NOT = { has_state_flag = achievement_cannibalism_supply_recovery_counted }
			OR = { is_island_state = yes is_coastal = yes }
		}
		set_state_flag = achievement_cannibalism_supply_recovery_counted
		CONTROLLER = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_isolated_nodes_recovered = 1 }
				set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_event_participant
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pulse tracking and completion history
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_achievement_refresh_unified_continent_count = {
	set_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_feeding_continent_count = 0 }
	if = { limit = { any_controlled_state = { is_on_continent = europe OR = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state has_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder } } } add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_feeding_continent_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { any_controlled_state = { is_on_continent = africa OR = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state has_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder } } } add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_feeding_continent_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { any_controlled_state = { is_on_continent = asia OR = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state has_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder } } } add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_feeding_continent_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { any_controlled_state = { is_on_continent = middle_east OR = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state has_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder } } } add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_feeding_continent_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { any_controlled_state = { is_on_continent = north_america OR = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state has_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder } } } add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_feeding_continent_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { any_controlled_state = { is_on_continent = south_america OR = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state has_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder } } } add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_feeding_continent_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { any_controlled_state = { is_on_continent = australia OR = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state has_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder } } } add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_feeding_continent_count = 1 } }
}

cannibalism_achievement_process_current_actor = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_event_participant
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_external_reinfection_active }
			set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_reinfection_faced
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_exploitation
						has_country_flag = cannibalism_ritual_response_appropriation
						has_country_flag = cannibalism_network_response_exploitation
					}
				}
				set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_reinfection_exploitation
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes
				has_country_flag = cannibalism_resistant_warlord
				has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = achievement_cannibalism_defiant_survival_due_date } }
				set_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_defiant_survival_due_date = global.date }
				add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_defiant_survival_due_date = constant:cannibalism_achievement.defiant_survival_days }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = achievement_cannibalism_defiant_survival_due_date
						value = global.date
						compare = less_than_or_equals
					}
					is_subject = no
					has_capitulated = no
				}
				set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_defiant_warlord_survived
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_cannibalism_unified_country = yes }
		cannibalism_achievement_refresh_unified_continent_count = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_process_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.cannibalism_infected_country_count
				value = constant:cannibalism_achievement.second_country_count
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_second_country_infected
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.cannibalism_max_warlords
				value = constant:cannibalism_achievement.minimum_warlord_history
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_warlord_ever_formed
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_node_states
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_commune_state }
			cannibalism_achievement_record_domestic_commune = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state has_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = cannibalism_state_stage }
			cannibalism_achievement_record_current_state_as_former_feeding_state = yes
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
		cannibalism_achievement_process_current_actor = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_broken_once
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
			check_variable = {
				var = global.cannibalism_network_reach
				value = constant:cannibalism_achievement.pre_reveal_network_reach
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_defeat_contributors
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
					has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_likely_host_destroyed
				}
				set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_convergence_mission_won
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_record_local_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_event_participant
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_external_reinfection_active }
			set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_reinfection_faced
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_reinfection_exploitation }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_exploitation }
				}
				set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_reinfection_defeated
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_record_global_victory = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_defeat_contributors
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_event_participant
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_broken_once
					NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
					has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_likely_host_destroyed
				}
				set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_convergence_mission_won
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Player ledger preservation across CBL and Wendigo tag transfers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_achievement_capture_current_player_ledger = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_player = 0 }
	if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_player = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_first_host = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_countries_suppressed = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_isolated_recovered = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_reconstruction = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_first_host } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_first_host = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = achievement_cannibalism_countries_suppressed } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_countries_suppressed = achievement_cannibalism_countries_suppressed } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = achievement_cannibalism_isolated_nodes_recovered } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_isolated_recovered = achievement_cannibalism_isolated_nodes_recovered } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = achievement_cannibalism_reconstruction_contribution } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_reconstruction = achievement_cannibalism_reconstruction_contribution } }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_exploitation_ever = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_exploitation_renounced = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_exploitation_repeated = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_joint = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_decisive = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_ever } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_exploitation_ever = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_renounced } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_exploitation_renounced = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_repeated } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_exploitation_repeated = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_joint_suppression_completed } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_joint = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_decisive_aid } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_decisive = 1 } }
}

cannibalism_achievement_apply_captured_player_ledger = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_player > 0 } }
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_event_participant
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_first_host > 0 } } set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_first_host }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_exploitation_ever > 0 } } set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_ever }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_exploitation_renounced > 0 } } set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_renounced }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_exploitation_repeated > 0 } } set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_exploitation_repeated }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_joint > 0 } } set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_joint_suppression_completed }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_achievement_transfer_decisive > 0 } } set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_decisive_aid }
		set_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_countries_suppressed = cannibalism_achievement_transfer_countries_suppressed }
		set_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_isolated_nodes_recovered = cannibalism_achievement_transfer_isolated_recovered }
		set_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_reconstruction_contribution = cannibalism_achievement_transfer_reconstruction }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paid international suppression and convergence counterplay
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_pay_international_response_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = cannibalism_international_manpower_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = -1 }
	add_manpower = cannibalism_international_negative_cost
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = cannibalism_international_command_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = -1 }
	add_command_power = cannibalism_international_negative_cost
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_international_navy_experience_cost > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = cannibalism_international_navy_experience_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = -1 }
		add_navy_experience = cannibalism_international_negative_cost
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = cannibalism_international_infantry_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = -1 }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = cannibalism_international_negative_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = cannibalism_international_support_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = -1 }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_international_negative_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = cannibalism_international_truck_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = -1 }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = motorized_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_international_negative_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = cannibalism_international_train_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = -1 }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_international_negative_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = cannibalism_international_convoy_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_negative_cost = -1 }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = cannibalism_international_negative_cost }
}

cannibalism_execute_joint_suppression = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_can_pay_joint_suppression_cost = yes
			has_event_target = cannibalism_joint_suppression_target
			event_target:cannibalism_joint_suppression_target = { cannibalism_is_valid_joint_suppression_target = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_manpower_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.joint_manpower }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_command_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.joint_command }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_infantry_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.joint_infantry }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_support_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.joint_support }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_truck_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.joint_trucks }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_train_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_convoy_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_navy_experience_cost = 0 }
		cannibalism_pay_international_response_cost = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_joint_suppression_target = {
			cannibalism_expose_detention_exploitation_in_current_country = yes
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.joint_target_cell_damage }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion } add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.joint_target_cult_damage } }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.joint_target_integrity_gain }
			cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
			cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_joint_suppression_counted } }
				set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_joint_suppression_counted
				ROOT = { add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_countries_suppressed = 1 } }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.joint_network_damage }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cannibalism_network_reach min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_joint_suppression_completed
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_decisive_aid
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_event_participant
		cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_joint_suppression_target = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_objective_country_target }
		cannibalism_record_break_network_operation = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_prepare_convergence_counterplay = {
	cannibalism_select_unification_host = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_unification_host
			event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = { cannibalism_is_viable_unification_host = yes }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
			save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_achievement_likely_host
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_likely_convergence_host
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_execute_convergence_interdiction = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_can_pay_convergence_interdiction_cost = yes
			has_event_target = cannibalism_convergence_interdiction_target
			event_target:cannibalism_convergence_interdiction_target = { cannibalism_is_likely_convergence_host = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_manpower_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.convergence_manpower }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_command_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.convergence_command }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_infantry_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.convergence_infantry }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_support_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.convergence_support }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_truck_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.convergence_trucks }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_train_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_convoy_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_navy_experience_cost = 0 }
		cannibalism_pay_international_response_cost = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_convergence_interdiction_target = {
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.convergence_alignment_damage }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_network_alignment min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_max }
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_convergence_interdiction_targeted
			set_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_interdiction_actor = ROOT }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } }
				declare_war_on = { target = ROOT type = annex_everything }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.convergence_network_damage }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cannibalism_network_reach min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_convergence_mission_started
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_decisive_aid
		cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_convergence_interdiction_target = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_objective_country_target }
		cannibalism_record_stop_unification_operation = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_achievement_record_likely_host_defeat = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_likely_convergence_host
			has_variable = cannibalism_convergence_interdiction_actor
			country_exists = var:cannibalism_convergence_interdiction_actor
		}
		var:cannibalism_convergence_interdiction_actor = {
			set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_likely_host_destroyed
			set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_decisive_aid
			cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = yes
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_can_pay_island_blockade_cost = yes
			has_event_target = cannibalism_island_host_target
			event_target:cannibalism_island_host_target = { cannibalism_is_valid_island_host_target = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_manpower_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_command_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.blockade_command }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_infantry_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_support_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_truck_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_train_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_convoy_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.blockade_convoys }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_navy_experience_cost = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.blockade_navy_experience }
		cannibalism_pay_international_response_cost = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_island_host_target = {
			set_variable = { cannibalism_island_counterwar_actor = ROOT }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_island_operation_days = constant:cannibalism_international_response_cost.blockade_days }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_island_host_under_blockade days = cannibalism_island_operation_days }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_island_host_blockade days = cannibalism_island_operation_days }
		}
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_island_host_blockaded
		cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_island_host_target = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_objective_country_target }
		cannibalism_record_reach_island_operation = yes
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Eligible defeat aftermath and reconstruction accounting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_refresh_current_country_reconstruction_idea = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = cannibalism_liberated_feeding_states } remove_ideas = cannibalism_liberated_feeding_states }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = cannibalism_identification_and_burial_emergency } remove_ideas = cannibalism_identification_and_burial_emergency }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = cannibalism_broken_military_trust } remove_ideas = cannibalism_broken_military_trust }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = cannibalism_rebuilt_supply_discipline } remove_ideas = cannibalism_rebuilt_supply_discipline }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_international_compact_member
			NOT = { has_idea = cannibalism_permanent_vigilance }
		}
		add_ideas = cannibalism_permanent_vigilance
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_owned_state = {
				cannibalism_state_is_former_feeding_state = yes
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_aftermath_identification_complete }
			}
		}
		add_ideas = cannibalism_liberated_feeding_states
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_owned_state = {
				cannibalism_state_is_former_feeding_state = yes
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_aftermath_identification_complete
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_aftermath_institutions_complete }
			}
		}
		add_ideas = cannibalism_identification_and_burial_emergency
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_owned_state = {
				cannibalism_state_is_former_feeding_state = yes
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_aftermath_institutions_complete
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_aftermath_reconstruction_complete }
			}
		}
		add_ideas = cannibalism_broken_military_trust
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_reconstruction_participant
			NOT = { cannibalism_country_has_unfinished_aftermath_state = yes }
		}
		add_ideas = cannibalism_rebuilt_supply_discipline
	}
}

cannibalism_initialize_global_defeat_reconstruction = {
	set_variable = { global.achievement_cannibalism_reconstructed_states = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.achievement_cannibalism_reconstruction_required = global.cannibalism_former_feeding_states^num }
	clear_array = global.cannibalism_reconstruction_participants
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_defeat_contributors
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_reconstruction_participant
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_reconstruction_participants value = THIS } } }
				add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_reconstruction_participants value = THIS }
			}
			cannibalism_refresh_current_country_reconstruction_idea = yes
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_former_feeding_states
		OWNER = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes NOT = { is_cannibalism_country = yes } }
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_reconstruction_participant
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_reconstruction_participants value = THIS } } }
					add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_reconstruction_participants value = THIS }
				}
				cannibalism_refresh_current_country_reconstruction_idea = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_pay_reconstruction_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_manpower_cost = cannibalism_reconstruction_manpower_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_command_cost = cannibalism_reconstruction_command_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_infantry_cost = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_support_cost = cannibalism_reconstruction_support_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_truck_cost = cannibalism_reconstruction_truck_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_train_cost = cannibalism_reconstruction_train_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_convoy_cost = cannibalism_reconstruction_convoy_cost }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_international_navy_experience_cost = 0 }
	cannibalism_pay_international_response_cost = yes
}

			event_target:cannibalism_reconstruction_state = { cannibalism_state_can_complete_aftermath_memorial = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_manpower_cost = constant:cannibalism_reconstruction.memorial_manpower }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_command_cost = constant:cannibalism_reconstruction.memorial_command }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_support_cost = constant:cannibalism_reconstruction.memorial_support }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_truck_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_train_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_convoy_cost = 0 }
		cannibalism_pay_reconstruction_cost = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_reconstruction_state = {
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_aftermath_reconstruction_complete
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_permanent_vigilance_state
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.achievement_cannibalism_reconstructed_states = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { achievement_cannibalism_reconstruction_contribution = 1 }
		cannibalism_refresh_current_country_reconstruction_idea = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.achievement_cannibalism_reconstructed_states
					value = global.achievement_cannibalism_reconstruction_required
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_aftermath_all_states_reconstructed
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_ratify_international_compact = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_can_ratify_international_compact = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_manpower_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_command_cost = constant:cannibalism_reconstruction.compact_command }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_support_cost = constant:cannibalism_reconstruction.compact_support }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_truck_cost = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_train_cost = constant:cannibalism_reconstruction.compact_trains }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_convoy_cost = constant:cannibalism_reconstruction.compact_convoys }
		cannibalism_pay_reconstruction_cost = yes
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_international_compact_member
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_mission_active
		set_variable = { cannibalism_compact_vigilance_start_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_compact_vigilance_progress_days = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_compact_vigilance_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.compact_vigilance_days }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_country_flag = cannibalism_international_compact_member
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			}
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = cannibalism_international_inspection_compact }
			ROOT = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = cannibalism_international_inspection_compact } }
		}
		cannibalism_refresh_current_country_reconstruction_idea = yes
	}
}

	if = {

		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_mission_active
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_compact_vigilance_complete

	}

}

cannibalism_store_captured_warlord_outcome = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cba } } set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_cba_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbb } } set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_cbb_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbc } } set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_cbc_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbd } } set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_cbd_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbe } } set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_cbe_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbf } } set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_cbf_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbg } } set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_cbg_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbh } } set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_cbh_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection } }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_captured_warlord_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection }
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_character_outcome_recorded
	add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_character_outcomes_resolved = 1 }
}

cannibalism_resolve_captured_warlord_outcome = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_captured_warlord
			event_target:cannibalism_captured_warlord = { is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_captured_warlord = {
			cannibalism_store_captured_warlord_outcome = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.escape } } }
				retire_country_leader = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.public_trial } }
			add_stability = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.trial_stability
			add_political_power = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.trial_political_power
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.international_tribunal } }
			add_stability = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.tribunal_stability
			add_political_power = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.tribunal_political_power
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.local_prosecution } }
			add_stability = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.local_stability
			add_political_power = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.local_political_power
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.intelligence_cooperation } }
			add_political_power = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.cooperation_political_power
			add_command_power = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.cooperation_command_power
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_captured_warlord_cooperation
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.execution } }
			add_stability = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.execution_stability
			add_war_support = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.execution_war_support
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.escape } }
			add_stability = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.escape_stability
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_captured_warlord_escaped
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_resolve_captured_hannibal_outcome = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete
			has_event_target = cannibalism_captured_hannibal
		}
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_hannibal_character_outcome = cannibalism_character_outcome_selection }
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_hannibal_character_outcome_recorded
		event_target:cannibalism_captured_hannibal = {
			if = { limit = { has_character = CBL_hannibal } retire_character = CBL_hannibal }
			if = { limit = { has_character = ZZZ_hannibal_wendigo } retire_character = ZZZ_hannibal_wendigo }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.public_trial } }
			add_stability = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.trial_stability
			add_political_power = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.trial_political_power
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.international_tribunal } }
			add_stability = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.tribunal_stability
			add_political_power = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.tribunal_political_power
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.execution } }
			add_stability = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.execution_stability
			add_war_support = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.execution_war_support
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.disappearance } }
			add_stability = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.disappearance_stability
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_character_outcome_selection = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome.death_in_battle } }
			add_war_support = constant:cannibalism_character_outcome_result.death_war_support
		}
	}
}

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source section: 014_cannibalism_core_effects.txt

@CANNIBALISM_REINFECTION_PROTECTION_DAYS = 180

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 CANNIBALISM CORE EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Overview:
# - Selects the first wartime host and high-risk theater deterministically from
#   dynamic war, casualty, supply, stability, isolation, convoy, occupation,
#   manpower, and chaos factors.
# - Owns the canonical actor, node, recovery, and spread ledgers and the single
#   targeted pulse anchor. No broad periodic on_action is used.
# - Implements baseline country meters, state stages, exact finite population
#   consumption, local containment, external reinfection hooks, evolution
#   scheduling, global victory, world threat, and cleanup.
# - Warlord creation, unification, Wendigo convergence, country decisions, and
#   terminal packages build on this contract in their dedicated Event 014
#   effect files.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prefire context and deterministic target selection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_clear_prefire_context = {
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_ready
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_i
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_ii
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_iii
	clear_variable = global.cannibalism_prefire_pending_generation
	clear_variable = global.cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_host_scope_pool
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_host_score_pool
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_state_scope_pool
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_state_score_pool
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_ready = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending = 0 }
}

cannibalism_prepare_random_event_fire = {
	cannibalism_clear_prefire_context = yes
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_automatic_event_is_available = yes }
		cannibalism_select_first_host = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_first_host }
			cannibalism_refresh_prefire_evolution_state = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_first_host = {
				cannibalism_select_highest_risk_state = yes
				if = {
					limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_selected_state }
					event_target:cannibalism_selected_state = {
						save_event_target_as = cannibalism_initial_state
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_ready = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_ready < 1 } }
		cannibalism_clear_prefire_context = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.cannibalism_prefire_generation } }
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_prefire_generation = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.cannibalism_prefire_consumed_generation } }
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_prefire_consumed_generation = 0 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_prefire_generation = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_generation = global.cannibalism_prefire_generation }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_prefire_pending_generation = cannibalism_prefire_generation }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution = cannibalism_prefire_evolution }
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_ready
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled > 0 } }
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_i
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled > 0 } }
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_ii
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending > 0 } }
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_iii
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_refresh_prefire_evolution_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_event_id = constant:cannibalism_event.id }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_type = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_type }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_tier = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_i_tier }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_stage = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_i_stage }
	if = {
		limit = { is_current_evolution_enabled = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_i_stage }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_tier = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_ii_tier }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_stage = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_ii_stage }
	if = {
		limit = { is_current_evolution_enabled = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_ii_stage }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_tier = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_iii_tier }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_stage = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_iii_stage }
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_current_evolution_enabled = yes
			check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled > 0 }
			cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_capacity_is_available = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_score_current_host = {
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_scored_host
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.base }

	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.player }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { longest_war_length > constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.extreme_war_months }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.extreme_war }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { longest_war_length > constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.long_war_months }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.long_war }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { longest_war_length > constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.short_war_months }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.short_war }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_stability < constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.critical_stability }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.critical_stability }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_stability < constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.low_stability }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.low_stability }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_stability > constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.high_stability }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.high_stability_penalty }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_war_support < constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.low_war_support }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.low_war_support }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_casualty_ratio = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { max_manpower_k > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_casualty_ratio = casualties_k }
		divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_casualty_ratio = max_manpower_k }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_host_casualty_ratio
				value = constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.casualty_ratio_extreme
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.casualties_extreme }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_host_casualty_ratio
				value = constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.casualty_ratio_high
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.casualties_high }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_host_casualty_ratio
				value = constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.casualty_ratio_medium
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.casualties_medium }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_manpower_ratio = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { max_manpower_k > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_manpower_ratio = manpower_k }
		divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_manpower_ratio = max_manpower_k }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_host_manpower_ratio
				value = constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.manpower_ratio_critical
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.critical_manpower }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_host_manpower_ratio
				value = constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.manpower_ratio_low
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.low_manpower }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_country_has_isolated_theater = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.isolation }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_country_has_damaged_supply_theater = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.damaged_supply }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_country_has_remote_army = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.encircled_or_remote_army }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_country_has_convoy_pressure = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.convoy_losses }
		if = {
			limit = { convoy_threat > constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.convoy_threat_high }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.convoy_high }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { convoy_threat > constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.convoy_threat_medium }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.convoy_medium }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_country_has_external_hunger_pressure = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_integration.host_shortage_score }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_occupation_count = 0 }
	every_controlled_state = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { is_core_of = event_target:cannibalism_scored_host }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_occupation_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_host_occupation_count > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.occupied_state }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_host_occupation_count
				value = constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.large_occupation
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.occupied_state }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { num_divisions > constant:cannibalism_host_threshold.large_army }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.large_army }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.chaos_meter_value
				value = constant:chaos_meter_tier_range.tier_final.min
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.chaos_final }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.chaos_meter_value
				value = constant:chaos_meter_tier_range.tier_4.min
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.chaos_tier_4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.chaos_meter_value
				value = constant:chaos_meter_tier_range.tier_3.min
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.chaos_tier_3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.chaos_meter_value
				value = constant:chaos_meter_tier_range.tier_2.min
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.chaos_tier_2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.chaos_meter_value
				value = constant:chaos_meter_tier_range.tier_1.min
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_score = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.chaos_tier_1 }
	}

	round_temp_variable = cannibalism_host_score
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_host_score
		min = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.minimum
		max = constant:cannibalism_host_weight.maximum
	}
}

cannibalism_select_first_host = {
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_host_scope_pool
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_host_score_pool
	every_country = {
		limit = { cannibalism_can_be_origin = yes }
		cannibalism_score_current_host = yes
		add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_host_scope_pool = THIS }
		add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_host_score_pool = cannibalism_host_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_host_score_pool^num > 0 } }
		find_highest_in_array = {
			array = cannibalism_host_score_pool
			value = cannibalism_best_host_score
			index = cannibalism_best_host_index
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_pool_iteration = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_selected = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cannibalism_host_scope_pool
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_host_selected < 1 }
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_host_pool_iteration
						value = cannibalism_best_host_index
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				save_event_target_as = cannibalism_first_host
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_selected = 1 }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_host_pool_iteration = 1 }
		}
	}
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_host_scope_pool
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_host_score_pool
}

cannibalism_score_current_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.base }
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_state_has_army_presence = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.army_presence }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_island_state = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.island }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_home_area = yes } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.remote_from_capital }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { infrastructure < constant:cannibalism_state_threshold.critical_infrastructure }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.critical_infrastructure }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { infrastructure < constant:cannibalism_state_threshold.low_infrastructure }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.low_infrastructure }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_damaged_buildings = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.damaged_port }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { naval_base > 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.port }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { supply_node > 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.supply_node }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = event_target:cannibalism_state_host } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.occupied }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_state_has_prison_or_camp = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.prison_or_camp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_state_has_external_hunger_pressure = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_integration.state_shortage_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = state_population_k
				value = constant:cannibalism_state_threshold.very_dense_population_k
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.very_dense_population }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = state_population_k
				value = constant:cannibalism_state_threshold.dense_population_k
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.dense_population }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_capital = yes }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_score = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.capital_penalty }
	}
	round_temp_variable = cannibalism_state_score
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_state_score
		min = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.minimum
		max = constant:cannibalism_state_weight.maximum
	}
}

cannibalism_select_highest_risk_state = {
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_state_host
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_state_scope_pool
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_state_score_pool
	every_controlled_state = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_state_is_valid_origin = yes
			NOT = { cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes }
		}
		cannibalism_score_current_state = yes
		add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_state_scope_pool = THIS }
		add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_state_score_pool = cannibalism_state_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_state_score_pool^num > 0 } }
		find_highest_in_array = {
			array = cannibalism_state_score_pool
			value = cannibalism_best_state_score
			index = cannibalism_best_state_index
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_pool_iteration = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_selected = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cannibalism_state_scope_pool
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_state_selected < 1 }
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_state_pool_iteration
						value = cannibalism_best_state_index
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				save_event_target_as = cannibalism_selected_state
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_selected = 1 }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_state_pool_iteration = 1 }
		}
	}
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_state_scope_pool
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_state_score_pool
}

cannibalism_register_current_country_actor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_actor_register_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries value = THIS } }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_next_actor_generation = 1 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_actor_generation = global.cannibalism_next_actor_generation }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_country_active
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_country_cleanup_complete
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries value = THIS }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_actor_register_result = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries value = THIS }
			NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_next_actor_generation = 1 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_actor_generation = global.cannibalism_next_actor_generation }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_country_active
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_country_cleanup_complete
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_actor_register_result = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries value = THIS }
			has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_country_active }
			NOT = { is_cannibalism_country = yes }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_next_actor_generation = 1 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_actor_generation = global.cannibalism_next_actor_generation }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_country_active
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_country_cleanup_complete
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_actor_register_result = 1 }
	}
}

	}
}

cannibalism_schedule_current_pulse_after_delay = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_scheduled }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_retired_pulse_callback }
			NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_ticket }
			NOT = { has_variable = global.cannibalism_active_pulse_ticket }
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_system_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_cleanup_complete }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_next_pulse_days > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_interval_days = cannibalism_next_pulse_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_next_pulse_ticket = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_active_pulse_ticket = global.cannibalism_next_pulse_ticket }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_pulse_due_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_pulse_due_date = cannibalism_next_pulse_days }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_ticket = global.cannibalism_active_pulse_ticket }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_pulse_flag_days = cannibalism_next_pulse_days }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_pulse_flag_days = constant:cannibalism_timing.pulse_flag_buffer_days }
		set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_pulse_scheduled days = cannibalism_pulse_flag_days }
		country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.10 days = cannibalism_next_pulse_days }
	}
}

cannibalism_schedule_next_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_scheduled }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_retired_pulse_callback }
			NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_ticket }
			NOT = { has_variable = global.cannibalism_active_pulse_ticket }
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_system_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_cleanup_complete }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_next_pulse_days = constant:cannibalism_timing.pulse_baseline_days }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_first_pulse_pending }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_next_pulse_days = constant:cannibalism_timing.first_pulse_days }
			clr_global_flag = cannibalism_first_pulse_pending
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.cannibalism_global_stage
					value = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.convergence
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_next_pulse_days = constant:cannibalism_timing.pulse_convergence_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.cannibalism_global_stage
					value = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.network
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_next_pulse_days = constant:cannibalism_timing.pulse_network_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.cannibalism_global_stage
					value = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.ritual
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_next_pulse_days = constant:cannibalism_timing.pulse_ritual_days }
		}
		cannibalism_schedule_current_pulse_after_delay = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_retire_current_pulse_callback = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_pulse_callback_retire_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_rehome_pulse_immediate = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_current_country_owns_active_pulse_callback = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_rehome_pulse_days = global.cannibalism_pulse_due_date }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_rehome_pulse_days = global.date }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_rehome_pulse_days < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_rehome_pulse_immediate = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_retired_pulse_ticket = cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_ticket }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_retired_pulse_callback
		clear_variable = cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_ticket
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_scheduled
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_active_pulse_ticket
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_pulse_due_date
		clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_pulse_callback_retire_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_rehome_current_pulse_callback = {
	cannibalism_retire_current_pulse_callback = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_pulse_callback_retire_result > 0 } }
		cannibalism_find_replacement_pulse_anchor = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found < 1 }
				has_event_target = cannibalism_lifecycle_successor
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_lifecycle_successor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = yes
						NOT = { has_capitulated = yes }
						NOT = { is_actual_nonhuman_country = yes }
						NOT = { is_cannibalism_reusable_warlord_slot_country = yes }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_retired_pulse_callback }
					}
					set_country_flag = cannibalism_recovery_coordinator
					cannibalism_select_current_country_as_pulse_anchor = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found > 0 }
				has_event_target = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_pulse_anchor = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_rehome_pulse_immediate > 0 } }
					cannibalism_run_pulse_on_valid_anchor = yes
				}
				else = {
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_next_pulse_days = cannibalism_rehome_pulse_days }
					cannibalism_schedule_current_pulse_after_delay = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
