cannibalism_rebuild_runtime_counts = {
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_infected_country_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_mature_cell_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_independent_node_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_controlled_state_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_connected_route_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = 0 }
	cannibalism_rebuild_spread_pending_ledgers = yes

	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
		if = {
			limit = { is_cannibalism_active_country = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_infected_country_count = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_network.infected_country }
			if = {
				limit = { is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_count = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_network.warlord_country }
			}
		}
	}

	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_node_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
				cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_state_stage
						value = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_mature_cell_count = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { cannibalism_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.island_commune }
						check_variable = {
							var = cannibalism_state_stage
							value = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state
							compare = greater_than_or_equals
						}
						CONTROLLER = { is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes }
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_independent_node_count = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { CONTROLLER = { is_cannibalism_country = yes } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_controlled_state_count = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_external_route_node }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_connected_route_count = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_network.foreign_seed }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.prison } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_network.prison_node }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.port } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_network.port_node }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.island_commune } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_network.island_commune }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.occupation } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_network.occupation_node }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.rail } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_network.rail_node }
			}
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_network.formation_node }
			}
		}
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_milestones = global.cannibalism_consumed_population_k }
	divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_milestones = constant:cannibalism_network.consumption_milestone_population_k }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_consumption_milestones
		min = 0
		max = constant:cannibalism_network.consumption_milestone_maximum
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_milestones = constant:cannibalism_network.consumption_milestone }
	add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = cannibalism_consumption_milestones }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cannibalism_network_reach min = constant:cannibalism_network.min max = constant:cannibalism_network.max }

	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_readiness = global.cannibalism_network_reach }
	multiply_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_readiness = constant:cannibalism_convergence.network_reach_weight }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = global.cannibalism_warlord_count }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = constant:cannibalism_convergence.warlord_weight }
	add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_readiness = cannibalism_convergence_score_component }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = global.cannibalism_independent_node_count }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = constant:cannibalism_convergence.independent_node_weight }
	add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_readiness = cannibalism_convergence_score_component }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = global.cannibalism_connected_route_count }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = constant:cannibalism_convergence.connected_route_weight }
	add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_readiness = cannibalism_convergence_score_component }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = global.cannibalism_controlled_state_count }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = constant:cannibalism_convergence.controlled_state_weight }
	add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_readiness = cannibalism_convergence_score_component }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = global.cannibalism_consumed_population_k }
	divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = constant:cannibalism_convergence.consumption_score_divisor_k }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_convergence_score_component = constant:cannibalism_convergence.consumption_milestone_weight }
	add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_readiness = cannibalism_convergence_score_component }

	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.cannibalism_controlled_state_count
				value = global.cannibalism_max_controlled_states
				compare = greater_than
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_max_controlled_states = global.cannibalism_controlled_state_count }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.cannibalism_warlord_count
				value = global.cannibalism_max_warlords
				compare = greater_than
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_max_warlords = global.cannibalism_warlord_count }
	}
}

cannibalism_refresh_world_threat_source = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_system_active
			cannibalism_is_existential_world_threat = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_global_victory }
		}
		set_global_flag = world_threat_source_cannibalism
	}
	else = {
		clr_global_flag = world_threat_source_cannibalism
	}
	refresh_world_threat_state = yes
}

cannibalism_find_replacement_pulse_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_has_valid_pulse_anchor = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found < 1 }
					cannibalism_country_can_continue_pulse = yes
				}
				cannibalism_select_current_country_as_pulse_anchor = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found < 1 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_node_states
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found < 1 }
					has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
					CONTROLLER = {
						exists = yes
						NOT = { has_capitulated = yes }
					}
				}
				CONTROLLER = {
					set_country_flag = cannibalism_recovery_coordinator
					cannibalism_select_current_country_as_pulse_anchor = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found < 1 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_recovery_states
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found < 1 }
					has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active
					OWNER = {
						exists = yes
						NOT = { has_capitulated = yes }
					}
				}
				OWNER = {
					set_country_flag = cannibalism_recovery_coordinator
					cannibalism_select_current_country_as_pulse_anchor = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_replacement_anchor_found = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_complete_current_country_local_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_active_ordinary_country = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_local_victory }
		}
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_country_active
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_local_victory
		cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = yes
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_recovery_coordinator
		set_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage = constant:cannibalism_country_stage.locally_defeated }
		clear_variable = cannibalism_local_victory_due_date
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_frontline_crisis }
		set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_external_reinfection_protected days = @CANNIBALISM_REINFECTION_PROTECTION_DAYS }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.local_victory_chaos }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_local_victory }
		cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
		cannibalism_try_enqueue_local_victory_survivors = yes
		cannibalism_achievement_record_local_victory = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_process_current_actor_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_country_can_continue_pulse = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_last_processed_pulse_sequence }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_last_processed_pulse_sequence
					value = global.cannibalism_pulse_sequence
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_last_processed_pulse_sequence = global.cannibalism_pulse_sequence }

		if = {
			limit = { has_war = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_hunger_war }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_hunger_peace }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_peace }
		}
		cannibalism_apply_external_pressure_to_current_actor = yes

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_open_emergency }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_integrity_open }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_concealment }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_integrity_conceal }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_exploitation }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_integrity_exploit }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_cult_exploit }
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_country_has_active_state_cell = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_cell_unchecked }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_cell_recovery }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_command_integrity
						value = constant:cannibalism_meter.active
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_cult_recovery }
			}
		}

		every_controlled_state = {
			limit = {
				cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes
				cannibalism_state_has_any_larder_contamination = yes
			}
			cannibalism_process_current_state_contamination_against_cell = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_larder > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_decay = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_weekly_decay_base }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_decay_component = num_of_controlled_states }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_decay_component = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_weekly_decay_per_state }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_decay = cannibalism_larder_decay_component }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_decay_component = num_divisions }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_decay_component = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_weekly_decay_per_division }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_decay = cannibalism_larder_decay_component }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_decay_negative = cannibalism_larder_decay }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_decay_negative = -1 }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_larder_decay_negative }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_cannibalism_country = yes
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_larder
					value = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_starving
					compare = less_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_starvation }
		}

		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_field_hunger min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_command_integrity min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_cell_strength min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_cult_cohesion min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_max }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_frenzy min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_max }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_network_alignment }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_network_alignment min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_max }
		}
		cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
		cannibalism_schedule_pending_evolution_reports = yes
		cannibalism_process_pending_evolution_reports = yes
		cannibalism_process_current_country_mission_objectives = yes
		cannibalism_process_current_country_objectives = yes
		if = {
			limit = { is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes }
			cannibalism_process_wendigo_transformation_pulse = yes
		}
		cannibalism_try_enqueue_current_actor_border_spread = yes

		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_country_can_begin_stabilization = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_local_victory_due_date } }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_local_victory_due_date = global.date }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_local_victory_due_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.stabilization_days }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_local_victory_due_date
						value = global.date
						compare = less_than_or_equals
					}
				}
				cannibalism_complete_current_country_local_victory = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			clear_variable = cannibalism_local_victory_due_date
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_mark_current_state_for_recovery = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
		}
		cannibalism_achievement_record_cell_suppression = yes
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
		clear_variable = cannibalism_node_id
		clear_variable = cannibalism_node_generation
		clear_variable = cannibalism_node_type
		clear_variable = cannibalism_node_strength
		clear_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country
		clear_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country_generation
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_external_route_node
		clear_variable = cannibalism_external_route_type
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_recovery_states value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_recovery_states value = THIS }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.liberated_emergency }
		cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
		set_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.liberated_emergency_days }
	}
}

cannibalism_process_current_node_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
			has_variable = cannibalism_node_id
			has_variable = cannibalism_node_generation
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_last_processed_pulse_sequence }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_last_processed_pulse_sequence
					value = global.cannibalism_pulse_sequence
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_last_processed_pulse_sequence = global.cannibalism_pulse_sequence }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_node_pulse_delta = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_node_source_is_live = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country_generation
				country_exists = var:cannibalism_node_source_country
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_source_generation = cannibalism_node_source_country_generation }
			var:cannibalism_node_source_country = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_cannibalism_active_country = yes
						check_variable = {
							var = cannibalism_actor_generation
							value = cannibalism_expected_source_generation
							compare = equals
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_node_source_is_live = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_node_source_is_live > 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_node_pulse_delta = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_node_growth }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_state_is_isolated = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_node_pulse_delta = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_network_node }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				CONTROLLER = {
					is_cannibalism_active_ordinary_country = yes
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_command_integrity
						value = constant:cannibalism_meter.active
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_node_pulse_delta = constant:cannibalism_delta.weekly_node_suppression }
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_node_strength = cannibalism_node_pulse_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_node_strength min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_node_strength
					value = constant:cannibalism_meter.dormant
					compare = less_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			cannibalism_mark_current_state_for_recovery = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.cannibalism_global_stage
					value = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.network
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_node_strength
					value = constant:cannibalism_meter.critical
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage < constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state }
			cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.cannibalism_global_stage
					value = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.ritual
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_node_strength
					value = constant:cannibalism_meter.severe
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage < constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }
			cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_node_strength
					value = constant:cannibalism_meter.guarded
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage < constant:cannibalism_state_stage.compromised_garrison }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.compromised_garrison }
			cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_state_stage
					value = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_consumption_cooldown }
				CONTROLLER = { is_cannibalism_country = yes }
			}
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state
			if = {
				limit = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder }
				CONTROLLER = {
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.silent_larder }
					cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				CONTROLLER = {
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.feeding }
					cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		if = {

		}
	}
}

cannibalism_complete_global_cleanup = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_global_victory
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_cleanup_complete }
			NOT = { cannibalism_has_global_residue = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = { cannibalism_clear_wendigo_prelock_operation_runtime = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target = {
				clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_defender
				clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target_lock
			}
			clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target
		}
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_cleanup_complete
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_system_active
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_first_pulse_pending
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_global_stabilization_active
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_broken
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_scenario_convergence_contract
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_unification_pending
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due
		clr_global_flag = world_threat_source_cannibalism
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_pulse_anchor }
			event_target:cannibalism_pulse_anchor = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
					clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_scheduled
					clr_country_flag = cannibalism_recovery_coordinator

		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_pulse_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_interval_days
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_global_victory_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_zero_residue_start_date

		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_ii_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_iii_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor_generation
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor_generation
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_convergence_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_convergence_rebuild_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_unification_readiness
		clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
		clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_latest_actor
		clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor
		clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor
		clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_unification_host
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_actor_countries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_objective_countries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_node_states = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_recovery_states = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_country_entries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_state_entries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_country_entries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_route_entries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_generation_entries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_due_date_entries = 0 }
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_infected_country_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_mature_cell_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_independent_node_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_connected_route_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_controlled_state_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_pending_spread_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_readiness = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_larder = 0 }
		refresh_world_threat_state = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_check_global_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_worldwide_victory_conditions = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_global_victory }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.cannibalism_global_victory_due_date } }
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_victory_due_date = global.date }
			add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_victory_due_date = constant:cannibalism_evolution_threshold.global_defeat_stabilization_days }
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_global_stabilization_active
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = global.cannibalism_global_victory_due_date
					value = global.date
					compare = less_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_global_victory
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_stage = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.defeated }
			clear_variable = global.cannibalism_global_victory_due_date
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.global_victory_chaos }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_global_victory }
			cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
			cannibalism_refresh_world_threat_source = yes
			cannibalism_achievement_record_global_victory = yes
			cannibalism_try_start_global_defeat_aftermath = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_global_victory } }
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_global_victory_due_date
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_global_stabilization_active
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_global_victory }
		cannibalism_complete_global_cleanup = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_record_current_evolution = {
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_event_id = constant:cannibalism_event.id }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_type = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_type }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_stage = cannibalism_evolution_stage_to_record }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_has_actor = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_stage_to_record = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_i_stage } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_tier = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_i_tier }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_stage_to_record = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_ii_stage } }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_tier = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_ii_tier }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_tier = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_iii_tier }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			is_cannibalism_active_country = yes
		}
		save_event_target_as = events_log_evolution_actor
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_has_actor = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_latest_actor }
		event_target:cannibalism_latest_actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					is_cannibalism_active_country = yes
				}
				save_event_target_as = events_log_evolution_actor
				set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_has_actor = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	record_events_log_evolution_entry = yes
}

cannibalism_process_pending_evolution_reports = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_scheduled
			has_variable = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_generation
			has_variable = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_due_date
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_generation
				value = cannibalism_actor_generation
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_due_date
				value = global.date
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.20 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_scheduled
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation }
				NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_generation }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_generation
						value = cannibalism_actor_generation
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_scheduled
		clear_variable = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_generation
		clear_variable = cannibalism_evolution_i_report_due_date
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_scheduled
			has_variable = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_generation
			has_variable = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_due_date
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_generation
				value = cannibalism_actor_generation
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_due_date
				value = global.date
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.21 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_scheduled
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation }
				NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_generation }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_generation
						value = cannibalism_actor_generation
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_scheduled
		clear_variable = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_generation
		clear_variable = cannibalism_evolution_ii_report_due_date
	}
}

cannibalism_open_evolution_i = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized > 0 }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
		}
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_active
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_stage = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.ritual }
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor_generation
		clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
			if = {
				limit = { is_cannibalism_active_country = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage < constant:cannibalism_country_stage.ritual_cell } }
					set_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage = constant:cannibalism_country_stage.ritual_cell }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion } }
					set_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_cult_cohesion }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion < constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_cult_cohesion } }
					set_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_cult_cohesion }
				}
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_ritual_ideology_active
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_recorded } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_stage_to_record = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_i_stage }
			cannibalism_record_current_evolution = yes
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_recorded
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
			if = {
				limit = { is_cannibalism_active_country = yes }
				cannibalism_schedule_pending_evolution_reports = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.evolution_i_chaos }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_spread }
		cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_begin_convergence_window = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized > 0 }
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_broken }
		}
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active
		set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_convergence_visibility_open
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_unification_pending
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_stage = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.convergence }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_convergence_due_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_convergence_due_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.convergence_warning_days }
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_iii_due_date
		clear_array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_is_viable_unification_host = yes }
				add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS }
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_convergence_participant
			}
		}
		cannibalism_achievement_prepare_convergence_counterplay = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.convergence_chaos }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_spread }
		cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_break_convergence = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
		}
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_unification_pending
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_broken
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_broken_once
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_scenario_convergence_contract
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_stage = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.network }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_convergence_rebuild_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_convergence_rebuild_date = constant:cannibalism_convergence.rebuild_cooldown_days }
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_convergence_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_iii_due_date
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					clr_country_flag = cannibalism_convergence_participant
					cannibalism_clear_network_preparation_flags = yes
				}
		}
		clear_array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries
	}
}

cannibalism_select_evolution_i_mtth_actor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_mtth_actor_found = 0 }
	clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor_generation
	clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_mtth_actor_found < 1 }
				cannibalism_current_actor_qualifies_for_evolution_i = yes
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor_generation = cannibalism_actor_generation }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_mtth_actor_found = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_select_evolution_ii_mtth_actor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_mtth_actor_found = 0 }
	clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor_generation
	clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_mtth_actor_found < 1 }
				cannibalism_current_actor_qualifies_for_evolution_ii = yes
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor_generation = cannibalism_actor_generation }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_mtth_actor_found = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_try_schedule_evolution_i = {
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_event_id = constant:cannibalism_event.id }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_type = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_type }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_tier = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_i_tier }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_stage = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_i_stage }
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_current_evolution_enabled = yes
			cannibalism_can_open_evolution_i = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor_is_valid = yes } }
			clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_due_date
			cannibalism_select_evolution_i_mtth_actor = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor_is_valid = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_due_date }
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor = {
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_delay_days = mtth:cannibalism_evolution_i_days }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cannibalism_evolution_delay_days min = constant:cannibalism_evolution_mtth.minimum_days max = constant:cannibalism_evolution_mtth.maximum_days }
			}
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_evolution_i_due_date = global.date }
			add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_evolution_i_due_date = cannibalism_evolution_delay_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor_is_valid = yes
				check_variable = {
					var = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_due_date
					value = global.date
					compare = less_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 1 }
			cannibalism_open_evolution_i = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor_generation
		clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor
	}
}

cannibalism_try_schedule_evolution_iii = {
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_event_id = constant:cannibalism_event.id }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_type = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_type }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_tier = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_iii_tier }
	set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_stage = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_iii_stage }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { cannibalism_convergence_entry_conditions_hold = yes } }
		cannibalism_break_convergence = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_current_evolution_enabled = yes
			has_variable = global.cannibalism_convergence_due_date
			check_variable = {
				var = global.cannibalism_convergence_due_date
				value = global.date
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_can_open_evolution_iii = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 1 }
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due
			clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_iii_due_date
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			cannibalism_break_convergence = yes
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_try_schedule_evolutions = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_active } }
		cannibalism_try_schedule_evolution_i = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active } }
		cannibalism_try_schedule_evolution_ii = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_event_id = constant:cannibalism_event.id }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_type = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_type }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_tier = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_iii_tier }
		set_temp_variable = { events_log_evolution_stage = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_iii_stage }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_current_evolution_enabled = yes
				cannibalism_can_enter_convergence = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 1 }
			cannibalism_begin_convergence_window = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 0 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due }
		}
		cannibalism_try_schedule_evolution_iii = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_run_pulse_on_valid_anchor = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_system_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_cleanup_complete }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_pulse_sequence = 1 }
		cannibalism_compact_actor_registry = yes
		cannibalism_compact_node_registry = yes
		cannibalism_compact_recovery_registry = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
			cannibalism_process_current_actor_pulse = yes
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_objective_countries
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries value = THIS } }
				}
				cannibalism_process_current_country_objectives = yes
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_node_states
			cannibalism_process_current_node_pulse = yes
		}
		cannibalism_process_recovery_registry = yes
		cannibalism_process_spread_queue = yes
		cannibalism_compact_spread_queue = yes
		cannibalism_process_warlord_slot_release_queue = yes
		cannibalism_try_form_warlord_country = yes
		cannibalism_compact_actor_registry = yes
		cannibalism_compact_node_registry = yes
		cannibalism_compact_recovery_registry = yes
		cannibalism_rebuild_runtime_counts = yes
		cannibalism_achievement_process_pulse = yes
		cannibalism_refresh_convergence_cooldown = yes
		cannibalism_try_schedule_evolutions = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due
				NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
			}
			cannibalism_execute_evolution_iii_reveal = yes
		}
		cannibalism_check_global_victory = yes
		cannibalism_refresh_world_threat_source = yes
		cannibalism_schedule_next_pulse = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_run_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_retired_pulse_callback }
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_retired_pulse_callback
		clear_variable = cannibalism_retired_pulse_ticket
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_current_country_owns_active_pulse_callback = yes }
		clear_variable = cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_ticket
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_scheduled
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_active_pulse_ticket
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_pulse_due_date
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = cannibalism_system_active
				NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_cleanup_complete }
				cannibalism_country_can_continue_pulse = yes
			}
			cannibalism_run_pulse_on_valid_anchor = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_flag = cannibalism_system_active
				NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_cleanup_complete }
			}
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
			clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
			cannibalism_find_replacement_pulse_anchor = yes
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_has_valid_pulse_anchor = yes }
				event_target:cannibalism_pulse_anchor = {
					cannibalism_run_pulse_on_valid_anchor = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		clear_variable = cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_ticket
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_scheduled
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pulse_anchor
	}
}

cannibalism_initialize_current_state_as_opening_node = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.formation }
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_state_has_prison_or_camp = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.prison }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_island_state = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.island_commune }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = event_target:cannibalism_node_source_actor } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.occupation }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { naval_base > 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.port }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { rail_way > 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.rail }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_opening.baseline_cell_strength }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_cell_strength }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_cell_strength }
	}
	cannibalism_register_current_state_node = yes
}

cannibalism_add_prefire_secondary_state = {
	cannibalism_select_highest_risk_state = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_selected_state }
		event_target:cannibalism_selected_state = {
			cannibalism_initialize_current_state_as_opening_node = yes
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_initialize_current_country = {
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_current_actor
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_node_source_actor
	cannibalism_register_current_country_actor = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_actor_register_result > 0 } }
		cannibalism_reset_current_country_incarnation_state = yes
		cannibalism_initialize_new_country_incarnation = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_initialize_new_country_incarnation = {
	cannibalism_achievement_mark_initial_host = yes
	set_variable = { cannibalism_policy = constant:cannibalism_policy.none }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage = constant:cannibalism_country_stage.active_baseline }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_opening.baseline_field_hunger }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_opening.baseline_command_integrity }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_opening.baseline_cell_strength }
	clear_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion
	clear_variable = cannibalism_network_alignment
	set_variable = { cannibalism_larder = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population_k = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_confirmed_predation_count = 1 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_last_processed_pulse_sequence = 0 }
	cannibalism_initialize_current_country_decision_tuning = yes

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage = constant:cannibalism_country_stage.ritual_cell }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_field_hunger }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_command_integrity }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_cell_strength }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_cult_cohesion }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 1 } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage = constant:cannibalism_country_stage.network_node }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_field_hunger }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_command_integrity }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_cell_strength }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_cult_cohesion }
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_resistant }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_frontline_crisis } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_frontline_crisis }
	}
	cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
	save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_latest_actor
	cannibalism_select_current_country_as_pulse_anchor = yes

	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_initial_state }
		event_target:cannibalism_initial_state = {
			ROOT = { set_variable = { cannibalism_primary_theater_state = PREV } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.suspected_predation }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.compromised_garrison }
			}
			cannibalism_initialize_current_state_as_opening_node = yes
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.compromised_garrison }
		cannibalism_add_prefire_secondary_state = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }
		cannibalism_add_prefire_secondary_state = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }
		cannibalism_add_prefire_secondary_state = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 1 }
		cannibalism_open_evolution_i = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 1 }
		cannibalism_open_evolution_ii = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending > 0 } }
		cannibalism_setup_prefire_evolution_iii_opening = yes
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.spread_chaos }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_entry }
	cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
	cannibalism_rebuild_runtime_counts = yes
	cannibalism_refresh_world_threat_source = yes
	cannibalism_schedule_next_pulse = yes
}

cannibalism_begin_from_prefire_context = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_begin_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_ready = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_generation = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_ready }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_ready = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_generation = global.cannibalism_prefire_pending_generation }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = global.cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_i }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_ii }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_iii }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_ready > 0 }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_first_host
			has_event_target = cannibalism_initial_state
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_prefire_generation
				value = global.cannibalism_prefire_consumed_generation
				compare = greater_than
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_first_host = {
				exists = yes
				cannibalism_can_be_origin = yes
				event_target:cannibalism_initial_state = {
					is_controlled_by = PREV
					cannibalism_state_is_valid_origin = yes
				}
			}
		}
		cannibalism_initialize_global_runtime = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_first_host = {
			cannibalism_initialize_current_country = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_actor_register_result > 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.cannibalism_prefire_consumed_generation = cannibalism_prefire_generation }
				country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_begin_result = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_ready
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_i
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_ii
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution_iii
	clear_variable = global.cannibalism_prefire_pending_generation
	clear_variable = global.cannibalism_prefire_pending_evolution
}

cannibalism_clear_current_policy = {
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_open_emergency
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_concealment
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_exploitation
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_humane_response_active
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_evidence_suppressed
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_terror_program_active
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_exploitation_unresolved
}

cannibalism_choose_open_emergency_policy = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_active_ordinary_country = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_opening_policy_chosen }
		}
		cannibalism_clear_current_policy = yes
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_opening_policy_chosen
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_open_emergency
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_humane_response_active
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_containment_decisions_open
		set_variable = { cannibalism_policy = constant:cannibalism_policy.open_emergency }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_delta.open_hunger }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_delta.open_integrity }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_delta.humane_response_cult }
		}
		add_stability = constant:cannibalism_policy_effect.open_stability
		add_war_support = constant:cannibalism_policy_effect.open_war_support
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.open_policy_chaos }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_entry }
		cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
		cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
		cannibalism_schedule_pending_evolution_reports = yes
	}
}

		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion }

	}
}
