cannibalism_set_consumption_parameters_from_context = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_base_percent = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.hunting } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_base_percent = constant:cannibalism_consumption.hunting_percent }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.hunting_people_cap }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.hunting_larder_per_population_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.maximum_hunting_larder }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.feeding } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_base_percent = constant:cannibalism_consumption.feeding_percent }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.feeding_people_cap }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.feeding_larder_per_population_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.maximum_feeding_larder }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.silent_larder } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_base_percent = constant:cannibalism_consumption.silent_percent }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.silent_people_cap }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.silent_larder_per_population_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.maximum_silent_larder }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.recruitment } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_base_percent = constant:cannibalism_consumption.recruitment_percent }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.recruitment_people_cap }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.recruitment_larder_per_population_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.maximum_recruitment_larder }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.emergency_reinforcement } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_base_percent = constant:cannibalism_consumption.emergency_reinforcement_percent }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.emergency_reinforcement_people_cap }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.emergency_reinforcement_larder_per_population_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.maximum_emergency_reinforcement_larder }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.battlefield } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_base_percent = constant:cannibalism_consumption.battlefield_percent }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.battlefield_people_cap }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.battlefield_larder_per_population_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.maximum_battlefield_larder }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.warlord_creation } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_base_percent = constant:cannibalism_consumption.warlord_creation_percent }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.warlord_creation_people_cap }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.warlord_creation_larder_per_population_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap = constant:cannibalism_consumption.maximum_warlord_creation_larder }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.prisoner_feeding } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_base_percent = constant:cannibalism_consumption.feeding_percent }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap = constant:cannibalism_integration.prisoner_feeding_people }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_integration.prisoner_feeding_larder_per_population_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap = constant:cannibalism_integration.prisoner_feeding_larder_cap }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.invalid_scope }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_population_loss_applied = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_gained = 0 }
	cannibalism_set_consumption_parameters_from_context = yes

	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_active_country = yes
			has_event_target = cannibalism_consumption_target_state
			check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_parameters_valid > 0 }
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_actor
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_next_consumption_request_id = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_request_id = global.cannibalism_next_consumption_request_id }
		event_target:cannibalism_consumption_target_state = {
			cannibalism_consume_current_state = yes
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_consume_current_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.invalid_scope }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_population_loss_applied = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_gained = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_consumption_actor
			event_target:cannibalism_consumption_actor = {
				exists = yes
				is_cannibalism_active_country = yes
			}
			check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_request_id > 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = cannibalism_last_consumption_request_id
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_last_consumption_request_id
					value = cannibalism_consumption_request_id
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.duplicate_request }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { cannibalism_can_consume_current_state = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.blocked_state }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_diminishing_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.first_action_yield_factor }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = cannibalism_consumption_actions
					check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_actions > constant:cannibalism_consumption.exhausted_action_prior_actions }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_diminishing_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.exhausted_action_yield_factor }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_actions > constant:cannibalism_consumption.fourth_action_prior_actions } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_diminishing_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.fourth_action_yield_factor }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_actions > constant:cannibalism_consumption.third_action_prior_actions } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_diminishing_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.third_action_yield_factor }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_actions > constant:cannibalism_consumption.second_action_prior_actions } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_diminishing_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.second_action_yield_factor }
			}

			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_usable_factor = cannibalism_consumption_diminishing_factor }
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_state_has_bioweapon_contamination = yes }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_usable_factor = constant:cannibalism_consumption.contamination_yield_factor }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_state_has_chemical_contamination = yes }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_usable_factor = constant:cannibalism_integration.chemical_larder_yield_factor }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = global.air_contamination_bp
					check_variable = {
						var = global.air_contamination_bp
						value = constant:air_contamination_threshold_bp.winter_75
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
				multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_usable_factor = constant:cannibalism_integration.severe_air_larder_yield_factor }
			}

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_population_requested = cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_population_available = state_population_k }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_population_available = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_population_requested = cannibalism_consumption_population_available }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_population_requested = cannibalism_consumption_base_percent }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_population_requested = cannibalism_consumption_usable_factor }
				clamp_temp_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_consumption_population_requested
					min = 0
					max = cannibalism_consumption_hard_cap
				}
				round_temp_variable = cannibalism_consumption_population_requested
			}

			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_requested = cannibalism_consumption_population_requested }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_minimum_remaining = constant:cannibalism_consumption.minimum_remaining_people }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.cannibalism_consumption }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.prisoner_feeding } }
				set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_log_deaths = 0 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_target_country = event_target:cannibalism_consumption_actor }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_has_target_country = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_applied = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_result = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.zero }
			set_temp_variable = { state_civilian_population_loss_contract_supplied = constant:chaos_meter_deaths.one }
			apply_exact_state_civilian_population_loss = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_population_loss_applied = state_civilian_population_loss_applied }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.prisoner_feeding }
					check_variable = { cannibalism_population_loss_applied > 0 }
				}
				cannibalism_log_mixed_prisoner_feeding_deaths = yes
			}

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_population_loss_applied > 0 } }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_last_consumption_request_id = cannibalism_consumption_request_id }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_actions = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_consumption_sequence = 1 }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_last_consumption_sequence = global.cannibalism_consumption_sequence }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_consumed_population = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
				set_variable = { global.cannibalism_consumed_population_k = global.cannibalism_consumed_population }
				divide_variable = { global.cannibalism_consumed_population_k = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }

				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_gained = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
				divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_gained = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_gained = cannibalism_consumption_larder_factor }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people > 0 } }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_gained = cannibalism_consumption_usable_factor }
				}
				event_target:cannibalism_consumption_actor = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_country_flag = cannibalism_larder_mobile
							has_variable = cannibalism_warlord_mobile_larder_yield_factor
						}
						multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_gained = cannibalism_warlord_mobile_larder_yield_factor }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_warlord_consumption_yield_factor }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_larder_gained = cannibalism_warlord_consumption_yield_factor }
					}
				}
				clamp_temp_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_larder_gained
					min = 0
					max = cannibalism_consumption_larder_cap
				}

				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_timing.consumption_cooldown_days }
				set_state_flag = { flag = cannibalism_consumption_cooldown days = cannibalism_consumption_cooldown_days }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied }

				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = cannibalism_consumption_actions
							value = constant:cannibalism_consumption.state_silent_actions
							compare = greater_than_or_equals
						}
						check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage < constant:cannibalism_state_stage.silent_larder }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.silent_larder }
					cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = cannibalism_consumption_actions
							value = constant:cannibalism_consumption.state_feeding_actions
							compare = greater_than_or_equals
						}
						check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage < constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state }
					cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = {
							var = cannibalism_consumption_actions
							value = constant:cannibalism_consumption.state_hunting_actions
							compare = greater_than_or_equals
						}
						check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage < constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }
					cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
				}

				event_target:cannibalism_consumption_actor = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								is_cannibalism_unified_country = yes
								is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes
							}
						}
						add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_larder_gained }
						clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_unification.global_larder_maximum }
						set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_larder = cannibalism_larder }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_larder_gained }
						clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_max }
					}
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
					set_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population_k = cannibalism_consumed_population }
					divide_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population_k = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_consumption }
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_delta.consumption_hunger }
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_delta.consumption_integrity }
					clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_frenzy min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_max }
					clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_field_hunger min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
					clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_command_integrity min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
					cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.population_exhausted }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Country penalties and state-stage lifecycle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = {
	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_stability = cannibalism_field_hunger }
	divide_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_stability = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	multiply_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_stability = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.hunger_stability_scale }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_component = cannibalism_cell_strength }
	divide_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_component = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	multiply_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_component = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.cell_stability_scale }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_stability = cannibalism_modifier_component }

	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_war_support = cannibalism_field_hunger }
	divide_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_war_support = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	multiply_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_war_support = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.hunger_war_support_scale }

	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_integrity_deficit = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_integrity_deficit = cannibalism_command_integrity }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_modifier_integrity_deficit
		min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min
		max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max
	}
	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_army_organization = cannibalism_field_hunger }
	divide_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_army_organization = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	multiply_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_army_organization = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.hunger_organization_scale }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_component = cannibalism_modifier_integrity_deficit }
	divide_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_component = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	multiply_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_component = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.integrity_deficit_organization_scale }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_army_organization = cannibalism_modifier_component }

	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_supply_consumption = cannibalism_field_hunger }
	divide_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_supply_consumption = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	multiply_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_supply_consumption = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.hunger_supply_scale }

	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_planning = cannibalism_modifier_integrity_deficit }
	divide_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_planning = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	multiply_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_planning = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.integrity_deficit_planning_scale }

	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_political_power = cannibalism_cell_strength }
	divide_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_political_power = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	multiply_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_political_power = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.cell_political_power_scale }

	set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_recruitable_population = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_recruitable_population = cannibalism_cult_cohesion }
		divide_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_recruitable_population = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		multiply_variable = { cannibalism_modifier_recruitable_population = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.cult_recruitable_scale }
	}

	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_modifier_stability min = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.stability_min max = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.stability_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_modifier_war_support min = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.war_support_min max = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.war_support_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_modifier_army_organization min = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.organization_min max = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.organization_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_modifier_supply_consumption min = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.supply_min max = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.supply_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_modifier_planning min = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.planning_min max = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.planning_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_modifier_political_power min = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.political_power_min max = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.political_power_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_modifier_recruitable_population min = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.recruitable_min max = constant:cannibalism_country_penalty.recruitable_max }
	clear_variable = cannibalism_modifier_component
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_frontline_crisis } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_frontline_crisis }
	}
}

cannibalism_clear_current_state_modifier = {
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_suspected_predation_state } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_suspected_predation_state } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_compromised_garrison_state } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_compromised_garrison_state } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_hunting_ground_state } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_hunting_ground_state } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_feeding_state } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_feeding_state } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_silent_larder_state } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_silent_larder_state } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_liberated_emergency_state } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_liberated_emergency_state } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_identification_recovery_state } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_identification_recovery_state } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_institutional_recovery_state } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_institutional_recovery_state } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_long_trauma_state } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_long_trauma_state } }
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_suspected_predation
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_compromised_garrison
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_hunting_ground
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_liberated_emergency
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_identification_recovery
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_institutional_recovery
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_long_trauma
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_state_stabilized
	set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.none }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.none }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resources = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.none }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_manpower = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.none }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.none }
}

cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = {
	cannibalism_achievement_record_current_state_as_former_feeding_state = yes
	cannibalism_clear_current_state_modifier = yes
	set_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage = cannibalism_new_state_stage }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.suspected_predation } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_suspected_predation
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.suspected_supplies }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.suspected_production }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.suspected_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_suspected_predation_state }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.compromised_garrison } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_compromised_garrison
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.compromised_supplies }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.compromised_production }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_manpower = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.compromised_manpower }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.compromised_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_compromised_garrison_state }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_hunting_ground
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.hunting_supplies }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.hunting_production }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resources = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.hunting_resources }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_manpower = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.hunting_manpower }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.hunting_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_hunting_ground_state }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_state
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.feeding_supplies }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.feeding_production }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resources = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.feeding_resources }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_manpower = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.feeding_manpower }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.feeding_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_feeding_state }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.silent_larder } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_silent_larder
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.silent_supplies }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.silent_production }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resources = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.silent_resources }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_manpower = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.silent_manpower }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.silent_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_silent_larder_state }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.liberated_emergency } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_liberated_emergency
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.emergency_supplies }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.emergency_production }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_manpower = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.emergency_manpower }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.emergency_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_liberated_emergency_state }
		cannibalism_achievement_begin_supply_recovery_tracking = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.identification_recovery } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_identification_recovery
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.identification_supplies }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.identification_production }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_manpower = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.identification_manpower }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.identification_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_identification_recovery_state }

	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.institutional_recovery } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_institutional_recovery
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.institutional_supplies }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.institutional_production }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_manpower = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.institutional_manpower }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.institutional_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_institutional_recovery_state }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.long_trauma } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_long_trauma
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_supplies = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.trauma_supplies }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_production = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.trauma_production }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_manpower = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.trauma_manpower }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_state_modifier_resistance = constant:cannibalism_state_modifier.trauma_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_long_trauma_state }

	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.stabilized } }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_state_stabilized
		cannibalism_achievement_finalize_supply_recovery_tracking = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_begin_current_state_recovery = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_start_allowed = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
			cannibalism_current_node_identity_matches = yes
		}
		cannibalism_achievement_record_cell_suppression = yes
		cannibalism_retire_current_state_node = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_node_retire_result > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_start_allowed = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_start_allowed > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_recovery_states value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_recovery_states value = THIS }
		}
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.liberated_emergency }
		cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
		set_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.liberated_emergency_days }
	}
}

cannibalism_advance_current_state_recovery = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_recovery_next_date
				value = global.date
				compare = less_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		cannibalism_achievement_check_supply_recovery_tracking = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.liberated_emergency } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.identification_recovery }
			cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
			set_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = global.date }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.identification_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.identification_recovery } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.institutional_recovery }
			cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
			set_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = global.date }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.institutional_recovery_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.institutional_recovery } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.long_trauma }
			cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
			set_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = global.date }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.long_trauma_days }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.long_trauma } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.stabilized }
			cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active
			clear_variable = cannibalism_recovery_next_date
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_chaos_change
				value = 0
				compare = not_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_change = cannibalism_chaos_change }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_history_reason = cannibalism_chaos_reason }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_history_reason_custom = 1 }
		save_event_target_as = chaos_history_actor
		add_chaos_meter_value = yes
	}
}

@CANNIBALISM_POST_REVEAL_WARLORD_RESPONSE_HOURS = 3

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 WARLORD COUNTRY EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Selects coherent feeding-state origins, allocates one of eight verified fixed
# slots, accounts starting recruitment through exact Deaths-system population
# loss, configures origin identity and AI, and retires a slot only after all
# country, state, queue, callback, core, and generation references are cleared.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Candidate selection and creation context
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_select_warlord_candidate_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_found = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_best_candidate_score = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_node_states
		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_state_can_emerge_as_warlord = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_score = cannibalism_node_strength }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_component = state_population_k }
			divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_component = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.candidate_population_divisor_k }
			clamp_temp_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_warlord_candidate_component
				min = 0
				max = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.candidate_population_score_cap
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_score = cannibalism_warlord_candidate_component }
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_state_can_form_island_host = yes }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_score = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.candidate_island_bonus }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_state_can_form_siege_commune = yes }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_score = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.candidate_siege_bonus }
			}
			else = {
				add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_score = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.candidate_march_bonus }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_warlord_candidate_score
						value = cannibalism_warlord_best_candidate_score
						compare = greater_than
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_best_candidate_score = cannibalism_warlord_candidate_score }
				save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_origin_state
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_found = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# State scope. Origins are derived from geography and operational conditions;
# all eight dormant tags are origin-agnostic reusable slots.
cannibalism_prepare_warlord_creation_context = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.none }
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_state_can_form_island_host = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.island_host }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_state_can_form_siege_commune = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.siege_commune }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_state_can_form_march_host = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.march_host }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.unknown }
	if = { limit = { is_on_continent = middle_east } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.middle_east } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_on_continent = europe } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.europe } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_on_continent = asia } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.asia } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_on_continent = africa } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.africa } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_on_continent = north_america } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.north_america } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_on_continent = south_america } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.south_america } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_on_continent = australia } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.oceania } }

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_units = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.weak_units }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.weak_experience }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.weak_frenzy }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = state_population_k
				value = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.severe_population_k
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_units = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.severe_units }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.severe_experience }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.severe_frenzy }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = state_population_k
				value = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.normal_population_k
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_units = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.normal_units }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.normal_experience }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.normal_frenzy }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.chaos_meter_value
				value = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.high_chaos
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_units = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.high_chaos_units }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.high_chaos_experience }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.high_chaos_frenzy }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units min = constant:cannibalism_slot.minimum max = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.maximum_units }

	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_origin_state
	OWNER = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_former_owner }
	CONTROLLER = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_former_controller }
}

		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.middle_east } }
		random_list = {
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.middle_east_1 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.middle_east_2 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.middle_east_3 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.middle_east_4 } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.north_america } }
		random_list = {
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.north_america_1 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.north_america_2 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.north_america_3 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.north_america_4 } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_region = constant:cannibalism_region.south_america } }
		random_list = {
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.south_america_1 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.south_america_2 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.south_america_3 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.south_america_4 } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		random_list = {
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.oceania_1 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.oceania_2 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.oceania_3 } }
			1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_name_index = constant:cannibalism_warlord_name.oceania_4 } }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_assign_current_warlord_personality = {
	random_list = {
		1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.hoarder } }
		1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.feast_captain } }
		1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.charismatic_initiator } }
		1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.suspicious_tyrant } }
		1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.network_disciple } }
		1 = { set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.defiant_mouth } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.hoarder } } add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_warlord_hoarder }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.feast_captain } } add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_warlord_feast_captain }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.charismatic_initiator } } add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_warlord_charismatic_initiator }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.suspicious_tyrant } } add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_warlord_suspicious_tyrant }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_personality = constant:cannibalism_personality.network_disciple } } add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_warlord_network_disciple }
	else = { add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_warlord_defiant_mouth }
}

cannibalism_create_current_warlord_leader = {
	meta_effect = {
		text = {
			create_country_leader = {
				name = "[WARLORD_NAME]"
				picture = GFX_portrait_[WARLORD_SLOT]_warlord_[WARLORD_REGION]
				ideology = ritual_predation
			}
		}
		WARLORD_NAME = "[This.GetCannibalismWarlordName]"
		WARLORD_SLOT = "[This.GetCannibalismWarlordPortraitSlotToken]"
		WARLORD_REGION = "[This.GetCannibalismWarlordPortraitRegionToken]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.island_host } }
		add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_warlord_island_reaver
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.siege_commune } }
		add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_warlord_siege_butcher
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.march_host } }
		add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_warlord_march_predator
	}
	cannibalism_assign_current_warlord_personality = yes
}

cannibalism_prepare_current_warlord_starting_force = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_population_unit_capacity = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
	divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_population_unit_capacity = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
	divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_population_unit_capacity = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.population_per_unit_k }
	round_temp_variable = cannibalism_warlord_population_unit_capacity
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_warlord_population_unit_capacity
		min = constant:cannibalism_slot.minimum
		max = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.maximum_units
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units
				value = cannibalism_warlord_population_unit_capacity
				compare = greater_than
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_units = cannibalism_warlord_population_unit_capacity }
	}
	set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_unit_count = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_reinforcement_unit_cap = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_reinforcement_unit_cap = constant:cannibalism_unit_cap.warlord_reinforcement_batch }

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_manpower = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_manpower = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.recruitment_manpower_factor }
	round_temp_variable = cannibalism_warlord_starting_manpower
	add_manpower = cannibalism_warlord_starting_manpower

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_infantry_equipment = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_infantry_equipment = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.infantry_equipment_per_unit }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_support_equipment = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_support_equipment = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.support_equipment_per_unit }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_warlord_starting_infantry_equipment }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_warlord_starting_support_equipment }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.siege_commune } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_artillery = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_artillery = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.artillery_per_specialist }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = artillery_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_warlord_starting_artillery }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.march_host } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_motorized = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_motorized = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.motorized_per_mobile_unit }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = motorized_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_warlord_starting_motorized }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.trains_mobile_start }
		add_fuel = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.fuel_mobile_start
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.island_host } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.convoys_island_start }
	}
}

cannibalism_spawn_current_warlord_starting_units = {
	set_variable = { cannibalism_scavenger_warbands_raised = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_feast_cohorts_raised = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_bone_guard_raised = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_origin_specialists_raised = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_network_cadres_raised = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_units_raised = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_equipment_factor = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.starting_equipment_factor }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_manpower_factor = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.starting_manpower_factor }
	event_target:cannibalism_warlord_origin_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_units < 2 } }
			var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country = { set_variable = { cannibalism_scavenger_warbands_raised = 1 } }
			meta_effect = {
				text = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "name = \"Scavenger Warband\" division_template = \"Scavenger Warband\" start_experience_factor = [START_EXPERIENCE] start_equipment_factor = [START_EQUIPMENT] start_manpower_factor = [START_MANPOWER]"
						owner = var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
				START_EXPERIENCE = "[?cannibalism_warlord_starting_experience]"
				START_EQUIPMENT = "[?cannibalism_warlord_starting_equipment_factor]"
				START_MANPOWER = "[?cannibalism_warlord_starting_manpower_factor]"
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_scavenger_count = cannibalism_warlord_starting_units }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_scavenger_count = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_units > constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.specialist_unit_threshold } }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_scavenger_count = 1 }
			}
			var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country = {
				set_variable = { cannibalism_scavenger_warbands_raised = cannibalism_warlord_scavenger_count }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_feast_cohorts_raised = 1 }
			}
			meta_effect = {
				text = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "name = \"Scavenger Warband\" division_template = \"Scavenger Warband\" start_experience_factor = [START_EXPERIENCE] start_equipment_factor = [START_EQUIPMENT] start_manpower_factor = [START_MANPOWER]"
						count = cannibalism_warlord_scavenger_count
						owner = var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
					create_unit = {
						division = "name = \"Feast Guard\" division_template = \"Feast Guard\" start_experience_factor = [START_EXPERIENCE] start_equipment_factor = [START_EQUIPMENT] start_manpower_factor = [START_MANPOWER]"
						owner = var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
					}
				}
				START_EXPERIENCE = "[?cannibalism_warlord_starting_experience]"
				START_EQUIPMENT = "[?cannibalism_warlord_starting_equipment_factor]"
				START_MANPOWER = "[?cannibalism_warlord_starting_manpower_factor]"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_starting_units > constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.specialist_unit_threshold } }
				var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country = { set_variable = { cannibalism_origin_specialists_raised = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_specialist_template = cannibalism_selected_warlord_origin }
				meta_effect = {
					text = {
						cannibalism_spawn_origin_specialist_[SPECIALIST] = yes
					}
					SPECIALIST = "[?cannibalism_warlord_specialist_template|.0]"
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_current_warlord_origin_package = {
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_island_host
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_siege_commune
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_march_host
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.island_host } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_island_host
		add_ideas = cannibalism_island_host_origin
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.siege_commune } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_siege_commune
		add_ideas = cannibalism_siege_commune_origin
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.march_host } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_march_host
		add_ideas = cannibalism_march_host_origin
	}
}

cannibalism_mark_transferred_states_for_current_warlord = {
	set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count = 0 }
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_transfer_selected
			OWNER = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country }
		}
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_transfer_selected
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_formation_pending
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_state
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country.cannibalism_warlord_slot_index }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country.cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_node_source_country = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_node_source_country_generation = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country.cannibalism_actor_generation }
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country = { add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_state_stage < constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state }
			cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_setup_current_warlord_country = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_setup_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			num_of_controlled_states > 0
			has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_origin_state
			check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index > constant:cannibalism_slot.none }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_origin > constant:cannibalism_origin.none }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_event_created_warlord
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_in_use
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_decisions_open
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_character_outcome_recorded
		clear_variable = cannibalism_captured_warlord_outcome
		clear_array = cannibalism_warlord_harvested_countries
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_major_victory_count = 0 }
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_release_verified
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_release_pending
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_integration_release_pending
		clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_reuse_date
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin = cannibalism_selected_warlord_origin }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_region = cannibalism_selected_warlord_region }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin_state = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_origin_state }
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_former_owner }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_former_owner = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_owner }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_next_warlord_generation = 1 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation = global.cannibalism_next_warlord_generation }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation_entries^cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_slot_reuse_date_entries^cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = 0 }

		set_stability = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.starting_stability
		set_war_support = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.starting_war_support
		set_research_slots = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.starting_research_slots
		set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
		set_popularities = { democratic = 0 fascism = 0 communism = 0 neutrality = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_former_controller }
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_controller = {
				var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country = { inherit_technology = PREV }
			}
		}
		set_technology = {
			infantry_weapons = 1
			infantry_weapons1 = 1
			tech_support = 1
			tech_engineers = 1
			tech_recon = 1
			motorised_infantry = 1
			marines = 1
			military_police = 1
			gw_artillery = 1
			popup = no
		}

		cannibalism_register_current_country_actor = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_actor_register_result > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage = constant:cannibalism_country_stage.warlord_country }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_meter.critical }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_meter.quiet }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_meter.critical }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_meter.critical }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_warlord_start.starting_alignment }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_larder = 0 }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = cannibalism_warlord_starting_frenzy }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population = 0 }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population_k = 0 }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_last_processed_pulse_sequence = global.cannibalism_pulse_sequence }
			cannibalism_assign_current_warlord_name_index = yes
			retire_country_leader = yes
			cannibalism_create_current_warlord_leader = yes
			add_ideas = {
				cannibalism_closed_muster_rolls
				cannibalism_warlord_survival_burdens
			}
			cannibalism_apply_current_warlord_origin_package = yes
			cannibalism_create_current_warlord_templates = yes
			country_lock_all_division_template = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_origin_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.warlord_creation }
			cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied } }
				cannibalism_mark_transferred_states_for_current_warlord = yes
				cannibalism_prepare_current_warlord_starting_force = yes
				cannibalism_spawn_current_warlord_starting_units = yes
				add_army_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.starting_army_experience
				add_command_power = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.starting_command_power
				load_focus_tree = { tree = cannibalism_warlord_focus_tree keep_completed = no }
				cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
				save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_latest_actor
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete
						cannibalism_has_valid_unification_destination = yes
						NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_unification_host }
					}
					set_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
					set_country_flag = cannibalism_convergence_participant
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS } } }
						add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS }
					}
					country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.71 hours = @CANNIBALISM_POST_REVEAL_WARLORD_RESPONSE_HOURS }
				}
				cannibalism_achievement_record_warlord_formation = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_setup_result = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. If the exact population transaction cannot complete, every
# provisional state returns to its prior authority and the slot stays reserved
# until the normal reference audit verifies that the dormant tag is clean.
cannibalism_rollback_current_warlord_creation = {
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_new_country
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_actor_generation = cannibalism_actor_generation }
		cannibalism_unregister_current_country_actor = yes
	}
	cannibalism_warlord_focus_reset_contracts = yes
	remove_ideas = {
		cannibalism_closed_muster_rolls
		cannibalism_warlord_survival_burdens
		cannibalism_island_host_origin
		cannibalism_siege_commune_origin
		cannibalism_march_host_origin
		cannibalism_archipelago_hunt
		cannibalism_city_that_eats
		cannibalism_moving_front
	}
	delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Scavenger Warband" disband = no }
	delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Feast Guard" disband = no }
	delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Feast Cohort" disband = no }
	delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Bone Guard" disband = no }
	delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Island Reavers" disband = no }
	delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Siege Eaters" disband = no }
	delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "March Predation Column" disband = no }
	delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Network Cadre" disband = no }
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_transfer_selected }
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_transfer_selected
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_formation_pending
		if = {
			limit = { is_core_of = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country }
			remove_state_core = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country
		}
		if = {
			limit = { event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_controller = { exists = yes } }
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_controller = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_owner = { exists = yes } }
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_owner = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_event_created_warlord
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_decisions_open
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_island_host
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_siege_commune
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_march_host
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_release_pending
	set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count = 0 }
}

cannibalism_declare_current_warlord_origin_wars = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_former_controller
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_controller = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country } }
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_controller } }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country = { declare_war_on = { target = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_controller type = annex_everything } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_former_owner
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_owner = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country }
				NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_controller }
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_owner } }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country = { declare_war_on = { target = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_owner type = annex_everything } }
	}
}

# State scope. The selected origin and at most two connected active-node states
# transfer together; unrelated neighboring territory is never swept into a Host.
cannibalism_create_selected_warlord_country_from_current_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_creation_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_state_can_emerge_as_warlord = yes
			check_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_origin > constant:cannibalism_origin.none }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index > constant:cannibalism_slot.none }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_formation_lock_days = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.formation_lock_days }
		set_state_flag = { flag = cannibalism_warlord_formation_pending days = cannibalism_warlord_formation_lock_days }
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_transfer_selected
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_neighbor_state_count = 0 }
		var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country = {
			transfer_state = PREV
			add_state_core = PREV
		}
		every_neighbor_state = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_neighbor_state_count < constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.maximum_neighbor_states }
				is_controlled_by = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_controller
				cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes
				NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_unusable_larder = yes }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_transfer_selected }
				OR = {
					NOT = { check_variable = { cannibalism_selected_warlord_origin = constant:cannibalism_origin.island_host } }
					is_island_state = yes
					is_coastal = yes
				}
			}
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_transfer_selected
			var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country = {
				transfer_state = PREV
				add_state_core = PREV
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_neighbor_state_count = 1 }
		}
		var:cannibalism_new_warlord_country = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_new_country
			set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = cannibalism_warlord_slot_index }
			set_capital = { state = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_origin_state remember_old_capital = no }
			cannibalism_setup_current_warlord_country = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_setup_result > 0 } }
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country = { cannibalism_declare_current_warlord_origin_wars = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_former_controller }
				event_target:cannibalism_warlord_former_controller = { country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.30 } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.warlord_chaos }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_warlord }
			cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_creation_result = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country = { cannibalism_rollback_current_warlord_creation = yes }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_allocate_slot_cba = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cba }
	set_global_flag = cannibalism_slot_cba_in_use
	CBA = {
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_warlord_country = THIS }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cba }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_release_pending
	}
	cannibalism_create_selected_warlord_country_from_current_state = yes
}
