cannibalism_allocate_warlord_slot_for_current_state = {
	if = { limit = { cannibalism_slot_cba_available = yes } cannibalism_allocate_slot_cba = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { cannibalism_slot_cbb_available = yes } cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbb = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { cannibalism_slot_cbc_available = yes } cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbc = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { cannibalism_slot_cbd_available = yes } cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbd = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { cannibalism_slot_cbe_available = yes } cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbe = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { cannibalism_slot_cbf_available = yes } cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbf = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { cannibalism_slot_cbg_available = yes } cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbg = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { cannibalism_slot_cbh_available = yes } cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbh = yes }
}

cannibalism_try_form_warlord_country = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active }
			cannibalism_has_free_warlord_slot = yes
		}
		cannibalism_select_warlord_candidate_state = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_candidate_found > 0 }
				has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_origin_state
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_origin_state = {
				cannibalism_prepare_warlord_creation_context = yes
				cannibalism_allocate_warlord_slot_for_current_state = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reusable-slot retirement and reference quarantine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Country scope. Rows are invalidated through the canonical ID-safe API and
# remain tombstones until the normal reverse compactor runs.
cannibalism_remove_current_country_from_spread_ledger = {
	cannibalism_invalidate_spread_entries_for_current_country_lifecycle = yes
}

# State scope. A defeated Host's cells enter the full liberation-recovery
# sequence before their slot/core/source references are cleared.
cannibalism_retire_current_state_from_warlord_slot = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_node_source_country
				value = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_release_country
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_id
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_generation
				is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_node_states value = THIS }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_node_id = cannibalism_node_id }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_node_generation = cannibalism_node_generation }
			cannibalism_begin_current_state_recovery = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_node_states value = THIS } }
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_node_states value = THIS }
			}
			clear_variable = cannibalism_node_id
			clear_variable = cannibalism_node_generation
			clear_variable = cannibalism_node_type
			clear_variable = cannibalism_node_strength
			clear_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country
			clear_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country_generation
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_recovery_states value = THIS } } }
					add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_recovery_states value = THIS }
				}
				set_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.liberated_emergency }
				cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
				set_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = global.date }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.liberated_emergency_days }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_core_of = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_release_country }
		remove_state_core = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_release_country
	}
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_state
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_transfer_selected
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_formation_pending
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_commune_state
	clr_state_flag = cannibalism_network_node
	clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_index
	clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation
}

# Country scope. Called from the annexed reusable tag after pulse rehoming.
cannibalism_begin_current_warlord_slot_release = {
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
			is_cannibalism_reusable_warlord_slot_country = yes
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_in_use
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_release_country
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_release_pending
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_integration_release_pending
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_decisions_open
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_containment_decisions_open
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_seeding_active
		cannibalism_warlord_focus_reset_contracts = yes
		cannibalism_remove_current_country_from_spread_ledger = yes
		cannibalism_reset_current_country_incarnation_state = yes
		remove_ideas = {
			cannibalism_closed_muster_rolls
			cannibalism_warlord_survival_burdens
			cannibalism_island_host_origin
			cannibalism_siege_commune_origin
			cannibalism_march_host_origin
			cannibalism_archipelago_hunt
			cannibalism_city_that_eats
			cannibalism_moving_front
		}
		delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Scavenger Warband" disband = no }
		delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Feast Guard" disband = no }
		delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Feast Cohort" disband = no }
		delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Bone Guard" disband = no }
		delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Island Reavers" disband = no }
		delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Siege Eaters" disband = no }
		delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "March Predation Column" disband = no }
		delete_unit_template_and_units = { division_template = "Network Cadre" disband = no }
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS } }
			remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_event_target = cannibalism_latest_actor
				event_target:cannibalism_latest_actor = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_release_country }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_latest_actor
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor
				event_target:cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_release_country }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor
			clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_i_mtth_actor_generation
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor
				event_target:cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_release_country }
			}
			clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor
			clear_variable = global.cannibalism_evolution_ii_mtth_actor_generation
		}
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					is_core_of = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_release_country
					AND = {
						has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country
						check_variable = {
							var = cannibalism_node_source_country
							value = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_release_country
							compare = equals
						}
					}
				}
			}
			cannibalism_retire_current_state_from_warlord_slot = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_actor_generation = cannibalism_actor_generation }
			cannibalism_unregister_current_country_actor = yes
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_frontline_crisis } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_frontline_crisis } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_emergency_logistics_burden } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_emergency_logistics_burden } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_formation_screening_burden } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_formation_screening_burden } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_terror_battalion_deployed } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_terror_battalion_deployed } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_synchronized_warlord_attack } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_synchronized_warlord_attack } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_island_convoy_ambush_operation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_island_convoy_ambush_operation } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_siege_relief_ambush_operation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_siege_relief_ambush_operation } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_march_supply_raid_operation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_march_supply_raid_operation } }
	}
}

cannibalism_finalize_current_warlord_slot_release = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_release_pending
			cannibalism_current_warlord_slot_references_are_clear = yes
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_reuse_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_reuse_date = constant:cannibalism_warlord_creation.reuse_quarantine_days }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_warlord_slot_reuse_date_entries^cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = cannibalism_warlord_slot_reuse_date }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cba } } clr_global_flag = cannibalism_slot_cba_in_use }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbb } } clr_global_flag = cannibalism_slot_cbb_in_use }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbc } } clr_global_flag = cannibalism_slot_cbc_in_use }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbd } } clr_global_flag = cannibalism_slot_cbd_in_use }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbe } } clr_global_flag = cannibalism_slot_cbe_in_use }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbf } } clr_global_flag = cannibalism_slot_cbf_in_use }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbg } } clr_global_flag = cannibalism_slot_cbg_in_use }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbh } } clr_global_flag = cannibalism_slot_cbh_in_use }
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_in_use
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_release_pending
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_integration_release_pending
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_event_created_warlord
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_island_host
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_siege_commune
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_march_host
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_slot_release_verified
		clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count
	}
}

cannibalism_process_warlord_slot_release_queue = {
	CBA = { cannibalism_finalize_current_warlord_slot_release = yes }
	CBB = { cannibalism_finalize_current_warlord_slot_release = yes }
	CBC = { cannibalism_finalize_current_warlord_slot_release = yes }
	CBD = { cannibalism_finalize_current_warlord_slot_release = yes }
	CBE = { cannibalism_finalize_current_warlord_slot_release = yes }
	CBF = { cannibalism_finalize_current_warlord_slot_release = yes }
	CBG = { cannibalism_finalize_current_warlord_slot_release = yes }
	CBH = { cannibalism_finalize_current_warlord_slot_release = yes }
}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost_negative = cannibalism_current_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost_negative = -1 }
	add_manpower = cannibalism_current_cost_negative
}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_decision_cost.ration_audit_manpower }
	cannibalism_pay_current_manpower_cost = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_decision_cost.ration_audit_support }
	cannibalism_pay_current_support_equipment_cost = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_decision_cost.ration_audit_command }
	cannibalism_pay_current_command_cost = yes
	if = {
		limit = { var:cannibalism_primary_theater_state = { is_island_state = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_decision_cost.ration_audit_convoys }
		cannibalism_pay_current_convoy_cost = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_decision_cost.ration_audit_trains }
		cannibalism_pay_current_train_cost = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_start_restore_supply_corridor = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_containment_decisions_visible = yes
			cannibalism_has_valid_primary_theater = yes
			cannibalism_can_pay_logistics_cost = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_logistics_mission_active }
		}
		cannibalism_pay_logistics_cost = yes
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_logistics_mission_active
		set_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_hold_days = 0 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_hold_base_days }
		var:cannibalism_primary_theater_state = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_island_state = yes }
				ROOT = { add_to_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_island_add_days } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { is_coastal = yes }
				ROOT = { add_to_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_coastal_add_days } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { infrastructure < constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_low_infrastructure_threshold }
				ROOT = { add_to_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_low_infrastructure_add_days } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger > constant:cannibalism_meter.severe } }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_severe_hunger_add_days }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = cannibalism_primary_theater_state
				var:cannibalism_primary_theater_state = { cannibalism_state_has_external_hunger_pressure = yes }
			}
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_integration.logistics_shortage_add_days }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = cannibalism_primary_theater_state
				var:cannibalism_primary_theater_state = { cannibalism_state_has_severe_external_hunger_pressure = yes }
			}
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_integration.logistics_severe_shortage_add_days }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_open_emergency }
			subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_open_response_reduction_days }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days min = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_minimum_days max = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_maximum_days }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_mission_duration = cannibalism_logistics_required_hold_days }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_mission_duration = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.logistics_timeout_buffer_days }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_division_floor = 0 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_emergency_logistics_burden }
		activate_mission = cannibalism_restore_supply_corridor_mission
	}
}

cannibalism_start_rotate_compromised_formations = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_containment_decisions_visible = yes
			cannibalism_has_valid_primary_theater = yes
			cannibalism_can_pay_rotation_cost = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_rotation_mission_active }
		}
		cannibalism_pay_rotation_cost = yes
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_rotation_mission_active
		set_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_hold_days = 0 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.rotation_hold_base_days }
		if = {
			limit = { has_war = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.rotation_war_add_days }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength > constant:cannibalism_meter.severe } }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.rotation_severe_cell_add_days }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity > constant:cannibalism_meter.active } }
			subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.rotation_high_integrity_reduction_days }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_rotation_required_hold_days min = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.rotation_minimum_days max = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.rotation_maximum_days }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_mission_duration = cannibalism_rotation_required_hold_days }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_mission_duration = constant:cannibalism_decision_timing.rotation_timeout_buffer_days }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_division_floor = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.rotation_division_base }
		if = {
			limit = { num_divisions > constant:cannibalism_decision_result.rotation_medium_army_threshold }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_division_floor = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.rotation_division_medium }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { num_divisions > constant:cannibalism_decision_result.rotation_large_army_threshold }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_division_floor = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.rotation_division_large }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_division_floor = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.objective_comparison_offset }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_formation_screening_burden }
		activate_mission = cannibalism_rotate_compromised_formations_mission
	}
}

cannibalism_process_current_country_mission_objectives = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_logistics_mission_active }
		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_logistics_objective_secured = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_hold_days = global.cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_interval_days }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { cannibalism_logistics_hold_days = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_rotation_mission_active }
		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_rotation_objective_secured = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_hold_days = global.cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_interval_days }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { cannibalism_rotation_hold_days = 0 } }
	}
}

cannibalism_resolve_ration_audit = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_can_pay_ration_audit_cost = yes }
		cannibalism_pay_ration_audit_cost = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_audit_success_weight = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_success_base }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_open_emergency }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_audit_success_weight = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_open_bonus }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_concealment }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_audit_success_weight = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_concealment_penalty }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity < constant:cannibalism_meter.guarded } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_audit_success_weight = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_low_integrity_penalty }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cannibalism_audit_success_weight min = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_weight_min max = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_weight_max }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_audit_failure_weight = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.chance_total }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_audit_failure_weight = cannibalism_audit_success_weight }
		random_list = {
			cannibalism_audit_success_weight = {
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_evidence = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_success_evidence }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_success_hunger }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_success_integrity }
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_ration_records_recovered
			}
			cannibalism_audit_failure_weight = {
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_failure_integrity }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_decision_result.audit_failure_cell }
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_ration_records_destroyed
			}
		}
		cannibalism_clamp_current_country_evidence = yes
		cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
		cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
		cannibalism_record_investigation_operation = yes
	}
}

	subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_focus_closure_larder_cost }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_larder
		min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min
		max = constant:cannibalism_unification.global_larder_maximum
	}
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_larder = cannibalism_larder }
}

	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_focus_closure_negative_cost = -1 }
	add_fuel = cannibalism_focus_closure_negative_cost
}

cannibalism_wendigo_start_terminal_hunt = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_start_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_target
			cannibalism_wendigo_can_pay_terminal_hunt_launch_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_target = { cannibalism_wendigo_is_valid_terminal_hunt_target = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_focus_closure_larder_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.launch_larder }
		cannibalism_pay_focus_closure_larder_cost = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.launch_command }
		cannibalism_pay_current_command_cost = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.launch_infantry }
		cannibalism_pay_current_infantry_equipment_cost = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.launch_support }
		cannibalism_pay_current_support_equipment_cost = yes

		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_target = {
			save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_defender
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target_lock_days = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.target_lock_days }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target_lock days = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target_lock_days }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_active
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_press_cooldown
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_hunt_pressure_applied
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_pressure = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.starting_pressure }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_counterpressure = 0 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_start_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_due_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_due_date = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.mission_days }
		activate_mission = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_mission
		add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_high }
		add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_high }
		add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_high }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_start_result = 1 }
	}
}

			clamp_variable = {

				min = 0

			}
		}
		cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_break_result = 1 }

cannibalism_clear_wendigo_terminal_hunt_runtime = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_remove_mission > 0 } }
		remove_mission = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_mission
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target }
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target = {
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_defender
			if = {
				limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_clear_target_lock > 0 } } }
				clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target_lock
			}
		}
	}
	clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_active
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_press_cooldown
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_hunt_pressure_applied
	clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_pressure
	clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_counterpressure
	clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_start_date
	clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_due_date
}

cannibalism_resolve_wendigo_terminal_hunt_success = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_has_succeeded = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunts_completed } }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunts_completed = 0 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunts_completed = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.success_progress }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress
			min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_min
			max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_max
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_launch_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.success_cooldown_days }
		set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_launch_cooldown days = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_launch_cooldown_days }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_remove_mission = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_clear_target_lock = 0 }
		cannibalism_clear_wendigo_terminal_hunt_runtime = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_resolve_wendigo_terminal_hunt_failure = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_active }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunts_failed } }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunts_failed = 0 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunts_failed = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.failure_progress }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress
			min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_min
			max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_max
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_launch_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.failure_cooldown_days }
		set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_launch_cooldown days = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_launch_cooldown_days }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_remove_mission = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_clear_target_lock = 0 }
		cannibalism_clear_wendigo_terminal_hunt_runtime = yes
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bounded enemy-loss receipts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_clear_current_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_epoch = {
	clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_casualties_snapshot
	clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_remainder
	clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts_issued
}

cannibalism_initialize_wendigo_enemy_receipt_epoch_for_target = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_epoch_target
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_epoch_target = {
				exists = yes
				has_war_with = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor
				cannibalism_target_country_is_ordinary_human_target = yes
			}
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_epoch_target = {
			cannibalism_clear_current_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_epoch = yes
			set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_casualties_snapshot = casualties }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_remainder = 0 }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts_issued = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						is_in_array = {
							array = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor.cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_tracked_countries
							value = THIS
						}
					}
				}
				event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor = {
					add_to_array = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_tracked_countries = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_epoch_target }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_prune_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_registry = {
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_wendigo_active_receipt_enemy_countries
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_tracked_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_war_with = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor
			}
			add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_wendigo_active_receipt_enemy_countries = THIS }
		}
		else = {
			cannibalism_clear_current_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_epoch = yes
		}
	}
	resize_array = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_tracked_countries = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cannibalism_wendigo_active_receipt_enemy_countries
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor = {
			add_to_array = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_tracked_countries = PREV }
		}
	}
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_wendigo_active_receipt_enemy_countries
}

cannibalism_clear_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_registry = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_tracked_countries
		cannibalism_clear_current_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_epoch = yes
	}
	resize_array = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_tracked_countries = 0 }
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_wendigo_active_receipt_enemy_countries
}

cannibalism_initialize_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts = {
	cannibalism_clear_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_registry = yes
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts_open
	set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts = 0 }
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor
	every_enemy_country = {
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_epoch_target
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor = { cannibalism_initialize_wendigo_enemy_receipt_epoch_for_target = yes }
	}
}

cannibalism_process_current_wendigo_enemy_death_delta = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_current_casualties = casualties }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_casualties_snapshot } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_casualties_snapshot = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_current_casualties }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_remainder = 0 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts_issued = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_current_casualties
				value = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_casualties_snapshot
				compare = less_than
			}
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_casualties_snapshot = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_current_casualties }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_remainder = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_new_casualties = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_current_casualties }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_new_casualties = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_casualties_snapshot }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_casualties_snapshot = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_current_casualties }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_new_casualties > 0 } }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_remainder = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_new_casualties }
		}
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_remainder
					value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.casualties_per_receipt
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts_issued
					value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.per_enemy_cap
					compare = less_than
				}
				event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts
						value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.pool_cap
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_remainder = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.casualties_per_receipt }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts_issued = 1 }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor = { add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_process_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_wendigo_can_process_enemy_death_receipts = yes }
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor
		cannibalism_prune_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_registry = yes
		every_enemy_country = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_epoch_target
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor.cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_tracked_countries
						value = THIS
					}
				}
				cannibalism_process_current_wendigo_enemy_death_delta = yes
			}
			else = {
				event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor = { cannibalism_initialize_wendigo_enemy_receipt_epoch_for_target = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_clear_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_runtime = {
	cannibalism_clear_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_registry = yes
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts_open
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_muster_open
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_muster_cooldown
	clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts
}

cannibalism_handle_wendigo_receipt_war_relation_added = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_wendigo_can_process_enemy_death_receipts = yes
			FROM = { cannibalism_target_country_is_ordinary_human_target = yes }
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor
		FROM = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_epoch_target }
		cannibalism_initialize_wendigo_enemy_receipt_epoch_for_target = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			FROM = { cannibalism_wendigo_can_process_enemy_death_receipts = yes }
			cannibalism_target_country_is_ordinary_human_target = yes
		}
		FROM = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor }
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_epoch_target
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_actor = { cannibalism_initialize_wendigo_enemy_receipt_epoch_for_target = yes }
	}
}

cannibalism_muster_wendigo_pack_from_enemy_death_receipt_effect = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_muster_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_requested_pack_batch = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_pack_batch }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state
			cannibalism_wendigo_can_pay_enemy_death_receipt_muster = yes
			cannibalism_wendigo_requested_pack_batch_fits_capacity = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { cannibalism_state_can_muster_wendigo_pack_from_enemy_death_receipt = yes }
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_actor
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.recruitment }
		cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_population_loss_applied
					value = cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_receipt_cost }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_focus_closure_larder_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_larder }
			cannibalism_pay_focus_closure_larder_cost = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_infantry }
			cannibalism_pay_current_infantry_equipment_cost = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_support }
			cannibalism_pay_current_support_equipment_cost = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_manpower = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_manpower = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_manpower_factor }
			round_temp_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_manpower
			add_manpower = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_manpower
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_batch = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_pack_batch }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { cannibalism_spawn_empty_wendigo_pack_batch = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_trained_pack_count = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_pack_batch }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_state_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.recruitment_state_cooldown_days }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = {
				set_state_flag = { flag = cannibalism_recruitment_cooldown days = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_state_cooldown_days }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_muster_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt.muster_cooldown_days }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_muster_cooldown days = cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_muster_cooldown_days }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_receipt_muster_result = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = 0 }
	}
}

cannibalism_wendigo_apply_pack_stage_drilled = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_template = "Wendigo Pack" NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_stage_drilled } }
		add_units_to_division_template = { template_name = "Wendigo Pack" support = { recon = 0 } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_stage_drilled
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Inherited commander stages
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_wendigo_bind_inherited_warlord_captains = {
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_captain_stage_bound
	every_army_leader = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = cannibalism_host_commander
				has_trait = cannibalism_bound_servant
			}
			NOT = { is_character = ZZZ_hannibal_wendigo }
			NOT = { has_trait = cannibalism_wendigo_bound_captain }
			NOT = { has_trait = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_hunt_captain }
		}
		add_unit_leader_trait = cannibalism_wendigo_bound_captain
	}
	cannibalism_wendigo_refresh_inherited_commander_stage = yes
}

cannibalism_wendigo_refresh_inherited_commander_stage = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_captain_stage_winter_hunt
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_victories
				value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.minimum_winter_victories
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		every_army_leader = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_trait = cannibalism_host_commander
					has_trait = cannibalism_bound_servant
				}
				NOT = { is_character = ZZZ_hannibal_wendigo }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_trait = cannibalism_wendigo_bound_captain } remove_unit_leader_trait = cannibalism_wendigo_bound_captain }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_hunt_captain } } add_unit_leader_trait = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_hunt_captain }
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paid inherited winter-cell operation and bounded cleanup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_activate_inherited_winter_cell_effect = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_target
			cannibalism_wendigo_can_pay_inherited_cell_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_target = { cannibalism_wendigo_is_valid_inherited_cell_target = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_focus_closure_larder_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell.larder }
		cannibalism_pay_focus_closure_larder_cost = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell.command }
		cannibalism_pay_current_command_cost = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell.support }
		cannibalism_pay_current_support_equipment_cost = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_duration_days = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell.duration_days }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_target_lock_days = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell.target_lock_days }
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_target = {
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_pressure days = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_duration_days }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_target days = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_duration_days }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_target_lock days = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_target_lock_days }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = ROOT.cannibalism_wendigo_active_cell_targets value = THIS } } }
				ROOT = { add_to_array = { cannibalism_wendigo_active_cell_targets = PREV } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_active
				NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_hunt_pressure_applied }
				has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target
				event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_target = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_target }
			}
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_pressure = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell.hunt_pressure }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_pressure
				min = 0
				max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt.pressure_goal
			}
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_hunt_pressure_applied
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_clear_wendigo_inherited_cell_runtime = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cannibalism_wendigo_active_cell_targets
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_pressure
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_target
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_target_lock
		}
	}
	resize_array = { cannibalism_wendigo_active_cell_targets = 0 }
}

# External lifecycle cleanup. Structural Pack/origin upgrades, inherited
# commander traits, already paid units, and population/Larder history remain.
cannibalism_clear_wendigo_prelock_operation_runtime = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_remove_mission = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_clear_target_lock = 1 }
	cannibalism_clear_wendigo_terminal_hunt_runtime = yes
	cannibalism_clear_wendigo_inherited_cell_runtime = yes
	cannibalism_clear_wendigo_enemy_death_receipt_runtime = yes
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_launch_cooldown
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_press_cooldown
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_open
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_inherited_cell_operations_open
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_training_open
}

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source section: 014_cannibalism_gui_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 SCRIPTED GUI EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Player-only view builders for the Evolution II network ledger. They copy
# already-registered actor and node scopes into country-scoped view arrays,
# preserving gameplay ownership in the core ledger and decision systems.
# No gameplay cost, population transaction, cooldown, or AI action lives here.
# ============================================================================

@cannibalism_gui_loop_zero = 0
@cannibalism_gui_loop_one = 1

cannibalism_gui_append_current_country_to_view_if_valid = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_gui_country_matches_selected_tab = yes }
		ROOT = { add_to_array = { cannibalism_network_gui_country_entries = PREV } }
	}
}

cannibalism_gui_append_current_state_to_view_if_valid = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_gui_state_matches_selected_tab = yes }
		ROOT = { add_to_array = { cannibalism_network_gui_state_entries = PREV } }
	}
}

cannibalism_gui_rebuild_network_view = {
	clear_array = cannibalism_network_gui_country_entries
	clear_array = cannibalism_network_gui_state_entries
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_sort = constant:cannibalism_gui_sort.newest_first }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_reverse_index = global.cannibalism_actor_countries^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_reverse_index = constant:cannibalism_gui_value.one }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = @cannibalism_gui_loop_zero
			end = global.cannibalism_actor_countries^num
			add = @cannibalism_gui_loop_one
			value = cannibalism_network_gui_loop_index
			var:global.cannibalism_actor_countries^cannibalism_network_gui_reverse_index = {
				cannibalism_gui_append_current_country_to_view_if_valid = yes
			}
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_reverse_index = constant:cannibalism_gui_value.one }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_reverse_index = global.cannibalism_node_states^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_reverse_index = constant:cannibalism_gui_value.one }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = @cannibalism_gui_loop_zero
			end = global.cannibalism_node_states^num
			add = @cannibalism_gui_loop_one
			value = cannibalism_network_gui_loop_index
			var:global.cannibalism_node_states^cannibalism_network_gui_reverse_index = {
				cannibalism_gui_append_current_state_to_view_if_valid = yes
			}
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_reverse_index = constant:cannibalism_gui_value.one }
		}
	}
	else = {
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
			cannibalism_gui_append_current_country_to_view_if_valid = yes
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_node_states
			cannibalism_gui_append_current_state_to_view_if_valid = yes
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_dirty = constant:cannibalism_gui_value.one }
}

cannibalism_gui_open_network_view = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_network_gui_tab } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_tab = constant:cannibalism_gui_tab.domestic_cells }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_network_gui_sort } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_sort = constant:cannibalism_gui_sort.oldest_first }
	}
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_network_gui_open
	cannibalism_gui_rebuild_network_view = yes
}

cannibalism_gui_close_network_view = {
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_network_gui_open
	clear_array = cannibalism_network_gui_country_entries
	clear_array = cannibalism_network_gui_state_entries
	clear_variable = cannibalism_network_gui_selected_country
	clear_variable = cannibalism_network_gui_selected_state
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_dirty = constant:cannibalism_gui_value.one }
}

cannibalism_gui_toggle_network_sort = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_sort = constant:cannibalism_gui_sort.newest_first } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_sort = constant:cannibalism_gui_sort.oldest_first }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_sort = constant:cannibalism_gui_sort.newest_first }
	}
	cannibalism_gui_rebuild_network_view = yes
}

cannibalism_gui_select_country_entry = {
	set_variable = {
		cannibalism_network_gui_selected_country = cannibalism_network_gui_country_entries^cannibalism_network_gui_country_index
	}
	clear_variable = cannibalism_network_gui_selected_state
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_dirty = constant:cannibalism_gui_value.one }
}

cannibalism_gui_select_state_entry = {
	set_variable = {
		cannibalism_network_gui_selected_state = cannibalism_network_gui_state_entries^cannibalism_network_gui_state_index
	}
	clear_variable = cannibalism_network_gui_selected_country
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_dirty = constant:cannibalism_gui_value.one }
}

cannibalism_gui_toggle_animations = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_gui_animations_disabled }
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_gui_animations_disabled
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_gui_animations_disabled
	}
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_gui_dirty = constant:cannibalism_gui_value.one }
}

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source section: 014_cannibalism_integration_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 CROSS-EVENT INTEGRATION EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Applies shortage pressure, routes Event 14 relief into the existing disaster
# and famine systems, damages cells exposed to contamination, and maintains the
# explicit exploitation/protection lifecycle for detention sites.
# ============================================================================

cannibalism_apply_external_pressure_to_current_actor = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_country_has_external_hunger_pressure = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_integration.weekly_shortage_hunger }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_external_shortage_pressure_active
	}
	else = { clr_country_flag = cannibalism_external_shortage_pressure_active }
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_country_has_severe_external_hunger_pressure = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_integration.weekly_severe_shortage_hunger }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_external_shortage_pressure_severe
	}
	else = { clr_country_flag = cannibalism_external_shortage_pressure_severe }
}

cannibalism_process_current_state_contamination_against_cell = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes
			cannibalism_state_has_any_larder_contamination = yes
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage_cooldown }
			CONTROLLER = {
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes
						has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_locked
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_contamination_evidence_gain = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = nuclear_fallout_state } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage = constant:cannibalism_integration.fallout_cell_damage }
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_cell_exposed_to_fallout
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_state_has_bioweapon_contamination = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage = constant:cannibalism_integration.biological_cell_damage }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_contamination_evidence_gain = constant:cannibalism_integration.biological_evidence_gain }
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_cell_exposed_to_biological_attack
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_state_has_chemical_contamination = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage = constant:cannibalism_integration.chemical_cell_damage }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_contamination_evidence_gain = constant:cannibalism_integration.chemical_evidence_gain }
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_cell_exposed_to_chemical_attack
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_node_strength }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_node_strength = cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_node_strength min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		}
		CONTROLLER = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_cannibalism_active_country = yes }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_evidence = cannibalism_contamination_evidence_gain }
				cannibalism_clamp_current_country_evidence = yes
				cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage_days = constant:cannibalism_integration.contamination_cell_damage_cooldown_days }
		set_state_flag = { flag = cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage_cooldown days = cannibalism_contamination_cell_damage_days }
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_shared_relief_to_current_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = natural_disaster_aftermath_active }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_phase = constant:natural_disaster_phase.early_rescue } }
			add_to_variable = { natural_disaster_rescue_score = constant:cannibalism_integration.shared_relief_score }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_phase = constant:natural_disaster_phase.middle_stabilization } }
			add_to_variable = { natural_disaster_stabilization_score = constant:cannibalism_integration.shared_relief_score }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_phase = constant:natural_disaster_phase.late_reconstruction } }
			add_to_variable = { natural_disaster_reconstruction_score = constant:cannibalism_integration.shared_relief_score }
		}
		clr_state_flag = natural_disaster_famine_pressure
		clr_state_flag = natural_disaster_supply_collapse
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_shared_relief_days = constant:cannibalism_integration.shared_relief_days }
		set_state_flag = { flag = natural_disaster_inbound_relief_arrived days = cannibalism_shared_relief_days }
		set_state_flag = { flag = cannibalism_shared_relief_delivered days = cannibalism_shared_relief_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
			has_state_flag = genocide_soviet_famine_pressure_site
			has_state_flag = camp_rework_soviet_famine_pressure
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = sov_famine_pressure_state }
			}
		}
		OWNER = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { famine_pressure > 0 } }
				add_to_variable = { famine_pressure = constant:cannibalism_integration.shared_relief_famine_reduction }
				clamp_variable = { var = famine_pressure min = 0 max = constant:camp_rework_threshold.max_value }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_shared_relief_days = constant:cannibalism_integration.shared_relief_days }
		set_state_flag = { flag = cannibalism_shared_relief_delivered days = cannibalism_shared_relief_days }
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_shared_medical_protection_to_current_state = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_state_flag = natural_disaster_aftermath_active
			has_state_flag = natural_disaster_disease_pressure
		}
		clr_state_flag = natural_disaster_disease_pressure
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_phase = constant:natural_disaster_phase.early_rescue } }
			add_to_variable = { natural_disaster_rescue_score = constant:cannibalism_integration.shared_relief_score }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { natural_disaster_phase = constant:natural_disaster_phase.middle_stabilization } }
			add_to_variable = { natural_disaster_stabilization_score = constant:cannibalism_integration.shared_relief_score }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_shared_relief_days = constant:cannibalism_integration.shared_relief_days }
		set_state_flag = { flag = natural_disaster_foreign_medical_mission days = cannibalism_shared_relief_days }
		set_state_flag = { flag = cannibalism_shared_medical_protection days = cannibalism_shared_relief_days }
	}
}

cannibalism_record_detention_exploitation_links = {
	every_controlled_state = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_state_has_prison_or_camp = yes
			cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_program_link }
		}
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_program_link
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_prisoners_abandoned_to_cell
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_node_strength }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_integration.camp_link_cell_gain }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_node_strength min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_country_has_active_detention_exploitation_link = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_integration.camp_link_cell_gain }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_integration.camp_link_cult_gain }
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_evidence = constant:cannibalism_integration.camp_link_evidence_gain }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_detention_exploitation_active
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_detention_exploitation_occurred
	}
}

cannibalism_protect_detention_sites_from_current_policy = {
	every_controlled_state = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_state_has_prison_or_camp = yes
			OR = {
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_program_link
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_prisoners_abandoned_to_cell
			}
		}
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_feeding_program_link
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_prisoners_abandoned_to_cell
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_prisoners_under_protected_custody
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_node_strength }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_integration.camp_protection_cell_damage }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_node_strength min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		}
	}
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_detention_exploitation_active
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_integration.camp_protection_integrity_gain }
}

cannibalism_expose_detention_exploitation_in_current_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_country_has_active_detention_exploitation_link = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_evidence = constant:cannibalism_integration.camp_exposure_evidence_gain }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_feeding_program_exposed
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_clean_route_disqualified
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_feeding_program_exposed_abroad
		cannibalism_clamp_current_country_evidence = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_log_mixed_prisoner_feeding_deaths = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prisoner_military_deaths = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prisoner_military_deaths = constant:cannibalism_integration.prisoner_feeding_military_share }
	round_temp_variable = cannibalism_prisoner_military_deaths
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prisoner_civilian_deaths = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prisoner_civilian_deaths = cannibalism_prisoner_military_deaths }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prisoner_civilian_deaths > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = cannibalism_prisoner_civilian_deaths }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.cannibalism_consumption }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_is_civilian = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_apply_state_pop = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_target_country = event_target:cannibalism_consumption_actor }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_has_target_country = 1 }
		chaos_meter_register_deaths = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prisoner_military_deaths > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_change = cannibalism_prisoner_military_deaths }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_reason = constant:chaos_meter_deaths_reason.cannibalism_consumption }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_is_civilian = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_apply_state_pop = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_target_country = event_target:cannibalism_consumption_actor }
		set_temp_variable = { chaos_deaths_has_target_country = 1 }
		chaos_meter_register_deaths = yes
	}
}

			cannibalism_clamp_current_country_evidence = yes

cannibalism_register_current_country_objective_observer = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries value = THIS } }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_objective_countries value = THIS } }
		}
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_objective_countries value = THIS }
	}
}

cannibalism_unregister_current_country_objective_observer_if_idle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { cannibalism_current_country_has_active_maintained_objective = yes }
			is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_objective_countries value = THIS }
		}
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_objective_countries value = THIS }
	}
}

cannibalism_start_investigation_mission = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_containment_decisions_visible = yes
			cannibalism_has_valid_primary_theater = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_mission_active }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_objective_resolved }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_mission_active
		set_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_target_state = cannibalism_primary_theater_state }
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_target_has_node_identity
		clear_variable = cannibalism_investigation_target_node_id
		clear_variable = cannibalism_investigation_target_node_generation
		var:cannibalism_investigation_target_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
					has_variable = cannibalism_node_id
					has_variable = cannibalism_node_generation
				}
				ROOT = {
					set_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_target_has_node_identity
					set_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_target_node_id = PREV.cannibalism_node_id }
					set_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_target_node_generation = PREV.cannibalism_node_generation }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_progress = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_goal = constant:cannibalism_objective_progress.investigation_goal }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.investigation_base_days }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_active }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.investigation_evolution_add_days }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength > constant:cannibalism_meter.severe } }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.investigation_severe_cell_add_days }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_policy_open_emergency }
			subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.investigation_open_response_reduction_days }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_investigation_duration min = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.investigation_minimum_days max = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.investigation_maximum_days }
		activate_mission = cannibalism_investigation_mission
	}
}

cannibalism_record_investigation_operation = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_mission_active } }
		cannibalism_start_investigation_mission = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_mission_active
			cannibalism_investigation_target_is_valid = yes
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_investigation_progress = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.one }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_investigation_progress min = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero max = cannibalism_investigation_goal }
	}
}

cannibalism_start_hold_prison_mission = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_containment_decisions_visible = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_hold_prison_mission_active }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_hold_prison_objective_resolved }
		}
		random_controlled_state = {
			limit = {
				impassable = no
				cannibalism_state_has_prison_or_camp = yes
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_id
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_generation
			}
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_prison_objective_state
			ROOT = {
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_hold_prison_mission_active
				set_variable = { cannibalism_prison_target_state = event_target:cannibalism_prison_objective_state }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_prison_target_node_id = event_target:cannibalism_prison_objective_state.cannibalism_node_id }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_prison_target_node_generation = event_target:cannibalism_prison_objective_state.cannibalism_node_generation }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_prison_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_prison_required_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_objective_progress.prison_goal_days }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_prison_division_floor = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_prison_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.prison_base_days }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength > constant:cannibalism_meter.severe } }
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_prison_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.prison_severe_cell_add_days }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { event_target:cannibalism_prison_objective_state = { OR = { is_island_state = yes NOT = { is_in_home_area = yes } } } }
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_prison_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.prison_isolated_add_days }
				}
				clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_prison_duration min = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.prison_minimum_days max = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.prison_maximum_days }
				activate_mission = cannibalism_hold_prison_mission
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_start_reach_island_mission = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_reach_island_mission_active }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_objective_country_target
			event_target:cannibalism_objective_country_target = { cannibalism_is_valid_silent_island_recon_target = yes }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_reach_island_mission_active
		set_variable = { cannibalism_reach_island_target_country = event_target:cannibalism_objective_country_target }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_reach_island_target_generation = event_target:cannibalism_objective_country_target.cannibalism_actor_generation }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_reach_island_progress = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_reach_island_goal = constant:cannibalism_objective_progress.island_goal }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_reach_island_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.island_base_days }
		if = {
			limit = { event_target:cannibalism_objective_country_target = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_island_host_under_blockade } }
			subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_reach_island_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.island_blockade_reduction_days }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { event_target:cannibalism_objective_country_target = { num_of_controlled_states > constant:cannibalism_objective_progress.large_island_host_state_threshold } }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_reach_island_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.island_large_host_add_days }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_reach_island_duration min = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.island_minimum_days max = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.island_maximum_days }
		cannibalism_register_current_country_objective_observer = yes
		activate_mission = cannibalism_reach_island_mission
	}
}

cannibalism_record_reach_island_operation = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_reach_island_mission_active } }
		cannibalism_start_reach_island_mission = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_reach_island_mission_active
			cannibalism_reach_island_target_identity_matches = yes

			event_target:cannibalism_objective_country_target = {
				tag = var:ROOT.cannibalism_reach_island_target_country
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_actor_generation value = ROOT.cannibalism_reach_island_target_generation compare = equals }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_reach_island_progress = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.one }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_reach_island_progress min = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero max = cannibalism_reach_island_goal }
	}
}

cannibalism_start_stop_unification_mission = {

		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_stop_unification_mission_active }

			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }

		set_variable = { cannibalism_stop_unification_target_generation = event_target:cannibalism_objective_country_target.cannibalism_actor_generation }

		set_variable = { cannibalism_stop_unification_goal_days = constant:cannibalism_objective_progress.unification_goal_days }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_stop_unification_duration = global.cannibalism_convergence_due_date }
		subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_stop_unification_duration = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_stop_unification_duration = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.unification_timeout_buffer_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_stop_unification_duration min = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.unification_minimum_days max = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.unification_maximum_days }

cannibalism_process_current_country_objectives = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_containment_decisions_visible = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_hold_prison_mission_active }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_hold_prison_objective_resolved }
		}
		cannibalism_start_hold_prison_mission = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_hold_prison_mission_active }
		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_prison_objective_secured = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_prison_hold_days = global.cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_interval_days }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { cannibalism_prison_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero } }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_prison_hold_days min = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero max = cannibalism_prison_required_hold_days }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_stop_unification_mission_active }
		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_stop_unification_objective_is_maintained = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_stop_unification_hold_days = global.cannibalism_scheduled_pulse_interval_days }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { cannibalism_stop_unification_hold_days = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero } }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_stop_unification_hold_days min = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero max = cannibalism_stop_unification_goal_days }
	}
	cannibalism_unregister_current_country_objective_observer_if_idle = yes
}

cannibalism_clear_investigation_mission = {
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_mission_active
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_target_has_node_identity
	clear_variable = cannibalism_investigation_target_state
	clear_variable = cannibalism_investigation_target_node_id
	clear_variable = cannibalism_investigation_target_node_generation
	clear_variable = cannibalism_investigation_progress
	clear_variable = cannibalism_investigation_goal
	clear_variable = cannibalism_investigation_duration
}

cannibalism_apply_investigation_target_node_change = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_target_has_node_identity
			cannibalism_investigation_target_is_valid = yes
		}
		var:cannibalism_investigation_target_state = {
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_node_strength = cannibalism_objective_node_change }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_node_strength min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_complete_investigation_mission = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_objective_node_change = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.investigation_success_node }
	cannibalism_apply_investigation_target_node_change = yes
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_evidence = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.investigation_success_evidence }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.investigation_success_cell }
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_objective_complete
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_objective_resolved
	cannibalism_clear_investigation_mission = yes
	cannibalism_clamp_current_country_evidence = yes
	cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
	cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
}

cannibalism_partial_investigation_mission = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_objective_node_change = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.investigation_partial_node }
	cannibalism_apply_investigation_target_node_change = yes
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_evidence = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.investigation_partial_evidence }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.investigation_partial_cell }

	set_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_objective_resolved

	cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes

cannibalism_fail_investigation_mission = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_objective_node_change = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.investigation_failure_node }
	cannibalism_apply_investigation_target_node_change = yes
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.investigation_failure_integrity }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.investigation_failure_cell }

	set_country_flag = cannibalism_investigation_objective_resolved

cannibalism_resolve_investigation_cancellation = {
	if = { limit = { cannibalism_investigation_objective_complete = yes } cannibalism_complete_investigation_mission = yes }
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_investigation_progress
				value = constant:cannibalism_objective_progress.investigation_partial
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		cannibalism_partial_investigation_mission = yes
	}
	else = { cannibalism_fail_investigation_mission = yes }
}

			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = cannibalism_objective_target_cult_change }
			}
			cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
			cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
		}
	}
}

	clear_variable = cannibalism_break_network_target_country
