	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_objective_target_cell_change = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.network_success_target_cell }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_objective_target_cult_change = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.network_success_target_cult }
	cannibalism_apply_break_network_target_change = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.network_success_reach }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_objective_effect.network_success_integrity }
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_break_network_objective_complete
	cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = yes
	cannibalism_clear_break_network_mission = yes
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cannibalism_network_reach min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
}

cannibalism_resolve_break_network_cancellation = {

	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_break_network_progress
				value = constant:cannibalism_objective_progress.network_partial
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		cannibalism_partial_break_network_mission = yes
	}
	else = { cannibalism_fail_break_network_mission = yes }
}

			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_network_alignment }

				clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_network_alignment min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_max }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reconstruction compact progress and bounded category retirement
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_refresh_compact_vigilance_progress = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_start_date }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_compact_vigilance_progress_days = global.date }
		subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_compact_vigilance_progress_days = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_start_date }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_progress_days min = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero max = constant:cannibalism_objective_timing.compact_vigilance_days }
	}
}

cannibalism_refresh_global_aftermath_category_lifecycle = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_participant_found = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.zero }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_reconstruction_participants
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_country_flag = cannibalism_reconstruction_participant
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_participant_found = constant:cannibalism_objective_value.one }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_reconstruction_participant_found < constant:cannibalism_objective_value.one } }
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_reconstruction_system_active
	}
}

cannibalism_clear_current_country_compact_vigilance_runtime = {
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_mission_active
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_reconstruction_participant
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_reconstruction_participants value = THIS } }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_reconstruction_participants value = THIS }
	}
	clear_variable = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_start_date
	clear_variable = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_progress_days
	clear_variable = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_duration
	cannibalism_refresh_current_country_reconstruction_idea = yes
	cannibalism_refresh_global_aftermath_category_lifecycle = yes
}

cannibalism_retire_current_country_reconstruction_participation = {
	cannibalism_clear_current_country_compact_vigilance_runtime = yes
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_reconstruction_participant_complete
}

cannibalism_partial_compact_vigilance = {
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_compact_vigilance_partial
	cannibalism_retire_current_country_reconstruction_participation = yes
}

cannibalism_resolve_compact_vigilance = {
	cannibalism_refresh_compact_vigilance_progress = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_compact_vigilance_is_maintained = yes
			cannibalism_compact_vigilance_has_full_progress = yes
		}
		cannibalism_complete_compact_vigilance = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_compact_vigilance_has_partial_progress = yes }
		cannibalism_partial_compact_vigilance = yes
	}
	else = { cannibalism_fail_compact_vigilance = yes }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared scale and runtime preparation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_scenario_prepare_scale = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = triggerable_scenarios_cannibalism_type }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = triggerable_scenarios_intensity }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_countries = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_countries }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_warlords }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_silent_hosts = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_silent_hosts }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_field_hunger }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_command_integrity }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_cell_strength }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_cult_cohesion }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_network }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.medium } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_countries = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_countries }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_warlords }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_silent_hosts = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_silent_hosts }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_field_hunger }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_command_integrity }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_cell_strength }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_cult_cohesion }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_network }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.high } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_countries = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_countries }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_states }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_warlords }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_silent_hosts = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_silent_hosts }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_field_hunger }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_command_integrity }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_cell_strength }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_cult_cohesion }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_network }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.maximum } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_countries = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_countries }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_states }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_warlords }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_silent_hosts = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_silent_hosts }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_field_hunger }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_command_integrity }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_cell_strength }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_cult_cohesion }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_network }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_convergence } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.low } } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_convergence_warlords } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.medium } } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_convergence_warlords } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.high } } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.high_convergence_warlords } }
		else = { set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.maximum_convergence_warlords } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scenario_selected_type
				value = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_ritual_cells
				compare = greater_than
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_countries = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_countries }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.compromised_garrison }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_mark_external_route = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_ritual_cells } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_i_stage }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type > constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_ritual_cells } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_ii_stage }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_mark_external_route = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_select_source_country = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_source_found = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_scenario_valid_preflight_source_country = yes }
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_scenario_source_country
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_source_found = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_source_found < 1 }
				is_ai = yes
				cannibalism_scenario_valid_preflight_source_country = yes
			}
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_scenario_source_country
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_source_found = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Atomic manual-launch preflight
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_scenario_prepare_preflight_requirements = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_warlord_states = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_march_states = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_warlord_slots = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_silent_islands } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states = cannibalism_scenario_target_states }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_warlord_states = cannibalism_scenario_target_silent_hosts }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_warlord_slots = cannibalism_scenario_target_silent_hosts }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_warlord_states } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_warlord_slots = cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.low } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.medium } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.high } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_march_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_march_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_warlord_states = cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_convergence } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_warlord_slots = cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.low } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_march_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.medium } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_march_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.high } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_march_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_march_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.medium_states }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_required_island_warlord_states = cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states }
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_plan_available_warlord_slots = {

	if = {

		}
		CBA = { add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slots = THIS } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slot_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slot_count < cannibalism_scenario_required_warlord_slots }
			cannibalism_slot_cbb_available = yes
		}
		CBB = { add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slots = THIS } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slot_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {

			cannibalism_slot_cbc_available = yes

		CBC = { add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slots = THIS } }

	}
	if = {

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slot_count < cannibalism_scenario_required_warlord_slots }
			cannibalism_slot_cbf_available = yes
		}
		CBF = { add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slots = THIS } }

		CBH = { add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slots = THIS } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slot_count = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_build_manual_preflight_plan = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_preflight_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_use_preflight_plan = 0 }
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_countries
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_siege_states
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_march_states
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slots
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_count = 0 }
	cannibalism_scenario_select_source_country = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_scenario_can_launch = yes
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_source_found > 0 }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_scenario_source_country
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country = {
			add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_countries = THIS }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_count = 1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_count < cannibalism_scenario_target_countries }
				is_ai = yes
				cannibalism_scenario_valid_preflight_additional_actor = yes
				NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country }
			}
			add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_countries = THIS }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_count = 1 }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_count
				value = cannibalism_scenario_target_countries
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		cannibalism_scenario_prepare_preflight_requirements = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_count = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_warlord_count = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_siege_count = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_march_count = 0 }

		every_state = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_warlord_count < cannibalism_scenario_required_island_warlord_states }
				cannibalism_scenario_preflight_island_warlord_state = yes
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states value = THIS } }
			}
			add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states = THIS }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_count = 1 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_warlord_count = 1 }
		}
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_count < cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states }
				cannibalism_scenario_preflight_island_node_state = yes
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states value = THIS } }
			}
			add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states = THIS }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_count = 1 }
		}
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_siege_count < cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states }
				cannibalism_scenario_preflight_siege_warlord_state = yes
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states value = THIS } }
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_siege_states value = THIS } }
			}
			add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_siege_states = THIS }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_siege_count = 1 }
		}
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_march_count < cannibalism_scenario_required_march_states }
				cannibalism_scenario_preflight_march_warlord_state = yes
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states value = THIS } }
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_siege_states value = THIS } }
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_march_states value = THIS } }
			}
			add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_march_states = THIS }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_march_count = 1 }
		}
		cannibalism_scenario_plan_available_warlord_slots = yes

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_count value = cannibalism_scenario_required_island_states compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_warlord_count value = cannibalism_scenario_required_island_warlord_states compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_scenario_planned_siege_count value = cannibalism_scenario_required_siege_states compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_scenario_planned_march_count value = cannibalism_scenario_required_march_states compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slot_count value = cannibalism_scenario_required_warlord_slots compare = equals }
				OR = {
					NOT = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_convergence } }
					AND = {
						NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active }
						NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
						NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_broken }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_preflight_result = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_use_preflight_plan = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_prepare_runtime = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_system_started
			NOT = { cannibalism_has_global_residue = yes }
			OR = {
				has_global_flag = cannibalism_global_victory
				has_global_flag = cannibalism_cleanup_complete
				NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_system_active }
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_system_started
	}
	cannibalism_initialize_global_runtime = yes
	set_global_flag = cannibalism_system_active
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_global_victory
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_cleanup_complete
	clr_global_flag = cannibalism_global_stabilization_active
	clear_variable = global.cannibalism_global_victory_due_date
	clear_variable = global.cannibalism_zero_residue_start_date
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ordinary actor creation and policy state
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_scenario_apply_scale_to_current_actor = {
	set_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = cannibalism_scenario_field_hunger }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = cannibalism_scenario_command_integrity }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = cannibalism_scenario_cell_strength }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = cannibalism_scenario_cult_cohesion }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 1 } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = cannibalism_scenario_network_alignment }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_network_actor
	}
	cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
	cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes

	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_opening_policy_chosen }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.low }
		}
		cannibalism_choose_open_emergency_policy = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_opening_policy_chosen }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.medium }
		}
		cannibalism_choose_concealment_policy = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_opening_policy_chosen }
		}
		cannibalism_choose_exploitation_policy = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_record_new_actor_nodes = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 1 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_nodes_created = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_state_count }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_nodes_created = constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_state_count }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_nodes_created = constant:cannibalism_opening.baseline_state_count }
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_initialize_current_country = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_initialization_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_was_new = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_cannibalism_active_ordinary_country = yes }
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_current_actor
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_node_source_actor
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_initialization_result = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_scenario_valid_new_actor_country = yes }
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_local_victory
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_external_reinfection_protected
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_country_cleanup_complete
		cannibalism_select_highest_risk_state = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_state_selected > 0 }
				has_event_target = cannibalism_selected_state
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_selected_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_initial_state }
			cannibalism_initialize_current_country = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_actor_register_result > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_initialization_result = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_was_new = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_initialization_result > 0 } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_manual_scenario_actor
		cannibalism_scenario_apply_scale_to_current_actor = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_authorize_requested_evolutions = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled > 0 }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_i_active }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 1 }
		cannibalism_open_evolution_i = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled > 0 }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 1 }
		cannibalism_open_evolution_ii = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 0 }
}

cannibalism_scenario_initialize_required_actors = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_count = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_setup_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_nodes_created = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_source_was_new = 0 }
	event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country = {
		cannibalism_scenario_initialize_current_country = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_initialization_result > 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_count = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_was_new > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_source_was_new = 1 }
				cannibalism_scenario_record_new_actor_nodes = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_source_was_new > 0 } }
		event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country = {
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.2 days = 1 } }
		}
	}
	cannibalism_scenario_authorize_requested_evolutions = yes

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_use_preflight_plan > 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_countries
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_count < cannibalism_scenario_target_countries }
					NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country }
				}
				cannibalism_scenario_initialize_current_country = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_initialization_result > 0 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_count = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_was_new > 0 } }
						cannibalism_scenario_record_new_actor_nodes = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_scenario_actor_count
					value = cannibalism_scenario_target_countries
					compare = less_than
				}
				is_ai = yes
				cannibalism_scenario_valid_source_country = yes
				NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country }
			}
			cannibalism_scenario_initialize_current_country = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_initialization_result > 0 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_count = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_was_new > 0 } }
					cannibalism_scenario_record_new_actor_nodes = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scenario_actor_count
				value = cannibalism_scenario_target_countries
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_setup_result = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_setup_result = 0 }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Node selection and canonical maturation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_scenario_seed_current_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_node_setup_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_scenario_source_country
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_stage = cannibalism_scenario_node_stage }
		cannibalism_initialize_current_state_as_opening_node = yes
		if = {
			limit = { cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_nodes_created = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_state_has_active_cell = yes }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.mature_node_strength }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = cannibalism_scenario_node_stage }
		cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution > 1 } }
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_network_node
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_mark_external_route > 0 } }
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_external_route_node
		}
		if = { limit = { is_island_state = yes } set_state_flag = cannibalism_commune_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_node_setup_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_seed_additional_source_states = {
	event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country = {
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_current_actor
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_node_source_actor
	}
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scenario_nodes_created
				value = cannibalism_scenario_target_states
				compare = less_than
			}
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed < 1 }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country = { cannibalism_select_highest_risk_state = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_state_selected > 0 }
				has_event_target = cannibalism_selected_state
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_selected_state = { cannibalism_scenario_seed_current_state = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_node_setup_result < 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_select_island_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_state_found = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_use_preflight_plan > 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_state_found < 1 } }
				set_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_reserved_state
				save_event_target_as = cannibalism_scenario_selected_state
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_state_found = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_state_found > 0 } }
			remove_from_temp_array = { array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states index = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_state_found < 1 }
				cannibalism_scenario_state_can_seed_island_host = yes
			}
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_reserved_state
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_scenario_selected_state
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_state_found = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Canonical warlord formation

cannibalism_scenario_allocate_next_planned_warlord_slot = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_found = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.none }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slots
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_found < 1 } }
			if = { limit = { tag = CBA } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cba } }
			else_if = { limit = { tag = CBB } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbb } }
			else_if = { limit = { tag = CBC } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbc } }
			else_if = { limit = { tag = CBD } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbd } }
			else_if = { limit = { tag = CBE } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbe } }
			else_if = { limit = { tag = CBF } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbf } }
			else_if = { limit = { tag = CBG } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbg } }
			else_if = { limit = { tag = CBH } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbh } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index > constant:cannibalism_slot.none } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_found = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cba }
			cannibalism_slot_cba_available = yes
		}
		cannibalism_allocate_slot_cba = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbb }
			cannibalism_slot_cbb_available = yes
		}
		cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbb = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbc }
			cannibalism_slot_cbc_available = yes
		}
		cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbc = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbd }
			cannibalism_slot_cbd_available = yes
		}
		cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbd = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbe }
			cannibalism_slot_cbe_available = yes
		}
		cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbe = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbf }
			cannibalism_slot_cbf_available = yes
		}
		cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbf = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbg }
			cannibalism_slot_cbg_available = yes
		}
		cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbg = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_planned_slot_index = constant:cannibalism_slot.cbh }
			cannibalism_slot_cbh_available = yes
		}
		cannibalism_allocate_slot_cbh = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_creation_result > 0 } }
		remove_from_temp_array = { array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slots index = 0 }
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_form_selected_warlord = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlord_formation_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_creation_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed < 1 }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_state_found > 0 }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_scenario_selected_state
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_current_actor
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_node_source_actor
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_scenario_selected_state = {
			CONTROLLER = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_state_host }
			cannibalism_scenario_seed_current_state = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_node_setup_result > 0 } }
				cannibalism_prepare_warlord_creation_context = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_use_preflight_plan > 0 } }
					cannibalism_scenario_allocate_next_planned_warlord_slot = yes
				}
				else = { cannibalism_allocate_warlord_slot_for_current_state = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_creation_result > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlord_formation_result = 1 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlords_created = 1 }
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_new_country = {
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_manual_scenario_country
				set_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = cannibalism_scenario_network_alignment }
				cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
				cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlord_formation_result < 1 }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlord_formation_required > 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_scenario_selected_state }
		event_target:cannibalism_scenario_selected_state = {
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_reserved_state
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_march_column
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_form_next_island_warlord = {
	cannibalism_scenario_select_island_state = yes
	cannibalism_scenario_form_selected_warlord = yes
}

cannibalism_scenario_form_next_siege_warlord = {
	cannibalism_scenario_select_siege_state = yes
	cannibalism_scenario_form_selected_warlord = yes
}

cannibalism_scenario_form_next_march_warlord = {
	cannibalism_scenario_select_march_state = yes
	cannibalism_scenario_form_selected_warlord = yes
}

cannibalism_scenario_create_warlord_states_distribution = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlord_formation_required = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.low } }
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_siege_warlord = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.medium } }
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_island_warlord = yes
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_siege_warlord = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.high } }
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_island_warlord = yes
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_siege_warlord = yes
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_march_warlord = yes
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_siege_warlord = yes
	}
	else = {
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_island_warlord = yes
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_island_warlord = yes
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_siege_warlord = yes
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_siege_warlord = yes
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_march_warlord = yes
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_march_warlord = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_create_convergence_distribution = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlord_formation_required = 1 }
	cannibalism_scenario_form_next_island_warlord = yes
	cannibalism_scenario_form_next_siege_warlord = yes
	cannibalism_scenario_form_next_march_warlord = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity > constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.low } }
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_island_warlord = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity > constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.medium } }
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_siege_warlord = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity > constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.high } }
		cannibalism_scenario_form_next_march_warlord = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_setup_discipline_collapse = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 0 }
	cannibalism_scenario_initialize_required_actors = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_setup_result > 0 } }
		cannibalism_scenario_seed_additional_source_states = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_setup_ritual_cells = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 0 }
	cannibalism_scenario_initialize_required_actors = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_setup_result > 0 } }
		cannibalism_scenario_seed_additional_source_states = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_setup_silent_islands = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_countries = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_countries }
	cannibalism_scenario_initialize_required_actors = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_island_states_seeded = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlords_created = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlord_formation_required = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_setup_result > 0 } }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_scenario_island_states_seeded
					value = cannibalism_scenario_target_states
					compare = less_than
				}
				check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed < 1 }
			}
			cannibalism_scenario_select_island_state = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_state_found > 0 }
					has_event_target = cannibalism_scenario_selected_state
				}
				event_target:cannibalism_scenario_source_country = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_node_source_actor }
				event_target:cannibalism_scenario_selected_state = { cannibalism_scenario_seed_current_state = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_node_setup_result > 0 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_island_states_seeded = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = {
								var = cannibalism_scenario_warlords_created
								value = cannibalism_scenario_target_silent_hosts
								compare = less_than
							}
						}
						cannibalism_scenario_form_selected_warlord = yes
					}
					event_target:cannibalism_scenario_selected_state = { clr_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_reserved_state }
				}
				else = { set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed = 1 } }
			}
			else = { set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed < 1 }
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scenario_island_states_seeded
				value = cannibalism_scenario_target_states
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_setup_warlord_states = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_countries = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_countries }
	cannibalism_scenario_initialize_required_actors = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlords_created = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_setup_result > 0 } }
		cannibalism_scenario_create_warlord_states_distribution = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed < 1 }
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scenario_warlords_created
				value = cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_scenario_setup_convergence = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_countries = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_countries }
	cannibalism_scenario_initialize_required_actors = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_warlords_created = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_actor_setup_result > 0 } }
		cannibalism_scenario_create_convergence_distribution = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed < 1 }
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scenario_warlords_created
				value = cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		cannibalism_rebuild_runtime_counts = yes
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_scenario_convergence_contract
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 1 }
		cannibalism_begin_convergence_window = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_transition_authorized = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Automatic pre-fire Evolution III opening. This reuses the exact scenario
# convergence transactions without marking the campaign as a manual scenario.
# The capacity trigger has already proved that all three required origins and
# reusable slots exist, so the opening creates a real three-warlord network,
# records Deaths-backed population consumption, and begins the public warning
# window before the reveal can occur.
cannibalism_setup_prefire_evolution_iii_opening = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_use_preflight_plan = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_convergence }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity = constant:triggerable_scenario_intensity.low }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_countries = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_countries }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_states = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_states }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_warlords = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_convergence_warlords }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_target_silent_hosts = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_silent_hosts }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_field_hunger }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_command_integrity }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_cell_strength }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_cult_cohesion }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_scenario_scale.low_network }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_mark_external_route = 1 }
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_scenario_source_country
	cannibalism_scenario_setup_convergence = yes

	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_manual_scenario_actor
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_manual_scenario_country
		}
	}
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_reserved_state
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_march_column
			}
		}
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_reserved_state
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_march_column
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Public wrapper called by the shared triggerable-scenario dispatcher
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

trigger_cannibalism_scenario = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_failed = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result = 0 }
	cannibalism_scenario_prepare_scale = yes
	cannibalism_scenario_build_manual_preflight_plan = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_preflight_result > 0 }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_scenario_source_country
		}
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_manual_scenario_setup_failed
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_scenario_launch_active
		cannibalism_scenario_prepare_runtime = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_discipline_collapse } }
			cannibalism_scenario_setup_discipline_collapse = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_ritual_cells } }
			cannibalism_scenario_setup_ritual_cells = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_silent_islands } }
			cannibalism_scenario_setup_silent_islands = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_warlord_states } }
			cannibalism_scenario_setup_warlord_states = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_selected_type = constant:cannibalism_scenario.type_convergence } }
			cannibalism_scenario_setup_convergence = yes
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_setup_result > 0 } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_manual_scenario_launcher
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_manual_scenario_ever_launched
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_scenario_last_type = cannibalism_scenario_selected_type }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_scenario_last_intensity = cannibalism_scenario_selected_intensity }
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_scenario_launch_count = 1 }
		cannibalism_compact_actor_registry = yes
		cannibalism_compact_node_registry = yes
		cannibalism_rebuild_runtime_counts = yes
		cannibalism_refresh_world_threat_source = yes
		cannibalism_schedule_next_pulse = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_manual_scenario_setup_failed
	}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_scenario_preflight_result > 0 } }
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_reserved_state
					has_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_march_column
				}
			}
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_reserved_state
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_scenario_march_column
		}
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_scenario_launch_active
	}
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_actor_countries
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_island_states
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_siege_states
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_march_states
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scenario_planned_warlord_slots
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_i_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_ii_enabled = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_prefire_evolution_iii_pending = 0 }
}

# Owns the aligned, generation-safe foreign-spread queue. Entries prove a
# source country, source state, target country, target state, and route before
# they are enqueued. The Event 014 pulse resolves due rows, exposes concrete
# state-targeted counterplay, applies external reinfection, and compacts only
# after iteration. No broad periodic on_action or unexplained world jump is
# used here.

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_node_strength = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.formation }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.compromised_garrison }

		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_spread.volunteer_return_strength }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_parameters_valid = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_delay_days = constant:cannibalism_spread.occupation_turnover_delay_days }

		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }

	else_if = {

		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_spread.deliberate_seed_strength }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.hunting_ground }

		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.occupation }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Enqueue and per-scope pending ledgers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Any indexed mutation first calls this executable audit. It checks alignment,
# positive row identities, legal route/status values, live-row scope payloads,
# exact state metadata, unique live IDs, and one live row per target state.
# A malformed ledger is left untouched and exposes a durable failure flag.
cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_spread_queue_invariant_failure }
			cannibalism_spread_queue_arrays_are_aligned = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_validation_index = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_spread_validation_index
					value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^num
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = cannibalism_spread_validation_index }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_route = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_route_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index > 0 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index > 0 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index > 0 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index > 0 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index > 0 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_generation_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index > 0 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_due_date_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index > 0 } }
						NOT = { cannibalism_spread_route_value_is_valid = yes }
						NOT = {
							OR = {
								check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.queued }
								check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.in_transit }
								check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.arrived }
								check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.contained }
								check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.invalidated }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_id_validation_index = cannibalism_spread_validation_index }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_id_validation_index = 1 }
				while_loop_effect = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
						check_variable = {
							var = cannibalism_spread_id_validation_index
							value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^num
							compare = less_than
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = {
								var = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_id_validation_index
								value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_validation_index
								compare = equals
							}
						}
						set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result = 0 }
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_id_validation_index = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
					cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes
				}
				cannibalism_load_spread_entry_context = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							NOT = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_source_country_context_loaded > 0 } }
							NOT = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_source_state_context_loaded > 0 } }
							NOT = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_country_context_loaded > 0 } }
							NOT = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_state_context_loaded > 0 } }
							NOT = {
								event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
									has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active
									has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id
									has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_route
									has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country
									has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation
									check_variable = { var = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id value = cannibalism_expected_spread_id compare = equals }
									check_variable = { var = cannibalism_inbound_spread_route value = cannibalism_spread_route compare = equals }
									check_variable = { var = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country value = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country compare = equals }
									check_variable = { var = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation value = cannibalism_spread_source_generation compare = equals }
									OR = {
										NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_warning_event_open }
										AND = {
											has_variable = cannibalism_warning_expected_spread_id
											check_variable = { var = cannibalism_warning_expected_spread_id value = cannibalism_expected_spread_id compare = equals }
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result = 0 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_duplicate_index = cannibalism_spread_validation_index }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_duplicate_index = 1 }
				while_loop_effect = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
						check_variable = {
							var = cannibalism_spread_duplicate_index
							value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^num
							compare = less_than
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_duplicate_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.queued }
								check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_duplicate_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.in_transit }
							}
							var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_duplicate_index = {
								state = event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state
							}
						}
						set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result = 0 }
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_duplicate_index = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
				cannibalism_load_spread_entry_context = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_state_context_loaded > 0 }
						event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
							has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id
							check_variable = { var = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id value = cannibalism_expected_spread_id compare = equals }
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result = 0 }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_validation_index = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result < 1 } }
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_spread_queue_invariant_failure
	}
}

# Normalized target-state scope is event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state.
# This authoritative scan rejects a duplicate even if the state's cache flag is
# missing. A cache flag without a matching live row is exposed as corruption.
cannibalism_check_spread_target_state_availability = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_available = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_live_row_count = 0 }
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_spread_target_state
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_spread_queue_index
					value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes
					var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
						state = event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_live_row_count = 1 }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_live_row_count < 1 }
				event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active }
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_warning_event_open }
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_active }
					NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id }
					NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_route }
					NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country }
					NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_available = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_live_row_count < 1 }
				event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
					OR = {
						has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active
						has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_active
						has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id
						has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_route
						has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country
						has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation
					}
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_spread_queue_invariant_failure
		}
	}
}

# Rebuilds every spread cache reachable from the canonical queue. It never runs
# against an invalid array shape or invalid live-row identity.
cannibalism_rebuild_spread_pending_ledgers = {
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_country_entries
			clear_variable = cannibalism_outbound_spread_count
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_seeding_active
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_country_entries
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_count
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_route_warning_active
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_route
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation
		}
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_pending_spread_count = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_spread_queue_index
					value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes }
				cannibalism_load_spread_entry_context = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_pending_spread_count = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_source_country_context_loaded > 0 }
						event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country = {
							exists = yes
							has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation
							check_variable = { var = cannibalism_actor_generation value = cannibalism_spread_source_generation compare = equals }
						}
					}
					event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country = {
						add_to_variable = { cannibalism_outbound_spread_count = 1 }
						set_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_seeding_active
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_country_context_loaded > 0 }
						event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = { exists = yes }
					}
					event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = {
						add_to_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_count = 1 }
						set_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_route_warning_active
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_state_context_loaded > 0 } }
					event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
						set_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active
						set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_id = cannibalism_expected_spread_id }
						set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_route = cannibalism_spread_route }
						set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country }
						set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation = cannibalism_spread_source_generation }
					}
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_enqueue_spread_entry = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_enqueue_result = 0 }
	cannibalism_set_spread_parameters_from_route = yes
	cannibalism_check_spread_target_state_availability = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_parameters_valid > 0 }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_available > 0 }
			cannibalism_spread_context_is_valid = yes
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_next_spread_id = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_due_date = global.date }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_due_date = cannibalism_spread_delay_days }

		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries value = global.cannibalism_next_spread_id }
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_country_entries value = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country }
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_state_entries value = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_state }
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_country_entries value = event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country }
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries value = event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state }
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_route_entries value = cannibalism_spread_route }
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_generation_entries value = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country.cannibalism_actor_generation }
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_due_date_entries value = cannibalism_spread_due_date }
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries value = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.in_transit }

		event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country = {
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_outbound_spread_count = 1 }
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_seeding_active
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = {
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_count = 1 }
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_route_warning_active
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active
			set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_id = global.cannibalism_next_spread_id }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_route = cannibalism_spread_route }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country.cannibalism_actor_generation }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_pending_spread_count = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_enqueue_result = 1 }
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = {
			country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.60 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_clear_loaded_spread_pending_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_pending_clear_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_source_country_context_loaded > 0 }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_state_context_loaded > 0 }
			event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active
				has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id
				has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_route
				has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country
				has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id value = cannibalism_expected_spread_id compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_inbound_spread_route value = cannibalism_spread_route compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country value = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country compare = equals }
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation value = cannibalism_spread_source_generation compare = equals }
			}
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_active
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_humane
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_hard
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_route
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_clear_warning_instance_on_invalidation > 0 } }
				clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_warning_event_open
				clear_variable = cannibalism_warning_expected_spread_id
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_pending_clear_result = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result = 0 }
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_spread_queue_invariant_failure
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_pending_clear_result > 0 }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_spread_source_country
			event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country = {
				exists = yes
				has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_actor_generation
					value = cannibalism_spread_source_generation
					compare = equals
				}
			}
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country = {
			subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_outbound_spread_count = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_outbound_spread_count < 1 } }
				clear_variable = cannibalism_outbound_spread_count
				clr_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_seeding_active
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_pending_clear_result > 0 }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_spread_target_country
			event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = { exists = yes }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = {
			subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_count = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_count < 1 } }
				clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_count
				clr_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_route_warning_active
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_pending_clear_result > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cannibalism_pending_spread_count > 0 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cannibalism_pending_spread_count = 1 }
	}
}
