cannibalism_activate_current_country_from_external_spread = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_external_activation_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_was_local_victory = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_local_victory }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_was_local_victory = 1 }
	}
	cannibalism_register_current_country_actor = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_actor_register_result > 0 } }
		cannibalism_reset_current_country_incarnation_state = yes
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_local_victory
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_external_reinfection_protected
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_recovery_coordinator
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_external_spread_new_actor
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_was_local_victory > 0 } }
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_external_reinfection_active
			add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_external_reinfection_count = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_policy = constant:cannibalism_policy.none }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage = constant:cannibalism_country_stage.network_node }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_field_hunger }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_command_integrity }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_cell_strength }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_cult_cohesion }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_resistant }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_larder = 0 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = 0 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population = 0 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population_k = 0 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_confirmed_predation_count = 1 }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_last_processed_pulse_sequence = global.cannibalism_pulse_sequence }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_external_infection_source = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_external_infection_route = cannibalism_spread_route }
		cannibalism_initialize_current_country_decision_tuning = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_frontline_crisis } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_frontline_crisis }
		}
		cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
		save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_latest_actor
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_external_activation_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_loaded_spread_to_current_country = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_country_arrival_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_cannibalism_active_ordinary_country = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_field_hunger = constant:cannibalism_spread.arrival_hunger }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_spread.arrival_integrity }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_spread.arrival_cell }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_cult_cohesion }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_spread.arrival_cult }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cannibalism_cult_cohesion = constant:cannibalism_opening.ritual_cult_cohesion }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage < constant:cannibalism_country_stage.network_node } }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage = constant:cannibalism_country_stage.network_node }
		}
		set_variable = { cannibalism_external_infection_source = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_external_infection_route = cannibalism_spread_route }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_external_spread_arrived
		cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
		cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_country_arrival_result = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		cannibalism_activate_current_country_from_external_spread = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_external_activation_result > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_country_arrival_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_loaded_spread_to_current_state = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node } }
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_node_source_actor }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_type = cannibalism_spread_node_type }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_strength = cannibalism_spread_node_strength }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_stage = cannibalism_spread_node_stage }
		cannibalism_register_current_state_node = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_node_strength
					value = cannibalism_spread_node_strength
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			set_variable = { cannibalism_node_strength = cannibalism_spread_node_strength }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_state_stage
					value = cannibalism_spread_node_stage
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = cannibalism_spread_node_stage }
			cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
		}
	}
	set_state_flag = cannibalism_external_route_node
	set_variable = { cannibalism_external_route_type = cannibalism_spread_route }
}

cannibalism_resolve_loaded_spread_arrival = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_arrival_applied = 0 }
	event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = {
		cannibalism_apply_loaded_spread_to_current_country = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_country_arrival_result > 0 } }
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
			cannibalism_apply_loaded_spread_to_current_state = yes
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_network_alignment }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_spread.seed_alignment_gain }
				clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_network_alignment min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_max }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_spread.arrival_chaos }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_spread }
		cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_arrival_applied = 1 }
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_external_spread_new_actor }
				country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.61 }
			}
			else = {
				country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.62 }
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_resolve_loaded_spread_containment = {
	event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_country = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_network_alignment }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_spread.seed_alignment_loss }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_network_alignment min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_max }
		}
	}
	event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = {
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_successful_external_screening
		if = {
			limit = { is_cannibalism_active_ordinary_country = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_spread.contained_integrity }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_cell_strength = constant:cannibalism_spread.contained_cell }
			cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
			cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_spread.contained_chaos }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_containment }
	cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Queue resolution and post-iteration compaction

cannibalism_load_spread_entry_context = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_id = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_route = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_route_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_source_generation = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_generation_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_source_country_context_loaded = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_source_state_context_loaded = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_country_context_loaded = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_state_context_loaded = 0 }
	var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_country
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_source_country_context_loaded = 1 }
	}
	var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_state
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_source_state_context_loaded = 1 }
	}
	var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_country
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_country_context_loaded = 1 }
	}
	var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_state
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_target_state_context_loaded = 1 }
	}
	cannibalism_set_spread_parameters_from_route = yes
}

# Inputs: cannibalism_spread_queue_index, cannibalism_expected_spread_id, and
# cannibalism_spread_terminal_status. The ID is re-read before status changes;
# status changes first, so a repeated call cannot clear any ledger twice.
cannibalism_finalize_loaded_spread_entry = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_finalize_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_requested_id = cannibalism_expected_spread_id }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_spread_queue_index
				value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num
				compare = less_than
			}
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_requested_id > 0 }
			check_variable = {
				var = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index
				value = cannibalism_spread_requested_id
				compare = equals
			}
			cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_terminal_status = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.arrived }
				check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_terminal_status = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.contained }
				check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_terminal_status = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.invalidated }
			}
		}
		cannibalism_load_spread_entry_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_expected_spread_id
					value = cannibalism_spread_requested_id
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = cannibalism_spread_terminal_status }
			cannibalism_clear_loaded_spread_pending_state = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_pending_clear_result > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_finalize_result = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Canonical idempotent invalidator. It never removes an index; the reverse
# compactor owns physical deletion after traversal.
cannibalism_invalidate_loaded_spread_entry = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_terminal_status = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.invalidated }
	cannibalism_finalize_loaded_spread_entry = yes
}

cannibalism_resolve_loaded_spread_entry = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_clear_warning_instance_on_invalidation = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_terminal_status = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.invalidated }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_parameters_valid > 0 }
			cannibalism_loaded_spread_entry_is_valid = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_active }
			}
			cannibalism_resolve_loaded_spread_containment = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_terminal_status = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.contained }
		}
		else = {
			cannibalism_resolve_loaded_spread_arrival = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_arrival_applied > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_terminal_status = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.arrived }
			}
		}
	}
	cannibalism_finalize_loaded_spread_entry = yes
}

cannibalism_process_spread_queue = {
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_spread_queue_index
					value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes
					check_variable = {
						var = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_due_date_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index
						value = global.date
						compare = less_than_or_equals
					}
				}
				cannibalism_load_spread_entry_context = yes
				cannibalism_resolve_loaded_spread_entry = yes
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_compact_spread_queue = {
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_compaction_index = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_compaction_index > 0 } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_compaction_index = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_id = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_id > 0 }
					check_variable = {
						var = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_compaction_index
						value = cannibalism_expected_spread_id
						compare = equals
					}
					OR = {
						check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_compaction_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.arrived }
						check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_compaction_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.contained }
						check_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^cannibalism_spread_compaction_index = constant:cannibalism_spread_status.invalidated }
					}
				}
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries index = cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_country_entries index = cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_state_entries index = cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_country_entries index = cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries index = cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_route_entries index = cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_generation_entries index = cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_due_date_entries index = cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
				remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries index = cannibalism_spread_compaction_index }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Physical automatic route producers

cannibalism_set_automatic_spread_route_from_source_state = {
	# The generic border pulse proves only adjacent wartime retreat. Other route
	# labels belong exclusively to their action-specific producers.
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_route = constant:cannibalism_spread_route.retreat }
}

# Country scope. The existing targeted pulse calls this only for registered
# actors. Source and target states must share a border and be controlled by
# countries currently at war; the timed flag prevents weekly route spam.
cannibalism_try_enqueue_current_actor_border_spread = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_automatic_spread_candidate_found = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active
			is_cannibalism_active_country = yes
			has_war = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_automatic_spread_cooldown }
			any_controlled_state = { cannibalism_state_is_automatic_border_spread_source = yes }
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_country
		random_controlled_state = {
			limit = { cannibalism_state_is_automatic_border_spread_source = yes }
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_state
			random_neighbor_state = {
				limit = { cannibalism_state_is_automatic_border_spread_target = yes }
				save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_state
				CONTROLLER = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_country }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_automatic_spread_candidate_found = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_automatic_spread_candidate_found > 0 } }
			cannibalism_set_automatic_spread_route_from_source_state = yes
			cannibalism_enqueue_spread_entry = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_enqueue_result > 0 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_automatic_spread_cooldown days = @CANNIBALISM_AUTOMATIC_ROUTE_COOLDOWN_DAYS }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Invaded-state scope from on_naval_invasion. ROOT is the invading country and
# FROM is the actual departure state. This is the sole automatic convoy route.
cannibalism_try_enqueue_convoy_from_naval_invasion = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_naval_invasion_spread_context_valid = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active
			ROOT = { cannibalism_spread_source_country_is_valid = yes }
			FROM = {
				is_controlled_by = ROOT
				is_coastal = yes
				naval_base > 0
				impassable = no
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
				NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_spread_recovery_blocked = yes }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.port }
					check_variable = { cannibalism_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.island_commune }
				}
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country_generation
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_node_source_country value = ROOT compare = equals }
				ROOT = {
					has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation
					check_variable = { var = cannibalism_actor_generation value = PREV.cannibalism_node_source_country_generation compare = equals }
				}
			}
			CONTROLLER = {
				cannibalism_spread_target_country_is_valid = yes
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			}
			is_coastal = yes
			impassable = no
			NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_unusable_larder = yes }
			NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_spread_recovery_blocked = yes }
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active }
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_warning_event_open }
		}
		ROOT = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_country }
		FROM = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_state }
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_state
		CONTROLLER = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_country }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_naval_invasion_spread_context_valid = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_naval_invasion_spread_context_valid > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_route = constant:cannibalism_spread_route.convoy }
		cannibalism_enqueue_spread_entry = yes
	}
}

# New-controller country scope for on_state_control_changed. An ordinary
# country retaking a live node starts the full liberation-recovery
# sequence in that state. If another controlled state is available, returning
# personnel also create an occupation-turnover warning there; containment can
# then stop the rear-area route without erasing the liberated state's trauma.
cannibalism_handle_state_control_recovery = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_recovery_context_valid = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_spread_target_country_is_valid = yes
			FROM.FROM = {
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_id
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_generation
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country
				has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country_generation
				var:cannibalism_node_source_country = {
					has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_actor_generation
						value = PREV.cannibalism_node_source_country_generation
						compare = equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		FROM.FROM = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_control_change_state
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_state
			var:cannibalism_node_source_country = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_control_change_node_source_country }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_node_id = cannibalism_node_id }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_node_generation = cannibalism_node_generation }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_node_source_generation = cannibalism_node_source_country_generation }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_was_warlord_state = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_state }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_was_warlord_state = 1 }
			}
			cannibalism_begin_current_state_recovery = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_was_warlord_state > 0 }
					check_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_start_allowed > 0 }
				}
				event_target:cannibalism_control_change_node_source_country = {
					subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count = 1 }
					clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count min = 0 max = constant:cannibalism_slot.maximum }
				}
				clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_state
				clr_state_flag = cannibalism_commune_state
				clr_state_flag = cannibalism_network_node
				clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_index
				clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_start_allowed > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_recovery_context_valid = 1 }
			cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = yes
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_try_enqueue_occupation_turnover_from_control_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_spread_candidate_found = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active
			check_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_recovery_context_valid > 0 }
			cannibalism_spread_target_country_is_valid = yes
			has_event_target = cannibalism_control_change_node_source_country
			event_target:cannibalism_control_change_node_source_country = {
				cannibalism_spread_source_country_is_valid = yes
				has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_actor_generation value = cannibalism_control_change_node_source_generation compare = equals }
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_country
		event_target:cannibalism_control_change_node_source_country = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_country }
		event_target:cannibalism_control_change_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_state }
		random_controlled_state = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { state = event_target:cannibalism_spread_source_state }
				impassable = no
				NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_unusable_larder = yes }
				NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_spread_recovery_blocked = yes }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_warning_event_open }
			}
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_state
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_spread_candidate_found = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_spread_candidate_found > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_route = constant:cannibalism_spread_route.occupation_turnover }
			cannibalism_enqueue_spread_entry = yes
		}
	}
}

# New-controller country scope for on_state_control_changed. A cannibal actor
# that captures a border state can carry a conquest route into a neighboring
# state still held by the defeated controller. The captured state is the
# physical source and remains part of the actor's territory.
cannibalism_try_enqueue_conquest_from_control_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_spread_candidate_found = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active
			is_cannibalism_active_country = yes
			FROM = {
				cannibalism_spread_target_country_is_valid = yes
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
			FROM.FROM = {
				is_controlled_by = ROOT
				any_neighbor_state = {
					is_controlled_by = FROM
					impassable = no
					NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_unusable_larder = yes }
					NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_spread_recovery_blocked = yes }
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active }
				}
			}
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_country
		FROM = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_country }
		FROM.FROM = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_state
			random_neighbor_state = {
				limit = {
					is_controlled_by = event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country
					impassable = no
					NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_unusable_larder = yes }
					NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_spread_recovery_blocked = yes }
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active }
				}
				save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_state
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_spread_candidate_found = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_control_change_spread_candidate_found > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_route = constant:cannibalism_spread_route.conquest }
			cannibalism_enqueue_spread_entry = yes
		}
	}
}

# Volunteer-sender country scope for on_recall_volunteers. ROOT receives its
# formations back from FROM; only a receiver with a live Event 014 node can be
# a source, and both ends are stored before the shared queue is called.
cannibalism_try_enqueue_volunteer_return = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_volunteer_spread_candidate_found = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_ii_active
			cannibalism_spread_target_country_is_valid = yes
			any_controlled_state = {
				impassable = no
				NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_unusable_larder = yes }
				NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_spread_recovery_blocked = yes }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active }
			}
			FROM = {
				cannibalism_spread_source_country_is_valid = yes
				any_controlled_state = {
					has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
				}
			}
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_country
		random_controlled_state = {
			limit = {
				impassable = no
				NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_unusable_larder = yes }
				NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_spread_recovery_blocked = yes }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active }
			}
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_state
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_volunteer_spread_candidate_found = 1 }
		}
		FROM = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_country
			random_controlled_state = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
				}
				save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_state
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_volunteer_spread_candidate_found > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_route = constant:cannibalism_spread_route.volunteer_return }
			cannibalism_enqueue_spread_entry = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Player and AI actions that use the same queue/cost API
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_find_expected_spread_row_for_screening = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_row_found = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_screening_requested_spread_id = cannibalism_expected_spread_id }
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_id = cannibalism_screening_requested_spread_id }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_screening_requested_spread_id > 0 }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_screening_state
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_spread_queue_index
					value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes
					check_variable = {
						var = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index
						value = cannibalism_screening_requested_spread_id
						compare = equals
					}
					var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
						state = event_target:cannibalism_screening_state
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_row_found = 1 }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_try_pay_humane_route_screening_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_humane_screening_result = 0 }
	cannibalism_find_expected_spread_row_for_screening = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_row_found > 0 }
			cannibalism_can_pay_humane_route_screening_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_screening_state = { cannibalism_screening_state_matches_expected_spread = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_manpower = constant:cannibalism_spread.humane_screening_manpower }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_manpower = -1 }
		add_manpower = cannibalism_spread_cost_manpower
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_support = constant:cannibalism_spread.humane_screening_support }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_support = -1 }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_spread_cost_support producer = ROOT }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_command = constant:cannibalism_spread.humane_screening_command }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_command = -1 }
		add_command_power = cannibalism_spread_cost_command
		add_stability = constant:cannibalism_spread.humane_screening_stability
		event_target:cannibalism_screening_state = {
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_active
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_humane
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_hard
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_humane_screening_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_try_pay_hard_route_screening_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_hard_screening_result = 0 }
	cannibalism_find_expected_spread_row_for_screening = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_row_found > 0 }
			cannibalism_can_pay_hard_route_screening_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_screening_state = { cannibalism_screening_state_matches_expected_spread = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_manpower = constant:cannibalism_spread.hard_screening_manpower }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_manpower = -1 }
		add_manpower = cannibalism_spread_cost_manpower
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_support = constant:cannibalism_spread.hard_screening_support }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_support = -1 }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_spread_cost_support producer = ROOT }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_command = constant:cannibalism_spread.hard_screening_command }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_command = -1 }
		add_command_power = cannibalism_spread_cost_command
		add_stability = constant:cannibalism_spread.hard_screening_stability
		add_war_support = constant:cannibalism_spread.hard_screening_war_support
		event_target:cannibalism_screening_state = {
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_active
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_hard
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_humane
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_cannibalism_active_ordinary_country = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_spread.hard_screening_integrity }
			cannibalism_clamp_current_country_meters = yes
			cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_hard_screening_result = 1 }
	}
}

# A stale event may close only its own per-state warning snapshot.
cannibalism_close_spread_warning_instance = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_screening_state
			event_target:cannibalism_screening_state = {
				has_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_warning_event_open
				has_variable = cannibalism_warning_expected_spread_id
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_warning_expected_spread_id value = cannibalism_expected_spread_id compare = equals }
			}
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_screening_state = {
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_warning_event_open
			clear_variable = cannibalism_warning_expected_spread_id
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_execute_deliberate_foreign_seed = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_deliberate_seed_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_deliberate_seed_uses_convoys = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_spread_target_state
			cannibalism_warlord_can_pay_deliberate_seed_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = { cannibalism_state_has_deliberate_seed_route_from_root = yes }
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_country
		event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_neighbor_state = { is_controlled_by = ROOT impassable = no } }
				random_neighbor_state = {
					limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT impassable = no }
					save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_state
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_deliberate_seed_uses_convoys = 1 }
				ROOT = {
					random_controlled_state = {
						limit = { is_coastal = yes naval_base > 0 impassable = no }
						save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_source_state
					}
				}
			}
			CONTROLLER = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_target_country }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_route = constant:cannibalism_spread_route.deliberate_seed }
		cannibalism_enqueue_spread_entry = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_enqueue_result > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_larder_cost = constant:cannibalism_spread.seed_larder_cost }
			cannibalism_pay_current_warlord_larder_cost = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_support = constant:cannibalism_spread.seed_support_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_support = -1 }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_spread_cost_support producer = ROOT }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_command = constant:cannibalism_spread.seed_command_cost }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_command = -1 }
			add_command_power = cannibalism_spread_cost_command
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_deliberate_seed_uses_convoys > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_convoys = constant:cannibalism_spread.seed_convoy_cost }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_cost_convoys = -1 }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = cannibalism_spread_cost_convoys producer = ROOT }
			}
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_spread.seed_frenzy_gain }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_network_routes_open }
				add_to_variable = { global.cannibalism_network_reach = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.operation_network_reach_gain }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_network_manipulation_open }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.network_manipulation_larder_gain }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_diverted_couriers_open }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.diverted_courier_larder_gain }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_officer_corruption_open
					has_event_target = cannibalism_spread_target_country
				}
				event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_country = {
					add_stability = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.officer_corruption_stability
				}
			}
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_frenzy min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_max }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_max }
			clamp_variable = { var = global.cannibalism_network_reach min = constant:cannibalism_network.min max = constant:cannibalism_network.max }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_deliberate_seed_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Matches both sides of every live row and leaves terminal
# tombstones for the normal post-iteration compactor.
cannibalism_invalidate_spread_entries_for_current_country_lifecycle = {
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_country
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_spread_queue_index
					value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_row_matches = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_clear_warning_instance_on_invalidation = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
							tag = event_target:cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_country
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_row_matches = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
							tag = event_target:cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_country
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_row_matches = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_clear_warning_instance_on_invalidation = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_row_matches > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_id = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index }
					cannibalism_invalidate_loaded_spread_entry = yes
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 1 }
		}
		cannibalism_rebuild_spread_pending_ledgers = yes
	}
}

# State scope. Control transfer invalidates rows whose physical source or target
# is this exact state before recovery or a replacement route is considered.
cannibalism_invalidate_spread_entries_for_current_state_lifecycle = {
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_state
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_spread_queue_index
					value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_row_matches = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_clear_warning_instance_on_invalidation = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
							state = event_target:cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_state
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_row_matches = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
							state = event_target:cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_state
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_row_matches = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_clear_warning_instance_on_invalidation = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_row_matches > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_spread_id = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index }
					cannibalism_invalidate_loaded_spread_entry = yes
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 1 }
		}
		cannibalism_rebuild_spread_pending_ledgers = yes
		cannibalism_reconcile_current_state_spread_lifecycle = yes
	}
}

# State scope. Used only by release/puppet lifecycle hooks to remove cache
# residue that has no authoritative live target row.
cannibalism_reconcile_current_state_spread_lifecycle = {
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_state
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_state_live_row_count = 0 }
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_spread_queue_index
					value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes
					var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_state_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
						state = event_target:cannibalism_spread_lifecycle_state
					}
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_state_live_row_count = 1 }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_state_live_row_count < 1 } }
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_inbound_active
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_active
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_humane
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_screening_hard
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_spread_warning_event_open
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_id
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_route
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation
			clear_variable = cannibalism_warning_expected_spread_id
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_reconcile_current_country_spread_lifecycle = {
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
		cannibalism_invalidate_spread_entries_for_current_country_lifecycle = yes
		every_controlled_state = { cannibalism_reconcile_current_state_spread_lifecycle = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_count }
				NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_outbound_spread_count }
			}
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_route_warning_active
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_seeding_active
		}
	}
}

# Contract for the unification owner:
# - regular target cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country = old actor;
# - regular target cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country = host;
# - destination has a positive current cannibalism_actor_generation.
# The helper updates every live source country/generation and target country
# reference, plus exact target-state source metadata, then rebuilds all caches.
cannibalism_migrate_spread_entries_between_countries = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_result = 0 }
	cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country
			has_event_target = cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country
			event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country = { exists = yes }
			event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country = {
				exists = yes
				has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation
				check_variable = { cannibalism_actor_generation > 0 }
				NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_destination_generation = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country.cannibalism_actor_generation }
		event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country = {
			clear_variable = cannibalism_outbound_spread_count
			clear_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_count
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_seeding_active
			clr_country_flag = cannibalism_foreign_route_warning_active
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_spread_queue_index
					value = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_status_entries^num
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_loaded_spread_status_is_live = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_requested_id = global.cannibalism_spread_queue_id_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index }
				cannibalism_load_spread_entry_context = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_source_match = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_target_match = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
							tag = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_source_match = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = {
							tag = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_target_match = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_source_match > 0 }
						check_variable = { var = cannibalism_expected_spread_id value = cannibalism_spread_migration_requested_id compare = equals }
					}
					event_target:cannibalism_spread_target_state = {
						set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_country = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country }
						set_variable = { cannibalism_inbound_spread_source_generation = cannibalism_spread_migration_destination_generation }
					}
					set_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country }
					set_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_source_generation_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = cannibalism_spread_migration_destination_generation }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_target_match > 0 }
						check_variable = { var = cannibalism_expected_spread_id value = cannibalism_spread_migration_requested_id compare = equals }
					}
					set_variable = { global.cannibalism_spread_queue_target_country_entries^cannibalism_spread_queue_index = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country }
				}
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_index = 1 }
		}
		cannibalism_rebuild_spread_pending_ledgers = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Publishes the researched reveal, ordinary world-end, Wendigo world-end, and
# eligible global-defeat aftermath packages through the shared settings-aware
# super-event player. Reveal text and audio are hard-gated behind the public
# reveal flag. The ordinary terminal effect also resolves remaining AI Hosts
# without transferring control away from any surviving human country.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Historical defeat contributors
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes }
			NOT = { is_cannibalism_unified_country = yes }
			NOT = { is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_defeat_contributors value = THIS } }
		}
		add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_defeat_contributors value = THIS }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_global_defeat_contributor
	}
}

cannibalism_refresh_global_defeat_contributor_count = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_live_defeat_contributor_count = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_defeat_contributors
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				has_country_flag = cannibalism_global_defeat_contributor
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_live_defeat_contributor_count = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_defeat_contributor_count = cannibalism_live_defeat_contributor_count }
}

cannibalism_emit_reveal_super_event = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_super_event_emitted }
		}
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_super_event_emitted
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_super_event_visible_days = constant:cannibalism_event.visible_days }
		set_global_flag = {
			flag = super_event_visible
			days = cannibalism_super_event_visible_days
			value = constant:cannibalism_event.super_event_reveal
		}
		set_variable = { global.current_super_event_audio_id = constant:cannibalism_event.super_event_reveal }
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			play_current_super_event_audio = yes
		}
	}
}

			flag = super_event_visible
			days = cannibalism_super_event_visible_days
			value = constant:cannibalism_event.super_event_world_end

		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			play_current_super_event_audio = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Terminal global war activation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_activate_terminal_global_war = {
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_terminal_global_actor
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes }
		cannibalism_wendigo_apply_scored_terminal_priorities = yes
	}
	else = {
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_terminal_global_actor }
				NOT = { has_capitulated = yes }
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_terminal_global_actor = {
				add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = PREV value = constant:cannibalism_ai_strategy.hannibal_terminal_conquest }
				add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = PREV value = constant:cannibalism_ai_strategy.hannibal_terminal_conquest }
				add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = PREV value = constant:cannibalism_ai_strategy.hannibal_terminal_front }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
						NOT = { has_wargoal_against = PREV }
					}
					create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = PREV expire = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_war_with = PREV }
						can_declare_war_on = PREV
					}
					declare_war_on = { target = PREV type = annex_everything }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_integrate_terminal_ai_warlords = {
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_terminal_ai_warlords
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes
				is_ai = yes
				NOT = { tag = CBL }
				NOT = { has_capitulated = yes }
			}
			add_to_temp_array = { cannibalism_terminal_ai_warlords = THIS }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes
				is_ai = no
				NOT = { tag = CBL }
				NOT = { has_capitulated = yes }
			}
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_terminal_player_resistance
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cannibalism_terminal_ai_warlords
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_requested_warlord_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.retained_commander }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_integration_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_unification.command_submission_larder_factor }
		cannibalism_absorb_current_warlord_into_unified_host = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_absorption_result < 1 } }
			set_global_flag = cannibalism_terminal_integration_incomplete
		}
	}
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_terminal_ai_warlords
}

cannibalism_try_start_ordinary_world_end = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			world_end_cannibalism_ordinary_scenario_enabled = yes
			cannibalism_can_complete_ordinary_world_end = yes
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_world_end_focus_complete
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_terminal_route_complete
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_world_end_ordinary }
		}
		save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_unification_host
		cannibalism_integrate_terminal_ai_warlords = yes
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_terminal_host_active
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_universal_enemy_decisions_open
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_terminal_consumption_open
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_global_absorption_open
		set_global_flag = world_end
		set_global_flag = world_end_cannibalism
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_world_end_ordinary
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_stage = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.ordinary_world_end }
		random_faction_cleanup_after_world_end = yes
		cannibalism_activate_terminal_global_war = yes
		add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_hannibal_terminal_command
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.world_end_chaos }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_world_end }
		cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
		cannibalism_emit_ordinary_world_end_super_event = yes
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Eligible defeat aftermath
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_try_start_global_defeat_aftermath = {
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_defeat_duration_days = global.date }
	subtract_from_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_defeat_duration_days = global.cannibalism_system_start_date }
	cannibalism_refresh_global_defeat_contributor_count = yes
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_global_defeat_aftermath_is_eligible = yes }
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_global_defeat_aftermath_eligible
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_reconstruction_system_active
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_defeat_contributors
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_reconstruction_participant
			}
		}
		cannibalism_initialize_global_defeat_reconstruction = yes
		cannibalism_emit_global_defeat_aftermath_super_event = yes
	}
}

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 TARGET-SCORING EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Retrieves temporary ordered country/score arrays, applies one-shot AI
# priorities, and supplies the Wendigo terminal-war consumer. Arrays are
# cleared both before and after every consumer; no persistent score cache and
# no recurring country scan is created.
# ============================================================================

cannibalism_get_unified_scored_targets = {
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scored_target_countries
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scored_target_values
	get_sorted_scored_countries_temp = {
		scorer = cannibalism_unified_target_scorer
		array = cannibalism_scored_target_countries
		scores = cannibalism_scored_target_values
	}
}

cannibalism_get_wendigo_scored_targets = {
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scored_target_countries
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scored_target_values
	get_sorted_scored_countries_temp = {
		scorer = cannibalism_wendigo_target_scorer
		array = cannibalism_scored_target_countries
		scores = cannibalism_scored_target_values
	}
}

cannibalism_clear_scored_target_runtime = {
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scored_target_countries
	clear_temp_array = cannibalism_scored_target_values
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scored_target_index = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_scored_target_value = 0 }
}

cannibalism_unified_apply_current_scored_target_priority = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_current_scored_target_value
				value = constant:cannibalism_target_score.high_score
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_target_ai.unified_high }
		add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_target_ai.unified_high }
		add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_target_ai.unified_high }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_current_scored_target_value
				value = constant:cannibalism_target_score.medium_score
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_target_ai.unified_medium }
		add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_target_ai.unified_medium }
		add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_target_ai.unified_medium }
	}
	else = {
		add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_target_ai.unified_low }
		add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_target_ai.unified_low }
		add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_target_ai.unified_low }
	}
}

cannibalism_wendigo_apply_current_scored_target_priority = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_current_scored_target_value
				value = constant:cannibalism_target_score.high_score
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_locked }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.postlock_target_high }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.postlock_target_high }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.postlock_target_high }
		}
		else = {
			add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_high }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_high }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_high }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_current_scored_target_value
				value = constant:cannibalism_target_score.medium_score
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_locked }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.postlock_target_medium }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.postlock_target_medium }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.postlock_target_medium }
		}
		else = {
			add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_medium }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_medium }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_medium }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_locked }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.postlock_target_low }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.postlock_target_low }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.postlock_target_low }
		}
		else = {
			add_ai_strategy = { type = conquer id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_low }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = antagonize id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_low }
			add_ai_strategy = { type = front_unit_request id = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.prelock_target_low }
		}
	}
}

# Pre-lock focus rewards may rescore at several milestones. Add each target's
# strategy band once so repeated focus calls can discover new enemies without
# stacking duplicate entries for countries already prioritized.
cannibalism_wendigo_apply_new_scored_enemy_priority = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				is_in_array = {
					array = cannibalism_wendigo_prelock_scored_priority_targets
					value = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target
				}
			}
		}
		cannibalism_wendigo_apply_current_scored_target_priority = yes
		add_to_array = { cannibalism_wendigo_prelock_scored_priority_targets = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target }
	}
}

cannibalism_unified_apply_scored_campaign_priorities = {
	cannibalism_get_unified_scored_targets = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scored_target_index = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scored_target_index
				value = cannibalism_scored_target_countries^num
				compare = less_than
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_scored_target_value = cannibalism_scored_target_values^cannibalism_scored_target_index }
		var:cannibalism_scored_target_countries^cannibalism_scored_target_index = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_current_scored_target }
		cannibalism_unified_apply_current_scored_target_priority = yes
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scored_target_index = 1 }
	}
	cannibalism_clear_scored_target_runtime = yes
}

cannibalism_wendigo_apply_scored_enemy_priorities = {
	cannibalism_get_wendigo_scored_targets = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scored_target_index = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scored_target_index
				value = cannibalism_scored_target_countries^num
				compare = less_than
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_scored_target_value = cannibalism_scored_target_values^cannibalism_scored_target_index }
		var:cannibalism_scored_target_countries^cannibalism_scored_target_index = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_current_scored_target }
		cannibalism_wendigo_apply_new_scored_enemy_priority = yes
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scored_target_index = 1 }
	}
	cannibalism_clear_scored_target_runtime = yes
}

# One-shot post-lock helper. The reserved super-event effect should call this
# instead of applying the Wendigo branch to every country indiscriminately.
cannibalism_wendigo_apply_scored_terminal_priorities = {
	cannibalism_get_wendigo_scored_targets = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scored_target_index = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_scored_target_index
				value = cannibalism_scored_target_countries^num
				compare = less_than
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_scored_target_value = cannibalism_scored_target_values^cannibalism_scored_target_index }
		var:cannibalism_scored_target_countries^cannibalism_scored_target_index = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_current_scored_target }
		cannibalism_wendigo_apply_current_scored_target_priority = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target }
				NOT = { has_wargoal_against = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target }
			}
			create_wargoal = { type = annex_everything target = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target expire = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target }
				can_declare_war_on = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target
			}
			declare_war_on = { target = event_target:cannibalism_current_scored_target type = annex_everything }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_scored_target_index = 1 }
	}
	cannibalism_clear_scored_target_runtime = yes
}
