# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 REVEAL AND UNIFICATION EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Selects a player-safe warlord host, creates the dedicated CBL country,
# preserves technology, troops, wars, route history, nodes, and spread-ledger
# identities, reveals the internal character only after the public flag, and
# resolves every surviving warlord through explicit submission or resistance.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Weighted host selection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_calculate_current_unification_host_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = constant:cannibalism_unification.base_host_score }
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = constant:cannibalism_unification.human_host_score }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = num_of_controlled_states }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = constant:cannibalism_unification.state_score }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = cannibalism_unification_score_component }

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = num_divisions }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = constant:cannibalism_unification.division_score }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = cannibalism_unification_score_component }

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_controlled_population_k = 0 }
	every_controlled_state = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_controlled_population_k = state_population_k }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = cannibalism_unification_controlled_population_k }
	divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = constant:cannibalism_unification.population_k_per_million }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = constant:cannibalism_unification.population_score_per_million }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = cannibalism_unification_score_component }

	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_larder }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = cannibalism_larder }
		divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = constant:cannibalism_unification.larder_score_divisor }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = cannibalism_unification_score_component }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_network_alignment }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = cannibalism_network_alignment }
		divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = constant:cannibalism_unification.alignment_score_divisor }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = cannibalism_unification_score_component }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_inbound_spread_count }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = cannibalism_inbound_spread_count }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = constant:cannibalism_unification.network_centrality_score }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = cannibalism_unification_score_component }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_outbound_spread_count }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = cannibalism_outbound_spread_count }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_score_component = constant:cannibalism_unification.network_centrality_score }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = cannibalism_unification_score_component }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { any_controlled_state = { is_coastal = yes naval_base > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = constant:cannibalism_unification.port_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { capital_scope = { OR = { supply_node > 0 naval_base > 0 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = constant:cannibalism_unification.host_capital_supply_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { capital_scope = { rail_way > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = constant:cannibalism_unification.host_rail_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_convergence_leverage_open }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.convergence_leverage_host_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_manipulation_endgame_open }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.manipulation_endgame_host_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			capital_scope = {
				NOT = { any_neighbor_state = { is_controlled_by = PREV } }
				is_island_state = no
			}
		}
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_score = constant:cannibalism_unification.host_isolation_penalty }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_current_unification_host_score
		min = constant:cannibalism_unification.minimum_host_score
		max = constant:cannibalism_unification.maximum_host_score
	}
}

cannibalism_consider_current_unification_host_candidate = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_unification_host_id = THIS.id }
	cannibalism_calculate_current_unification_host_score = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_current_unification_host_score
					value = cannibalism_best_unification_host_score
					compare = greater_than
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_current_unification_host_score
						value = cannibalism_best_unification_host_score
						compare = equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_current_unification_host_id
						value = cannibalism_best_unification_host_id
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_unification_host_score = cannibalism_current_unification_host_score }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_unification_host_id = cannibalism_current_unification_host_id }
		save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_unification_host
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_host_generation = cannibalism_actor_generation }
	}
}

cannibalism_select_unification_host = {
	clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_unification_host
	clear_variable = global.cannibalism_unification_host_generation
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_unification_host_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_unification_host_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_human_unification_host_found = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				cannibalism_is_viable_unification_host = yes
				is_ai = no
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_human_unification_host_found = 1 }
			cannibalism_consider_current_unification_host_candidate = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_human_unification_host_found < 1 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
			if = {
				limit = {
					cannibalism_is_viable_unification_host = yes
					is_ai = yes
				}
				cannibalism_consider_current_unification_host_candidate = yes
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_host_score = cannibalism_best_unification_host_score }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Host inheritance and reusable-slot release
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_capture_current_warlord_inheritance = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_hierarchy = cannibalism_hierarchy }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_larder_route = cannibalism_larder_route }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_network_route = cannibalism_network_route }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_larder = cannibalism_larder }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_frenzy = cannibalism_frenzy }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_alignment = cannibalism_network_alignment }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_consumed_population = cannibalism_consumed_population }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_consumed_population_k = cannibalism_consumed_population_k }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_warlord_origin = cannibalism_warlord_origin }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_warlord_region = cannibalism_warlord_region }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_warlord_name_index = cannibalism_warlord_name_index }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_warlord_slot_index = cannibalism_warlord_slot_index }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_warlord_personality = cannibalism_warlord_personality }

	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_island = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_siege = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_march = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_island_host } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_island = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_siege_commune } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_siege = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_march_host } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_march = 1 } }
}

cannibalism_apply_inherited_host_identity_to_cbl = {
	set_variable = { cannibalism_hierarchy = cannibalism_inherited_hierarchy }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_larder_route = cannibalism_inherited_larder_route }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_network_route = cannibalism_inherited_network_route }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = cannibalism_inherited_frenzy }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = cannibalism_inherited_alignment }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population = cannibalism_inherited_consumed_population }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_consumed_population_k = cannibalism_inherited_consumed_population_k }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_inherited_larder }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_global_larder }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_unification.global_larder_maximum }
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_larder = cannibalism_larder }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_command_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_authority }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_authority }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_world_hostility = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_world_hostility }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_terminal_progress = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_terminal_progress }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_hierarchy = constant:cannibalism_hierarchy.personal_tyranny } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_personal_tyranny
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_personal_authority }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_hierarchy = constant:cannibalism_hierarchy.feast_council } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_feast_council
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_council_authority }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_hierarchy = constant:cannibalism_hierarchy.pack_confederacy } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_pack_confederacy
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_confederate_authority }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_larder_route = constant:cannibalism_larder_route.rapid_consumption } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_rapid_consumption
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_rapid_frenzy }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_world_hostility = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_rapid_hostility }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_terminal_progress = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_rapid_terminal_progress }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_larder_route = constant:cannibalism_larder_route.managed_herds } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_managed_herds
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_managed_larder }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_managed_authority }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_world_hostility = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_managed_hostility }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_larder_route = constant:cannibalism_larder_route.mobile_larder } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_mobile_larder
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_larder_mobile
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_mobile_larder }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_mobile_convoys }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_mobile_trains }
		add_fuel = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_mobile_fuel
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_network_route = constant:cannibalism_network_route.alignment } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_network_alignment
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_alignment_network_alignment }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_alignment_authority }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_network_route = constant:cannibalism_network_route.manipulation } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_network_manipulation
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_terminal_progress = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_manipulation_terminal_progress }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_world_hostility = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_manipulation_hostility }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_network_route = constant:cannibalism_network_route.defiance } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_network_defiance
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_defiance_authority }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_world_hostility = constant:cannibalism_unification.inherited_defiance_hostility }
	}

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_island > 0 } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_island_knowledge set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_inherited }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_siege > 0 } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_siege_knowledge set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_inherited }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_march > 0 } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_march_knowledge set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_inherited }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_unification.global_larder_maximum }
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_larder = cannibalism_larder }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_frenzy min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_network_alignment min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_world_hostility min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_terminal_progress min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_unified_authority min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
}

# origin knowledge without replacing the opening host's active route variables.

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_hierarchy = constant:cannibalism_hierarchy.personal_tyranny } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_personal_tyranny }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_hierarchy = constant:cannibalism_hierarchy.feast_council } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_feast_council }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_hierarchy = constant:cannibalism_hierarchy.pack_confederacy } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_pack_confederacy }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_larder_route = constant:cannibalism_larder_route.rapid_consumption } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_rapid_consumption }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_larder_route = constant:cannibalism_larder_route.managed_herds } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_managed_herds }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_larder_route = constant:cannibalism_larder_route.mobile_larder } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_mobile_larder }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_network_route = constant:cannibalism_network_route.alignment } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_network_alignment }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_network_route = constant:cannibalism_network_route.manipulation } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_network_manipulation }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_network_route = constant:cannibalism_network_route.defiance } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_inherited_network_defiance }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_island > 0 } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_island_knowledge set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_inherited }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_siege > 0 } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_siege_knowledge set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_inherited }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_origin_march > 0 } } set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_march_knowledge set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_inherited }
}

# Revealed unified and transformed hosts retain the two paid warlord-era unit
# families that are not duplicated by the unified war-machine contracts.
# Their normal template queue remains locked; each formation still consumes
# one valid state's population through the canonical Deaths transaction.
cannibalism_open_inherited_warlord_recruitment = {
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_recruitment_open
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_basic_recruitment_open
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_network_cadre_open
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_scavenger_warbands_raised } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_scavenger_warbands_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_network_cadres_raised } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_network_cadres_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
}

cannibalism_prepare_current_warlord_slot_for_unification = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_absorbed_warlord_slot_index = cannibalism_warlord_slot_index }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_absorbed_warlord_slot_generation = cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation }
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_integration_release_country
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS } }
		remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS }
	}
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_convergence_participant
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_integration_release_pending
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_index
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_warlord_slot_index
				value = cannibalism_absorbed_warlord_slot_index
				compare = equals
			}
			check_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation
				value = cannibalism_absorbed_warlord_slot_generation
				compare = equals
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_event_target = cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country
				event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country = { exists = yes }
				NOT = { is_core_of = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country }
			}
			add_state_core = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_core_of = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_integration_release_country }
			remove_state_core = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_integration_release_country
		}
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_state
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_transfer_selected
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_formation_pending
		clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_index
		clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation
	}
	# The in-use flags and country incarnation remain intact until on_annex calls
	# the canonical reset and the reference audit authorizes final release.
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Runtime reference migration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_migrate_runtime_references_to_unified_country = {
	# Contract: cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country and
	# cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country must both be valid
	# regular event targets. Never infer the destination from ROOT: absorption
	# runs from the responding warlord's event scope.
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_runtime_migration_result = 0 }
	# The spread owner validates all nine aligned arrays, updates both country
	# directions and exact state metadata, then rebuilds every derived cache.
	cannibalism_migrate_spread_entries_between_countries = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_migration_result > 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_node_states
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = cannibalism_node_source_country
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_node_source_country
						value = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				set_variable = { cannibalism_node_source_country = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_node_source_country_generation = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country.cannibalism_actor_generation }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = cannibalism_external_infection_source
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_external_infection_source
						value = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country
						compare = equals
					}
				}
				set_variable = { cannibalism_external_infection_source = event_target:cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_runtime_migration_result = 1 }
	}
}

# Event 014-owned additive technology union. The current country receives
# compatible researched technologies from event_target:technology_union_donor.
union_compatible_researched_technologies_from_donor = {
	for_each_loop = {
		array = event_target:technology_union_donor.researched_techs
		value = technology_union_entry
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_tech = var:technology_union_entry }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:flexible_line } }
					NOT = { has_tech = streamlined_line }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:streamlined_line } }
					NOT = { has_tech = flexible_line }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:concentrated_industry }
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:concentrated_industry2 }
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:concentrated_industry3 }
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:concentrated_industry4 }
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:concentrated_industry5 }
						}
					}
					NOT = { has_tech = dispersed_industry }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:dispersed_industry }
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:dispersed_industry2 }
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:dispersed_industry3 }
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:dispersed_industry4 }
							check_variable = { technology_union_entry = token:dispersed_industry5 }
						}
					}
					NOT = { has_tech = concentrated_industry }
				}
			}
			set_technology = {
				var:technology_union_entry = 1
				popup = no
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_unified_country_ai_strategy = {
	add_ai_strategy = { type = build_army value = constant:cannibalism_ai_strategy.hannibal_build_army }
	add_ai_strategy = { type = equipment_production_factor id = infantry value = constant:cannibalism_ai_strategy.hannibal_build_infantry }
	add_ai_strategy = { type = equipment_production_factor id = support value = constant:cannibalism_ai_strategy.hannibal_build_support }
	add_ai_strategy = { type = template_prio id = infantry value = constant:cannibalism_ai_strategy.hannibal_build_army }
	add_ai_strategy = { type = role_ratio id = infantry value = constant:cannibalism_ai_strategy.hannibal_build_infantry }
}

cannibalism_create_unified_country_from_selected_host = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_creation_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_selected_unification_host_is_valid = yes }
		event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country
			save_event_target_as = technology_union_donor
			capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_unification_capital_state }
			cannibalism_capture_current_warlord_inheritance = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_host_was_human = 0 }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unification_host_was_human = 1 } }
		}

		# The public flag is set before CBL, its leader, portrait, name, or tree
		# can become visible to any player-facing system.
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_active
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_scenario_convergence_contract
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_broken
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_unification_pending
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_stage = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.unified }
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_convergence_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_convergence_rebuild_date

		event_target:cannibalism_unification_capital_state = {
			set_state_owner_to = CBL
			set_state_controller_to = CBL
		}
		CBL = {
			union_compatible_researched_technologies_from_donor = yes
			set_research_slots = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_research_slots
			set_capital = event_target:cannibalism_unification_capital_state
			set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_integrated_named_commander_count = 1 }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_integrated_servant_count = 0 }
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_country
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_decisions_open
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_focus_tree_available
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_reveal_host
			load_focus_tree = { tree = cannibalism_unified_focus_tree keep_completed = no }
			cannibalism_unified_initialize_decision_values = yes
			cannibalism_apply_unified_country_ai_strategy = yes
			cannibalism_register_current_country_actor = yes
			cannibalism_apply_inherited_host_identity_to_cbl = yes
			cannibalism_create_current_warlord_templates = yes
			cannibalism_open_inherited_warlord_recruitment = yes
			country_lock_all_division_template = yes
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = cannibalism_unified_command_burden } } add_ideas = cannibalism_unified_command_burden }
			add_country_leader_role = {
				character = CBL_hannibal
				promote_leader = yes
				country_leader = {
					ideology = ritual_predation
					traits = { cannibalism_hannibal_network_command }
				}
			}
			add_named_threat = { threat = constant:cannibalism_unification.reveal_world_tension name = cannibalism_reveal_world_tension }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unification_host_was_human > 0 } }
			event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = { cannibalism_achievement_capture_current_player_ledger = yes }
			CBL = {
				cannibalism_achievement_apply_captured_player_ledger = yes
				set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_player_unification_host
				change_tag_from = event_target:cannibalism_unification_host
			}
		}

		CBL = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country
			cannibalism_migrate_runtime_references_to_unified_country = yes
			set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_name_index = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_name_index }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_origin = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_origin }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_region = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_region }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_slot_index = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_slot_index }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_personality = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_personality }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.host_commander }
			cannibalism_record_integrated_warlord_slot = yes
			cannibalism_create_integrated_warlord_commander = yes
		}

		# Join the selected host's existing wars before annexing it, so the new
		# country cannot shed the player's active fronts during the transfer.
		event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
			every_enemy_country = {
				CBL = {
					add_to_war = {
						targeted_alliance = event_target:cannibalism_unification_host
						enemy = PREV
						hostility_reason = ally
					}
				}
			}
			cannibalism_prepare_current_warlord_slot_for_unification = yes
		}
		CBL = {
			annex_country = {
				target = event_target:cannibalism_unification_host
				transfer_troops = yes
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_unification_host
			save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_latest_actor
			cannibalism_select_current_country_as_pulse_anchor = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_stage_to_record = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_iii_stage }
			cannibalism_record_current_evolution = yes
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_host_generation = cannibalism_actor_generation }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.reveal_chaos }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_reveal }
			cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
			cannibalism_emit_reveal_super_event = yes
			country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.70 hours = @CANNIBALISM_REVEAL_HOST_EVENT_HOURS }
			news_event = { id = chaosx.news.90 hours = @CANNIBALISM_REVEAL_NEWS_HOURS }
		}

		# Rebuild the response roster at reveal so a warlord created during the
		# warning window cannot escape submission, autonomy, or resistance merely
		# because it was absent from the original convergence snapshot.
		resize_array = { global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes
					NOT = { tag = CBL }
					NOT = { has_capitulated = yes }
				}
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
				set_country_flag = cannibalism_convergence_participant
				add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS }
				country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.71 hours = @CANNIBALISM_WARLORD_RESPONSE_HOURS }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_creation_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_execute_evolution_iii_reveal = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
		}
		# Reveal is transactional with respect to the foreign-route ledger. A
		# malformed queue remains flagged for diagnosis and cannot be carried
		# into either irreversible unification branch.
		cannibalism_validate_spread_queue = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_spread_queue_validation_result > 0 } }
			cannibalism_try_execute_wendigo_unification = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_unification_result < 1 } }
				cannibalism_select_unification_host = yes
				if = {
					limit = { cannibalism_selected_unification_host_is_valid = yes }
					cannibalism_create_unified_country_from_selected_host = yes
				}
				else = {
					cannibalism_break_convergence = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Warlord dispositions after the public reveal

cannibalism_add_current_warlord_larder_to_unified_host = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_integrated_larder_transfer = cannibalism_larder }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_integrated_larder_transfer = cannibalism_integration_larder_factor }
	subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_integrated_larder_transfer }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_max }
	event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_integrated_larder_transfer }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_unification.global_larder_maximum }
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_larder = cannibalism_larder }
	}
}

cannibalism_absorb_current_warlord_into_unified_host = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_absorption_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
			cannibalism_has_valid_unification_destination = yes
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_absorbed_warlord
		save_event_target_as = technology_union_donor
		cannibalism_capture_current_warlord_inheritance = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_absorbed_warlord_was_human = 0 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_absorbed_warlord_was_human = 1 } }
		event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country
			cannibalism_migrate_runtime_references_to_unified_country = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_runtime_migration_result > 0 } }
			cannibalism_add_current_warlord_larder_to_unified_host = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
				union_compatible_researched_technologies_from_donor = yes
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_name_index = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_name_index }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_origin = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_origin }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_region = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_region }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_slot_index = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_slot_index }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_personality = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_personality }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_disposition = cannibalism_requested_warlord_disposition }
				cannibalism_apply_absorbed_warlord_inheritance_to_unified_host = yes
				cannibalism_record_integrated_warlord_slot = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							check_variable = { cannibalism_requested_warlord_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.retained_commander }
							check_variable = { cannibalism_requested_warlord_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.host_commander }
						}
					}
					cannibalism_create_integrated_warlord_commander = yes
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_integrated_named_commander_count = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_requested_warlord_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.disposable_servant } }
					cannibalism_create_integrated_warlord_servant = yes
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_integrated_servant_count = 1 }
				}
			}
			every_enemy_country = {
				limit = { NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_unification_host } }
				event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
					add_to_war = {
						targeted_alliance = event_target:cannibalism_absorbed_warlord
						enemy = PREV
						hostility_reason = ally
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_absorbed_warlord_was_human > 0 } }
				event_target:cannibalism_absorbed_warlord = { cannibalism_achievement_capture_current_player_ledger = yes }
				event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
					cannibalism_achievement_apply_captured_player_ledger = yes
					change_tag_from = event_target:cannibalism_absorbed_warlord
				}
			}
			cannibalism_prepare_current_warlord_slot_for_unification = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
				annex_country = {
					target = event_target:cannibalism_absorbed_warlord
					transfer_troops = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_integrated_warlord_count = 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_absorption_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_submit_current_warlord_and_retain_command = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_requested_warlord_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.retained_commander }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_integration_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_unification.command_submission_larder_factor }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_submission_preparation_open }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_integration_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.submission_larder_factor_bonus }
	}
	cannibalism_absorb_current_warlord_into_unified_host = yes
}

cannibalism_submit_current_warlord_and_surrender_warband = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_requested_warlord_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.disposable_servant }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_integration_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_unification.surrender_submission_larder_factor }
	cannibalism_absorb_current_warlord_into_unified_host = yes
}

cannibalism_bargain_current_warlord_autonomy = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
			cannibalism_has_valid_unification_destination = yes
		}
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_convergence_participant
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS } }
			remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_autonomous_warlord_governor
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.autonomous_governor }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_integration_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_unification.autonomy_tribute_larder_factor }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_manipulation_endgame_open }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_integration_larder_factor = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.manipulation_autonomy_tribute_relief }
		}
		cannibalism_add_current_warlord_larder_to_unified_host = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = { puppet = ROOT add_to_variable = { cannibalism_autonomous_warlord_count = 1 } }
	}
}

cannibalism_resist_unified_host = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
			cannibalism_has_valid_unification_destination = yes
		}
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_convergence_participant
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS } }
			remove_from_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_resistant_warlord
		set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.resistant_rival }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_warlord_resistance_to_unification days = @CANNIBALISM_WARLORD_RESISTANCE_DAYS }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_independent_fortification_open }
			capital_scope = {
				add_building_construction = { type = bunker level = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.independent_capital_fort_levels instant_build = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_defiance_endgame_open }
			capital_scope = {
				add_building_construction = { type = bunker level = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.defiance_resistance_fort_levels instant_build = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cannibalism_unification_host } }
			event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = { declare_war_on = { target = ROOT type = annex_everything } }
		}
	}
}

		}

			limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = event_target:cannibalism_unification_host } }
			event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = { declare_war_on = { target = ROOT type = annex_everything } }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_unified_initialize_decision_values = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_decision_runtime_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_decision_runtime_initialized
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_command_operations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_larder_operations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_legions_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_bone_guards_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_island_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_siege_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_march_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_army_operations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_naval_operations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_air_operations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_cell_operations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_campaigns_prepared = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_postwar_integrations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_counterwar_operations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		clear_array = cannibalism_unified_defeated_enemy_entries
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_distinct_enemy_capitulations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_battlefield_receipts = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_rout_harvest_receipts = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_convoy_harvest_receipts = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
	cannibalism_unified_refresh_contract_capacities = yes
	cannibalism_unified_refresh_operational_profiles = yes
	cannibalism_unified_focus_refresh_terminal_route = yes
}

cannibalism_unified_refresh_contract_capacities = {
	set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_command_capacity = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_larder_capacity = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_army_capacity = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_navy_capacity = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_air_capacity = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_cell_capacity = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_campaign_capacity = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_counterwar_capacity = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }

	# Command contracts
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_public_command_established } add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_command_capacity = constant:cannibalism_unified_contract.point } }

cannibalism_unified_apply_counterpressure_to_current_target = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_counterpressure_duration = cannibalism_unified_hostility_counterpressure_days }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_hostility_tier = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.three } }
		event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_target = {
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_unified_enemy_counterpressure_total days = cannibalism_unified_counterpressure_duration }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_hostility_tier = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.two } }
		event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_target = {
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_unified_enemy_counterpressure_mobilized days = cannibalism_unified_counterpressure_duration }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_hostility_tier = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one } }
		event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_target = {
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_unified_enemy_counterpressure_pressure days = cannibalism_unified_counterpressure_duration }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_unified_pay_current_larder_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_negative_cost = cannibalism_unified_larder_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_negative_cost = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.minus_one }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_unified_negative_cost }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_unification.global_larder_maximum }
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_larder = cannibalism_larder }
}

# Called in CBL scope from the capitulation on-action after it saves
# event_target:cannibalism_defeated_country. Each defeated country can issue
# receipts only once per unified runtime, so repeated capitulation callbacks do
# not manufacture battlefield harvest capacity.
cannibalism_unified_record_distinct_enemy_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_unified_decisions_are_open = yes
			has_event_target = cannibalism_defeated_country
			event_target:cannibalism_defeated_country = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { tag = CBL }
				NOT = { is_cannibalism_active_country = yes }
			}
			NOT = {
				is_in_array = {
					array = cannibalism_unified_defeated_enemy_entries
					value = event_target:cannibalism_defeated_country
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_array = {
			array = cannibalism_unified_defeated_enemy_entries
			value = event_target:cannibalism_defeated_country
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_distinct_enemy_capitulations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_receipt_flag_days = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.battlefield_receipt_days }
		event_target:cannibalism_defeated_country = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_unified_battlefield_victory_receipted days = cannibalism_unified_receipt_flag_days }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_larder_method_battlefield
				has_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_major_victory_receipts_open
			}
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_battlefield_receipts = cannibalism_unified_battlefield_receipts_per_victory }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_battlefield_harvest_caps_required }
				clamp_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_unified_battlefield_receipts
					min = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero
					max = cannibalism_unified_battlefield_receipt_cap
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_unified_record_command_operation = {
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_command_operations = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_command_mission_actions = cannibalism_unified_command_mission_progress }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_command_mission_active } }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_command_mission_active
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_command_mission_duration = cannibalism_unified_command_mission_days }
		activate_mission = cannibalism_unified_command_mission
	}
	cannibalism_unified_refresh_operational_profiles = yes
}

cannibalism_unified_execute_absorb_warlord = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_larder_cost = cannibalism_unified_absorb_larder_cost }
	cannibalism_unified_pay_current_larder_cost = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = cannibalism_unified_absorb_command_cost }
	cannibalism_pay_current_command_cost = yes
	event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_target = {
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
		cannibalism_submit_current_warlord_and_retain_command = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = cannibalism_unified_absorb_authority_gain }
	cannibalism_unified_focus_clamp_values = yes
	cannibalism_unified_record_command_operation = yes
}

cannibalism_unified_execute_appoint_governor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = cannibalism_unified_governor_manpower_cost }
	cannibalism_pay_current_manpower_cost = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = cannibalism_unified_governor_support_cost }
	cannibalism_pay_current_support_equipment_cost = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = cannibalism_unified_governor_command_cost }
	cannibalism_pay_current_command_cost = yes
	event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_state = {
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_unified_governor_appointed
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_governor_local_supply = ROOT.cannibalism_unified_governor_local_supply }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_governor_resistance = ROOT.cannibalism_unified_governor_resistance }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_unified_governor_administration }
		add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.governor_infrastructure_levels instant_build = yes }
	}

cannibalism_unified_execute_state_consumption = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_consumption_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_unified_decision_state }
		event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = cannibalism_unified_population_cost_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = cannibalism_unified_consumption_mode }
		cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied }
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_population_loss_applied value = cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people compare = equals }
			}
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_command_cost > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = cannibalism_unified_command_cost } cannibalism_pay_current_command_cost = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_truck_cost > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = cannibalism_unified_truck_cost } cannibalism_pay_current_truck_cost = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_train_cost > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = cannibalism_unified_train_cost } cannibalism_pay_current_train_cost = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_support_cost > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = cannibalism_unified_support_cost } cannibalism_pay_current_support_equipment_cost = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_convoy_cost > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_cost = cannibalism_unified_convoy_cost } cannibalism_pay_current_convoy_cost = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_fuel_cost > 0 } } cannibalism_unified_pay_current_fuel_cost = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_skip_operation_record < 1 } }
				cannibalism_unified_record_larder_operation = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_consumption_result = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_skip_operation_record = 0 }
	}
}

cannibalism_unified_execute_rapid_consumption = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_population_cost_k = constant:cannibalism_unified_decision_cost.rapid_population_k }

				owner = event_target:cannibalism_unified_recruitment_actor
				allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
			}
		}
		START_EXPERIENCE = "[?cannibalism_unified_unit_start_experience]"
		START_EQUIPMENT = "[?cannibalism_unified_unit_start_equipment]"

cannibalism_unified_execute_recruitment = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_unified_decision_state }
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_unified_recruitment_actor
		event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = cannibalism_unified_population_cost_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.recruitment }
		cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied }
				check_variable = { var = cannibalism_population_loss_applied value = cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people compare = equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_larder_cost = cannibalism_unified_recruitment_larder_cost }
			cannibalism_unified_pay_current_larder_cost = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_manpower = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_manpower = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.recruitment_manpower_factor }
			round_temp_variable = cannibalism_unified_recruitment_manpower
			add_manpower = cannibalism_unified_recruitment_manpower
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.unit_start_experience }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_unit_start_equipment = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.unit_start_equipment }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_unit_start_manpower = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.unit_start_manpower }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template.legion } }
				event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_state = { cannibalism_unified_spawn_legion = yes }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_legions_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template.bone_guard } }
				event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_state = { cannibalism_unified_spawn_bone_guard = yes }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_bone_guards_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template.island_reavers }
						check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template.siege_eaters }
						check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template.march_predation_column }
					}
				}
				event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_state = { cannibalism_unified_spawn_origin_specialist = yes }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template.island_reavers } }
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_island_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template.siege_eaters } }
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_siege_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_unified_recruitment_template.march_predation_column } }
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_march_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
				}
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_unified_decision_state = {
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.recruitment_state_cooldown_days }
				set_state_flag = { flag = cannibalism_recruitment_cooldown days = cannibalism_unified_recruitment_cooldown_days }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_unified_decisions_are_open = yes }
				cannibalism_unified_record_war_machine_operation = yes
				cannibalism_unified_focus_refresh_terminal_route = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					cannibalism_wendigo_command_is_open = yes
					has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_cannibal_recruitment_open
				}
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cannibal_formations_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
				cannibalism_unified_refresh_operational_profiles = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_recruitment_result = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.one }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = 0 }
	}
}

		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_counterwar_enemy_organization = ROOT.cannibalism_unified_counterwar_enemy_organization }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_unified_counterwar_disruption days = cannibalism_unified_operation_duration }
	}
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_world_hostility = cannibalism_unified_counterwar_relief }
	cannibalism_unified_focus_clamp_values = yes
	cannibalism_unified_record_counterwar_operation = yes
}

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 UNIFIED COUNTRY FOCUS EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Reward implementation for the 108-focus CBL post-reveal tree. These effects
# establish exact flags, route variables, staged-idea contracts, decision-family
# contracts, and bounded map construction. They never add population, Larder,
# manpower, equipment, divisions, templates, or OOBs. All recruitment and
# consumption flags require costed decision implementations that call the Event
# 014 Deaths-accounting transaction pipeline.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared value, construction, idea, and terminal helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_unified_focus_initialize_values = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_authority } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_authority }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_world_hostility } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_world_hostility = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_world_hostility }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_terminal_progress } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_terminal_progress = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_terminal_progress }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_warlord_disposition } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_warlord_disposition = @cannibalism_unified_route_undecided }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_hierarchy } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_hierarchy = @cannibalism_unified_route_undecided }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_larder_method } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_larder_method = @cannibalism_unified_route_undecided }
	}
}

	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_unified_authority min = @cannibalism_unified_meter_min max = @cannibalism_unified_meter_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_world_hostility min = @cannibalism_unified_meter_min max = @cannibalism_unified_meter_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_terminal_progress min = @cannibalism_unified_meter_min max = @cannibalism_unified_meter_max }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_frenzy }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_frenzy min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_max }
	}
}

cannibalism_unified_focus_refresh_terminal_route = {
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_operational_larder_package
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_operational_army_package
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_operational_expansion_package
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_operational_counterwar_package
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_terminal_route_ready
	clr_country_flag = cannibalism_terminal_route_complete
	set_variable = { cannibalism_terminal_progress = @cannibalism_unified_meter_min }
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_unified_larder_package_is_operational = yes }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_operational_larder_package
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_terminal_progress = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.terminal_package_progress }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_unified_army_package_is_operational = yes }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_operational_army_package
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_terminal_progress = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.terminal_package_progress }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_unified_expansion_package_is_operational = yes }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_operational_expansion_package
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_terminal_progress = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.terminal_package_progress }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_unified_counterwar_package_is_operational = yes }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_operational_counterwar_package
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_terminal_progress = constant:cannibalism_unified_operation.terminal_package_progress }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = CBL
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_country
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country }
			cannibalism_unified_all_operational_packages_are_ready = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_terminal_route_ready
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_terminal_route_complete
	}
	cannibalism_unified_focus_clamp_values = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ordinary world-end. The shared terminal effect remains owned by the Event 014
# runtime layer. This file calls it only after the same strict readiness trigger
# and explicit greater-than-1000 Chaos test used by both terminal focuses.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_unified_focus_final_global_mobilization = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_can_complete_ordinary_world_end = yes
			check_variable = { global.chaos_meter_value > constant:cannibalism_evolution_threshold.world_end_chaos }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_final_global_mobilization_active
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_universal_enemy_decisions_open
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_terminal_consumption_preparation_open
	}
}

cannibalism_unified_focus_dismantle_the_ordinary_world = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_can_complete_ordinary_world_end = yes
			check_variable = { global.chaos_meter_value > constant:cannibalism_evolution_threshold.world_end_chaos }
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_terminal_mobilization_prepared
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_world_end_focus_complete
		cannibalism_try_start_ordinary_world_end = yes
	}
}

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source section: 014_cannibalism_warlord_decision_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 WARLORD DECISION EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Performs exact Deaths-backed state consumption and recruitment. Scripted
# units begin with no generated manpower or equipment; the exact population
# transaction fills the manpower pool and existing stockpiles reinforce them.
# ============================================================================

cannibalism_pay_current_warlord_larder_cost = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_recruitment_open }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_unified_larder_cost = cannibalism_warlord_larder_cost }
		cannibalism_unified_pay_current_larder_cost = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_larder_cost_negative = cannibalism_warlord_larder_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_larder_cost_negative = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.minus_one }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_warlord_larder_cost_negative }
		clamp_variable = {
			var = cannibalism_larder
			min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min
			max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_max
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_register_selected_state_to_current_warlord = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state
			has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = { is_controlled_by = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_node_source_actor }
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_active_node } }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_type = constant:cannibalism_node_type.warlord }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_opening.network_cell_strength }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_node_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.feeding_state }
				cannibalism_register_current_state_node = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_node_states value = THIS } } }
				add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_node_states value = THIS }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_state } }
				set_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_state
				event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor = { add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count = 1 } }
			}
			set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_index = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor.cannibalism_warlord_slot_index }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor.cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_node_source_country = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_node_source_country_generation = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor.cannibalism_actor_generation }
		}
	}
}
