	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_siege_commune }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.siege_eaters }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_origin_march_host }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_origin_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.march_column }
	}
}

cannibalism_prepare_warlord_recruitment_contract = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.unit_start_experience }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_equipment = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.unit_start_equipment }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_manpower = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.unit_start_manpower }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.recruitment_state_cooldown_days }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_survival_order_open }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruit_experience_small }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_origin_defense_open }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruit_experience_small }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_capital_repairs_open }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruitment_cooldown_reduction_small }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_lieutenant_assignments_open }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruit_experience_medium }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_hierarchy_routes_open }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruitment_cooldown_reduction_small }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_officer_training_open }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruit_experience_large }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_distributed_recruitment_open }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruitment_cooldown_reduction_large }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_workshop_conversion_open }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruitment_cooldown_reduction_medium }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_personal_guard_doctrine_open
			check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.bone_guard }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruit_experience_elite }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_leader_protection_open
			check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.bone_guard }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruit_experience_large }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_tyrant_doctrine_open }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruit_experience_large }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_council_doctrine_open }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruit_experience_medium }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruitment_cooldown_reduction_small }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_confederacy_doctrine_open }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruitment_cooldown_reduction_medium }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_warlord_unit_start_experience
		min = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.unit_start_experience
		max = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruit_experience_maximum
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_cooldown_days
		min = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.recruitment_cooldown_minimum
		max = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.recruitment_state_cooldown_days
	}
}

cannibalism_spawn_selected_warlord_recruitment_unit = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.origin_specialist } }
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor = { cannibalism_prepare_current_warlord_origin_specialist_template = yes }
		meta_effect = {
			text = { cannibalism_spawn_warlord_recruitment_template_[TEMPLATE] = yes }
			TEMPLATE = "[?cannibalism_warlord_origin_template|.0]"
		}
	}
	else = {
		meta_effect = {
			text = { cannibalism_spawn_warlord_recruitment_template_[TEMPLATE] = yes }
			TEMPLATE = "[?cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template|.0]"
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_record_current_warlord_recruitment = {
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_units_raised = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.scavenger_warband } }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_scavenger_warbands_raised = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.feast_cohort } }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_feast_cohorts_raised = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.origin_specialist } }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_origin_specialists_raised = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.bone_guard } }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_bone_guard_raised = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.network_cadre } }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_cadres_raised = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_execute_warlord_recruitment_transaction = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_result = 0 }
	cannibalism_prepare_warlord_recruitment_contract = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state
			check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_population_k > 0 }
			check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_larder_cost > 0 }
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.recruitment }
		cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_population_loss_applied
					value = cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes }
				cannibalism_register_selected_state_to_current_warlord = yes
			}
			cannibalism_pay_current_warlord_larder_cost = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_manpower = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_manpower = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.recruitment_manpower_factor }
			round_temp_variable = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_manpower
			add_manpower = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_manpower
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template < constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.emergency_reinforcement } }
				event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = { cannibalism_spawn_selected_warlord_recruitment_unit = yes }
				cannibalism_record_current_warlord_recruitment = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_workshop_conversion_open }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recovered_infantry = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.workshop_recovery_infantry }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = cannibalism_warlord_recovered_infantry }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_survival_order_open
					check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.emergency_reinforcement }
				}
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.frenzy_relief }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.command_integrity_gain }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_purge_decisions_open
					check_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_template = constant:cannibalism_recruitment_template.bone_guard }
				}
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.rapid_frenzy_gain }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.provincial_integrity_gain }
			}
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_frenzy min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_max }
			clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_command_integrity min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = {
				set_state_flag = { flag = cannibalism_recruitment_cooldown days = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_cooldown_days }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_result = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = 0 }
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_warlord_consumption_contracts = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_larder_inventory_open }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.larder_inventory_gain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_larder_accounting_open }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.larder_accounting_gain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_prisoner_ledger_open }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.prisoner_ledger_alignment_gain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_provincial_servants_open }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.provincial_integrity_gain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_rapid_consumption_open }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.rapid_frenzy_gain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_managed_herd_actions_open }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.managed_frenzy_relief }
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state }
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = {
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.feeding_district_strength_gain }
				clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_node_strength min = constant:cannibalism_network.min max = constant:cannibalism_network.max }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_mobile_larder_open }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_command_integrity = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.provincial_integrity_gain }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_state_exhaustion_risk
			has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = {
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_actions = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.state_exhaustion_action_increment }
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_frenzy min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_network_alignment min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_command_integrity min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max }
}

cannibalism_consume_selected_state_for_larder = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_consumption_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state }
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.feeding }
		cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied } }
			cannibalism_register_selected_state_to_current_warlord = yes
			cannibalism_apply_warlord_consumption_contracts = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_consumption_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_pay_warlord_operation_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_operation_larder_cost_negative = cannibalism_warlord_operation_larder_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_operation_larder_cost_negative = -1 }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_warlord_operation_larder_cost_negative }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_max }
	add_command_power = cannibalism_warlord_operation_command_spend
}

cannibalism_intensify_selected_feeding_district = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_intensification_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state
			cannibalism_warlord_can_pay_intensification_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = { cannibalism_state_can_be_intensified_by_current_warlord = yes }
		}
		add_command_power = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.intensification_command_spend
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_actor
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.silent_larder }
		cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied } }
			cannibalism_register_selected_state_to_current_warlord = yes
			cannibalism_apply_warlord_consumption_contracts = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_feeding_districts_open
					has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state
				}
				event_target:cannibalism_warlord_recruitment_state = {
					add_to_variable = { cannibalism_node_strength = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.feeding_district_strength_gain }
					clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_node_strength min = constant:cannibalism_network.min max = constant:cannibalism_network.max }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_council_votes_open }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.council_frenzy_relief }
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_network_alignment = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.operation_alignment_gain_small }
				clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_frenzy min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_max }
				clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_network_alignment min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_max }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_intensification_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_abandon_selected_exhausted_state = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_abandon_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_warlord_abandon_state
			cannibalism_warlord_can_pay_abandon_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_warlord_abandon_state = { cannibalism_state_can_be_abandoned_by_current_warlord = yes }
			has_variable = cannibalism_warlord_former_owner
			var:cannibalism_warlord_former_owner = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
		}
		add_command_power = constant:cannibalism_warlord_decision.abandon_command_spend
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_warlord_abandon_actor
		event_target:cannibalism_warlord_abandon_state = {
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_node_id = cannibalism_node_id }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_expected_node_generation = cannibalism_node_generation }
			cannibalism_begin_current_state_recovery = yes
			if = {
				limit = { is_core_of = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_abandon_actor }
				remove_state_core = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_abandon_actor
			}
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_warlord_state
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_commune_state
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_network_node
			clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_index
			clear_variable = cannibalism_warlord_slot_generation
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_warlord_slot_reference_count min = 0 max = constant:cannibalism_slot.maximum }
		var:cannibalism_warlord_former_owner = { transfer_state = event_target:cannibalism_warlord_abandon_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_abandon_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_warlord_origin_operation_recovery = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_origin_operation_larder_recovery > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_origin_operation_larder_recovery }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_max }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_origin_operation_infantry_recovery > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = cannibalism_origin_operation_infantry_recovery }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_origin_operation_support_recovery > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_origin_operation_support_recovery }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_origin_operation_convoy_recovery > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = convoy_1 amount = cannibalism_origin_operation_convoy_recovery }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_origin_operation_truck_recovery > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = motorized_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_origin_operation_truck_recovery }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_origin_operation_train_recovery > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = train_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_origin_operation_train_recovery }
	}
}

cannibalism_record_warlord_major_victory_harvest = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_battlefield_harvest_open
			has_event_target = cannibalism_defeated_country
			event_target:cannibalism_defeated_country = { exists = yes }
			NOT = {
				is_in_array = {
					array = cannibalism_warlord_harvested_countries
					value = event_target:cannibalism_defeated_country
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_array = {
			array = cannibalism_warlord_harvested_countries
			value = event_target:cannibalism_defeated_country
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.major_victory_larder_gain }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_major_victory_infantry = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.major_victory_infantry_recovery }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_major_victory_support = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.major_victory_support_recovery }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_battlefield_harvest_upgraded }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.major_victory_larder_bonus }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_major_victory_infantry = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.major_victory_infantry_bonus }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_major_victory_support = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.major_victory_support_bonus }
		}
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = cannibalism_warlord_major_victory_infantry }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_warlord_major_victory_support }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_major_victory_count = constant:cannibalism_warlord_contract.major_victory_count_increment }
		clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_larder min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_max }
	}
}

cannibalism_warlord_refresh_operating_order = {
	cannibalism_warlord_clear_operating_order = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_hierarchy_personal_tyranny }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_army_attack = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.personal_attack }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_planning_speed = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.personal_planning }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_command_power_gain = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.personal_command_gain }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_max_command_power = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.personal_max_command }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_stability = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.personal_stability }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_hierarchy_feast_council }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_army_organization = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.council_organization }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_planning_speed = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.council_planning }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_political_power = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.council_political_power }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_efficiency_gain = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.council_efficiency_gain }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_max_command_power = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.council_max_command }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_hierarchy_pack_confederacy }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_army_speed = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.confederacy_speed }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_organization_regain = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.confederacy_organization_regain }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_out_of_supply = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.confederacy_out_of_supply }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_army_defence = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.confederacy_defence }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_planning_speed = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.confederacy_planning }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_larder_order_complete
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_larder_rapid_consumption
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_training_time = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.rapid_training }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_organization_regain = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.rapid_organization_regain }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_army_attack = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.rapid_attack }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_supply_consumption = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.rapid_supply_consumption }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_stability = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.rapid_stability }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_larder_order_complete
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_larder_managed_herds
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_efficiency_gain = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.managed_efficiency_gain }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_max_efficiency = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.managed_max_efficiency }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_local_resources = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.managed_local_resources }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_supply_consumption = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.managed_supply_consumption }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_occupation_resistance = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.managed_occupation_resistance }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_larder_order_complete
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_larder_mobile
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_army_speed = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.mobile_speed }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_supply_consumption = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.mobile_supply_consumption }

		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_planning_speed = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.discipline_planning }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_organization_regain = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.discipline_organization_regain }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_army_attack = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.discipline_attack }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_supply_consumption = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.discipline_supply_consumption }
	}
	if = {

			has_country_flag = cannibalism_warlord_network_order_complete

		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_command_power_gain = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.defiance_command_gain }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_warlord_order_political_power = constant:cannibalism_warlord_order.defiance_political_power }

	}

cannibalism_warlord_focus_refresh_meters = {
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_frenzy min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.frenzy_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = cannibalism_network_alignment min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_min max = constant:cannibalism_consumption.alignment_max }
	cannibalism_refresh_country_penalty_variables = yes
}

cannibalism_warlord_focus_add_capital_infrastructure = {
	capital_scope = {
		add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = @cannibalism_warlord_focus_map_level instant_build = yes }
	}
}

cannibalism_warlord_focus_add_capital_defenses = {
	capital_scope = {
		add_building_construction = { type = bunker level = @cannibalism_warlord_focus_map_level instant_build = yes }
	}
}

cannibalism_warlord_focus_add_capital_workshop = {
	capital_scope = {
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = @cannibalism_warlord_focus_shared_slot
		add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = @cannibalism_warlord_focus_map_level instant_build = yes }
	}
}

cannibalism_warlord_focus_add_capital_port_capacity = {
	capital_scope = {
		add_building_construction = { type = naval_base level = @cannibalism_warlord_focus_map_level instant_build = yes }
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = @cannibalism_warlord_focus_shared_slot
		add_building_construction = { type = dockyard level = @cannibalism_warlord_focus_map_level instant_build = yes }
	}
}

# ============================================================================
# Consolidated source section: 014_cannibalism_wendigo_decision_effects.txt
# ============================================================================
# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 WENDIGO DECISION EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Executes post-reveal anchor, winter-logistics, population-backed recruitment,
# countdown, and counterwar actions. All population consumption uses the shared
# Event 014 Deaths-accounted transaction. New packs start empty and reinforce
# from the paid manpower pool and the country's existing equipment stockpile.
# ============================================================================

@CANNIBALISM_WENDIGO_DECISION_EVENT_HOURS = 1

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared resource helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_pay_wendigo_larder_and_command_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = cannibalism_wendigo_larder_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = -1 }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_larder = cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_larder
		min = constant:cannibalism_consumption.larder_min
		max = constant:cannibalism_unification.global_larder_maximum
	}
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_larder = cannibalism_larder }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = cannibalism_wendigo_command_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = -1 }
	add_command_power = cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative
}

cannibalism_pay_wendigo_counterwar_cost = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_manpower_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = -1 }
	add_manpower = cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_command_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = -1 }
	add_command_power = cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_infantry_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = -1 }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_support_cost }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = -1 }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = support_equipment_1 amount = cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wendigo command actions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_designate_selected_wendigo_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_designate_anchor_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state
			cannibalism_wendigo_can_pay_designate_anchor_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { cannibalism_state_can_become_wendigo_anchor = yes }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { cannibalism_register_current_wendigo_anchor = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_registration_result > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_larder_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.designate_anchor_larder }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_command_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.designate_anchor_command }
			cannibalism_pay_wendigo_larder_and_command_cost = yes
			cannibalism_rebuild_wendigo_anchor_runtime = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_designate_anchor_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_fortify_selected_wendigo_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_fortify_anchor_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state
			cannibalism_wendigo_can_pay_fortify_anchor_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { cannibalism_state_can_fortify_wendigo_anchor = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_larder_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.fortify_anchor_larder }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_command_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.fortify_anchor_command }
		cannibalism_pay_wendigo_larder_and_command_cost = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = {
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.fortify_anchor_strength }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength
				min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.minimum_live_strength
				max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.maximum_strength
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_fortify_anchor_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_feed_selected_wendigo_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_feed_anchor_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state
			cannibalism_wendigo_command_is_open = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { cannibalism_state_can_feed_wendigo_anchor = yes }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.feed_anchor_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.feeding }
		cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_population_loss_applied
					value = cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = {
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.feed_anchor_strength }
				clamp_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength
					min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.minimum_live_strength
					max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.maximum_strength
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.feed_anchor_progress }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress
				min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_min
				max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_max
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_feed_anchor_result = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = 0 }
	}
}

cannibalism_spawn_empty_wendigo_pack_batch = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_start_experience = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_start_experience }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_start_equipment = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_start_equipment }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_start_manpower = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_start_manpower }
	meta_effect = {
		text = {
			create_unit = {
				division = "name = \"Wendigo Pack\" division_template = \"Wendigo Pack\" start_experience_factor = [START_EXPERIENCE] start_equipment_factor = [START_EQUIPMENT] start_manpower_factor = [START_MANPOWER]"
				owner = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_actor
				count = [PACK_COUNT]
				allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
			}
		}
		START_EXPERIENCE = "[?cannibalism_wendigo_pack_start_experience]"
		START_EQUIPMENT = "[?cannibalism_wendigo_pack_start_equipment]"
		START_MANPOWER = "[?cannibalism_wendigo_pack_start_manpower]"
		PACK_COUNT = "[?cannibalism_wendigo_pack_batch|.0]"
	}
}

cannibalism_train_wendigo_pack_from_selected_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_training_result = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_requested_pack_batch = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_batch }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state
			cannibalism_wendigo_can_pay_train_pack_cost = yes
			cannibalism_wendigo_requested_pack_batch_fits_capacity = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { cannibalism_state_can_train_wendigo_pack = yes }
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_actor
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.recruitment }
		cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_population_loss_applied
					value = cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_larder_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_larder }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_command_cost = 0 }
			cannibalism_pay_wendigo_larder_and_command_cost = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_manpower = cannibalism_population_loss_applied }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_manpower = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_manpower_factor }
			round_temp_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_manpower
			add_manpower = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_manpower
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_batch = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_batch }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { cannibalism_spawn_empty_wendigo_pack_batch = yes }
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_trained_pack_count = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_batch }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_training_result = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = 0 }
	}
}

cannibalism_accelerate_wendigo_countdown_from_selected_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_acceleration_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state
			cannibalism_wendigo_can_pay_acceleration_cost = yes
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { cannibalism_state_can_accelerate_wendigo_countdown = yes }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_decision_state = { save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.accelerate_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.silent_larder }
		cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_population_loss_applied
					value = cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_larder_cost = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.accelerate_larder }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_command_cost = 0 }
			cannibalism_pay_wendigo_larder_and_command_cost = yes
			add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.accelerate_progress }
			clamp_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress
				min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_min
				max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_max
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_decision_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.accelerate_cooldown_days }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_wendigo_acceleration_cooldown days = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_cooldown_days }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_acceleration_result = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = 0 }
	}
}

cannibalism_stabilize_wendigo_countdown_at_selected_anchor = {

		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.stabilize_progress }

			clamp_variable = {

				min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.minimum_live_strength
				max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.maximum_strength
			}

cannibalism_calculate_current_counterwar_anchor_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.selection_base_score }
	if = {
		limit = { CONTROLLER = { has_war_with = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_actor } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.selection_at_war_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_neighbor_state = { CONTROLLER = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_actor } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.selection_adjacent_score }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_identified }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.selection_identified_score }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_strength_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.selection_maximum_strength }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_strength_component = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_score = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_strength_component }
}

cannibalism_select_counterwar_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_found = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_best_score = 0 }
	save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_actor
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_is_reachable_by_root = yes
				OR = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_require_unidentified < 1 }
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_identified }
				}
				OR = {
					check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_require_active_site < 1 }
					NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_recruitment_site_broken }
				}
			}
			cannibalism_calculate_current_counterwar_anchor_score = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_score
						value = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_best_score
						compare = greater_than
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_best_score = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_score }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_found = 1 }
				save_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_identify_counterwar_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_identification_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_can_identify_any_wendigo_anchor = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_require_unidentified = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_require_active_site = 0 }
		cannibalism_select_counterwar_anchor = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_found > 0 }
				has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor
				cannibalism_can_identify_any_wendigo_anchor = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.identify_political_power }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative = -1 }
			add_political_power = cannibalism_wendigo_cost_negative
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor = { set_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_identified }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_decision_cooldown_days = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.identify_cooldown_days }
			set_country_flag = { flag = cannibalism_wendigo_identification_cooldown days = cannibalism_wendigo_decision_cooldown_days }
			cannibalism_record_current_country_as_defeat_contributor = yes
			cannibalism_record_stop_transformation_operation = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_identification_result = 1 }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_apply_counterwar_anchor_damage = {
	event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor = {
		subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength = cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_damage }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength
					value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.minimum_live_strength
					compare = less_than
				}
			}
			cannibalism_break_loaded_wendigo_anchor = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_destroyed = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			clamp_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength
				min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.minimum_live_strength
				max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.maximum_strength
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_anchor_destroyed > 0 }
			is_ai = no
		}
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_wendigo_counterwar_contributor
		set_country_flag = achievement_cannibalism_decisive_aid
	}
}

cannibalism_break_wendigo_transformation_route = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_active
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_locked }
			check_variable = { global.cannibalism_wendigo_active_anchor_count < 1 }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_broken
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_defeated
		set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_all_wendigo_anchors_broken_prelock
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_active
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_route_complete
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_open
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_active
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_terminal_hunt_active }
			cannibalism_resolve_wendigo_terminal_hunt_failure = yes
		}
		cannibalism_clear_wendigo_prelock_operation_runtime = yes
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_stage = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_stage.winter_network }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_min }
		country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.76 hours = @CANNIBALISM_WENDIGO_DECISION_EVENT_HOURS }
	}
}

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 WENDIGO CONVERGENCE EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Selects the exact live Event 2 Wendigo country deterministically, preserves
# that original-ZZZ country in place, transfers one eligible human donor before
# annexation, aggregates Event 014 state without resetting zombie systems, and
# creates the initial public anchors. Later countdown and terminal effects use
# the same persistent cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host target.
# ============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deterministic live-Wendigo selection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_calculate_current_wendigo_merge_host_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.base_host_score }
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.human_host_score }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component = num_divisions }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.division_score }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_score = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component = num_of_controlled_states }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.controlled_state_score }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_score = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_controlled_population_k = 0 }
	every_controlled_state = {
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_controlled_population_k = state_population_k }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_controlled_population_k }
	divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.population_k_per_million }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.controlled_population_score_per_million }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_score = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_score_component }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_score
		min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.base_host_score
		max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.maximum_host_score
	}
}

cannibalism_consider_current_wendigo_merge_host_candidate = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_id = THIS.id }
	cannibalism_calculate_current_wendigo_merge_host_score = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_score
					value = cannibalism_best_wendigo_merge_host_score
					compare = greater_than
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_score
						value = cannibalism_best_wendigo_merge_host_score
						compare = equals
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_id
						value = cannibalism_best_wendigo_merge_host_id
						compare = less_than
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_wendigo_merge_host_score = cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_score }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_wendigo_merge_host_id = cannibalism_current_wendigo_merge_host_id }
		save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host
	}
}

cannibalism_select_wendigo_merge_host = {
	clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_wendigo_merge_host_score = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_wendigo_merge_host_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_human_wendigo_merge_host_found = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_is_valid_wendigo_merge_host = yes
			is_ai = no
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_human_wendigo_merge_host_found = 1 }
		cannibalism_consider_current_wendigo_merge_host_candidate = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_human_wendigo_merge_host_found < 1 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				cannibalism_is_valid_wendigo_merge_host = yes
				is_ai = yes
			}
			cannibalism_consider_current_wendigo_merge_host_candidate = yes
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host_score = cannibalism_best_wendigo_merge_host_score }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Initial transformation anchors
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_calculate_current_wendigo_anchor_score = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.base_score }
	if = {
		limit = { is_capital = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.capital_score }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_score_component = state_population_k }
	divide_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_score_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.population_score_divisor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_score = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_score_component }
	if = { limit = { is_coastal = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.coastal_score } }
	if = { limit = { naval_base > 0 } add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.naval_base_score } }
	if = { limit = { supply_node > 0 } add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.supply_node_score } }
	if = { limit = { rail_way > 0 } add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_score = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.rail_score } }
}

cannibalism_register_current_wendigo_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_registration_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				var = global.cannibalism_wendigo_active_anchor_count
				value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.maximum
				compare = less_than
			}
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_anchor }
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_population_committed }
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states value = THIS } }
			OWNER = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host }
			CONTROLLER = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host }
			NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_unusable_larder = yes }
			NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_consumption_cooldown }
			check_variable = {
				var = state_population_k
				value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.minimum_creation_population_k
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		save_event_target_as = cannibalism_consumption_target_state
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.feeding_population_k }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = constant:cannibalism_consumption.population_people_per_k }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_context = constant:cannibalism_consumption_mode.silent_larder }
			cannibalism_prepare_consumption_context = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_result = constant:cannibalism_consumption_result.applied }
				check_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_population_loss_applied
					value = cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people
					compare = equals
				}
			}
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_anchor
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_population_committed
			clr_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_broken
			set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.initial_strength }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_source_country = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host }
			set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_source_generation = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host.cannibalism_actor_generation }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_anchor }
			add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states value = THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_registration_result = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_consumption_exact_request_people = 0 }
	}
}

cannibalism_select_next_initial_wendigo_anchor = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_candidate_found = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_wendigo_anchor_score = 0 }
	event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
		every_controlled_state = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_anchor }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_population_committed }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active }
				NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states value = THIS } }
				NOT = { cannibalism_state_is_unusable_larder = yes }
				NOT = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_consumption_cooldown }
				check_variable = {
					var = state_population_k
					value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.minimum_creation_population_k
					compare = greater_than_or_equals
				}
			}
			cannibalism_calculate_current_wendigo_anchor_score = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = {
						var = cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_score
						value = cannibalism_best_wendigo_anchor_score
						compare = greater_than
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_best_wendigo_anchor_score = cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_score }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_candidate_found = 1 }
				save_event_target_as = cannibalism_selected_wendigo_anchor_state
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_candidate_found > 0 } }
		event_target:cannibalism_selected_wendigo_anchor_state = {
			cannibalism_register_current_wendigo_anchor = yes
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_create_initial_wendigo_anchors = {
	resize_array = { global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_candidate_found = 1 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_candidate_found > 0 }
			check_variable = {
				var = global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states^num
				value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.initial_target
				compare = less_than
			}
		}
		cannibalism_select_next_initial_wendigo_anchor = yes
	}
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_wendigo_active_anchor_count = global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states^num }
	if = {
		limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host }
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = { cannibalism_rebuild_wendigo_anchor_runtime = yes }
	}
}
