# The transformed country keeps its original paid Wendigo Pack training and
# gains the inherited ordinary cannibal contracts. These flags expose only
# exact-population, Larder-gated scripted recruitment; every template remains
# locked against normal queue recruitment.
cannibalism_open_wendigo_inherited_cannibal_recruitment = {
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_cannibal_recruitment_open
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_warband_integration_open
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_template_mapping_open
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_specialist_recruitment_open
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_preserved
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_cannibal_legion_recruitment_open
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_legion_cap_active
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_legion_deaths_accounting_required
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_bone_guard_recruitment_open
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_bone_guard_cap_active
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_legions_raised } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_legions_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_bone_guards_raised } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_bone_guards_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_raised } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_origin_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_island_specialists_raised } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_island_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_siege_specialists_raised } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_siege_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_march_specialists_raised } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_march_specialists_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_cannibal_formations_raised } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_cannibal_formations_raised = constant:cannibalism_unified_profile.zero }
	}
	cannibalism_unified_refresh_contract_capacities = yes
	cannibalism_unified_refresh_operational_profiles = yes
}

cannibalism_prepare_wendigo_merge_identity = {
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_prelock
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_unified_decisions_open
	set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_focus_overlay_available
	set_variable = { cannibalism_country_stage = constant:cannibalism_country_stage.wendigo_merged }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_stage = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_stage.prelock }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.starting_progress }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_winter_victories = 0 }
	clear_array = global.cannibalism_wendigo_victory_countries
	set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_broken_anchor_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_trained_pack_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_focus_pack_capacity_bonus = constant:cannibalism_meter.min }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_capacity = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_base_cap }
	set_cosmetic_tag = ZZZ_CANNIBALISM_HANNIBAL
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries value = THIS } } }
		cannibalism_register_current_country_actor = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_actor_generation } }
		cannibalism_register_current_country_actor = yes
	}
	cannibalism_apply_inherited_host_identity_to_cbl = yes
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.authority_transition_gain }
	clamp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_unified_authority
		min = constant:cannibalism_meter.min
		max = constant:cannibalism_meter.max
	}
	cannibalism_create_current_warlord_templates = yes
	cannibalism_wendigo_focus_preserve_pack_contract = yes
	cannibalism_open_inherited_warlord_recruitment = yes
	cannibalism_open_wendigo_inherited_cannibal_recruitment = yes
	if = { limit = { has_idea = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_feeding_network } remove_ideas = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_feeding_network }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = cannibalism_wendigo_locked_terminal_form } remove_ideas = cannibalism_wendigo_locked_terminal_form }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = cannibalism_wendigo_conjoined_hunger } } add_ideas = cannibalism_wendigo_conjoined_hunger }
	if = { limit = { has_character = ZZZ_leader } retire_character = ZZZ_leader }
	add_country_leader_role = {
		character = ZZZ_hannibal_wendigo
		promote_leader = yes
		country_leader = {
			ideology = ritual_predation
			traits = { cannibalism_hannibal_wendigo_command }
		}
	}
	add_named_threat = { threat = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_merge.reveal_world_tension name = cannibalism_wendigo_reveal_world_tension }
	save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host
	save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_unification_host
	save_global_event_target_as = cannibalism_latest_actor
	cannibalism_select_current_country_as_pulse_anchor = yes
}

cannibalism_record_wendigo_winter_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_network_active
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_broken }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_locked }
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_defeated_country
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_defeated_country = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = {
					is_in_array = {
						array = global.cannibalism_wendigo_victory_countries
						value = THIS
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_array = {
			array = global.cannibalism_wendigo_victory_countries
			value = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_defeated_country
		}
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_winter_victories = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.winter_victory_increment }
	}
}

cannibalism_absorb_primary_warlord_donor_into_wendigo = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_event_target = cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor
			has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host
			check_variable = { cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor_can_be_absorbed > 0 }
			event_target:cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor = { is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = { is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_runtime_migration_source_country
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_absorbed_warlord
			save_event_target_as = technology_union_donor
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_runtime_migration_destination_country
			cannibalism_migrate_runtime_references_to_unified_country = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_runtime_migration_result > 0 } }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
				union_compatible_researched_technologies_from_donor = yes
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_name_index = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_name_index }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_origin = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_origin }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_region = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_region }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_slot_index = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_slot_index }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_personality = cannibalism_inherited_warlord_personality }
				set_variable = { cannibalism_integration_disposition = constant:cannibalism_warlord_disposition.host_commander }
				cannibalism_apply_absorbed_warlord_inheritance_to_unified_host = yes
				cannibalism_record_integrated_warlord_slot = yes
				cannibalism_create_integrated_warlord_commander = yes
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor = {
				every_enemy_country = {
					limit = { NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host } }
					event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
						add_to_war = {
							targeted_alliance = event_target:cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor
							enemy = PREV
							hostility_reason = ally
						}
					}
				}
				cannibalism_prepare_current_warlord_slot_for_unification = yes
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
				annex_country = {
					target = event_target:cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor
					transfer_troops = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_integrated_warlord_count = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_build_wendigo_warlord_response_roster = {
	resize_array = { global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cannibalism_actor_countries
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				is_cannibalism_warlord_country = yes
				NOT = { has_capitulated = yes }
				NOT = { tag = event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host }
			}
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_pending_absorption
			set_country_flag = cannibalism_convergence_participant
			add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_convergence_actor_countries value = THIS }
			country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.71 hours = @CANNIBALISM_WENDIGO_RESPONSE_EVENT_HOURS }
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_create_wendigo_unification_from_selected_hosts = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_unification_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_selected_wendigo_merge_host_is_valid = yes
			cannibalism_selected_unification_host_is_valid = yes
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_unification_host = {
			save_event_target_as = cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor
			cannibalism_capture_current_warlord_inheritance = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor_was_human = 0 }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor_was_human = 1 } }
		}
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host_was_human = 0 }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host_was_human = 1 } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor_can_be_absorbed = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor_was_human > 0 }
				check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host_was_human > 0 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor_can_be_absorbed = 0 }
			# The nonabsorbed human retains all local Larder until the explicit
			# response choice; only route identity is inherited at reveal.
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_inherited_larder = 0 }
		}

		# The reveal flag precedes every transformed country, leader, portrait,
		# focus, decision, cosmetic, report, news, or audio-facing operation.
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_active
		set_global_flag = achievement_cannibalism_wendigo_merge_occurred
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_scenario_convergence_contract
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_route_active
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_active
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_convergence_broken
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_unification_pending
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_stage = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.wendigo_merged }
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_convergence_due_date
		clear_variable = global.cannibalism_convergence_rebuild_date

		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
			cannibalism_prepare_wendigo_merge_identity = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor_was_human > 0 }
				check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host_was_human < 1 }
			}
			event_target:cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor = { cannibalism_achievement_capture_current_player_ledger = yes }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
				cannibalism_achievement_apply_captured_player_ledger = yes
				change_tag_from = event_target:cannibalism_primary_warlord_donor
			}
		}

		cannibalism_absorb_primary_warlord_donor_into_wendigo = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
			set_variable = { global.cannibalism_unification_host_generation = cannibalism_actor_generation }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_evolution_stage_to_record = constant:cannibalism_event.evolution_iii_stage }
			cannibalism_record_current_evolution = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_change = constant:cannibalism_delta.reveal_chaos }
			set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_chaos_reason = constant:chaos_meter_history_reason.special.cannibalism_reveal }
			cannibalism_apply_chaos_change = yes
			cannibalism_emit_reveal_super_event = yes
		}
		cannibalism_create_initial_wendigo_anchors = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = { cannibalism_load_wendigo_focus_overlay = yes }
		cannibalism_build_wendigo_warlord_response_roster = yes
		event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
			country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.72 hours = @CANNIBALISM_WENDIGO_REVEAL_EVENT_HOURS }
			news_event = { id = chaosx.news.91 hours = @CANNIBALISM_WENDIGO_REVEAL_NEWS_HOURS }
		}
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_pending
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_unification_result = 1 }
	}
}

cannibalism_try_execute_wendigo_unification = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_unification_result = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_evolution_iii_transition_due
			NOT = { has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
			cannibalism_valid_wendigo_merge_host_exists = yes
		}
		# This is the first route mutation. It blocks the legacy Event 2
		# terminal while the exact survivor is selected and transformed.
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_pending
		cannibalism_select_wendigo_merge_host = yes
		cannibalism_select_unification_host = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				cannibalism_selected_wendigo_merge_host_is_valid = yes
				cannibalism_selected_unification_host_is_valid = yes
			}
			cannibalism_create_wendigo_unification_from_selected_hosts = yes
		}
		else = {
			clr_global_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_pending
			clear_global_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host
		}
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Anchor loss, winter-network stage, countdown, and terminal lock
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cannibalism_break_loaded_wendigo_anchor = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_anchor }
		clr_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_anchor
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_broken
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_anchor }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_broken_anchor_recovery_days = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.broken_anchor_recovery_days }
		add_dynamic_modifier = {
			modifier = cannibalism_wendigo_broken_anchor_recovery
			days = cannibalism_wendigo_broken_anchor_recovery_days
		}
		clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_strength
		clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_source_country
		clear_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_source_generation
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cannibalism_recovery_states value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { array = global.cannibalism_recovery_states value = THIS }
		}
		set_state_flag = cannibalism_recovery_active
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_new_state_stage = constant:cannibalism_state_stage.liberated_emergency }
		cannibalism_set_current_state_stage = yes
		set_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_recovery_next_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.liberated_emergency_days }
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host }
			event_target:cannibalism_wendigo_merge_host = {
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_broken_anchor_count = 1 }
				subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_anchor.loss_progress_penalty }
				clamp_variable = {
					var = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress
					min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_min
					max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_max
				}
			}
		}
		CONTROLLER = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = yes
					NOT = { is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes }
				}
				country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.73 hours = @CANNIBALISM_WENDIGO_STAGE_EVENT_HOURS }
			}
		}
	}
}

cannibalism_rebuild_wendigo_anchor_runtime = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_rebuild_index = global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_live_anchor_count = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_rebuild_index > 0 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_rebuild_index = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_loaded_anchor_is_live = 0 }
		var:global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states^cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_rebuild_index = {
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_current_wendigo_anchor_is_live = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_loaded_anchor_is_live = 1 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_live_anchor_count = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				cannibalism_break_loaded_wendigo_anchor = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_loaded_anchor_is_live < 1 } }
			remove_from_array = {
				array = global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states
				index = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_rebuild_index
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cannibalism_wendigo_active_anchor_count = cannibalism_wendigo_live_anchor_count }
	set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_capacity = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_base_cap }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_capacity_component = cannibalism_wendigo_live_anchor_count }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_capacity_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_cap_per_anchor }
	add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_capacity = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_capacity_component }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_focus_pack_capacity_bonus }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_capacity = cannibalism_wendigo_focus_pack_capacity_bonus }
	}
}

cannibalism_advance_wendigo_to_winter_network = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_prelock
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_network_active }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_network_active
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_stage = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_stage.winter_network }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = cannibalism_wendigo_conjoined_hunger } remove_ideas = cannibalism_wendigo_conjoined_hunger }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_feeding_network } } add_ideas = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_feeding_network }
		add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_hannibal_wendigo_winter_command
		country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.74 hours = @CANNIBALISM_WENDIGO_STAGE_EVENT_HOURS }
	}
}

cannibalism_try_start_wendigo_countdown = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			cannibalism_wendigo_can_start_countdown = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_active }
		}
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_active
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_active
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_stage = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_stage.locked }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_start_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_estimated_end_date = global.date }
		add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_estimated_end_date = constant:cannibalism_timing.wendigo_countdown_days }
		country_event = { id = chaosx.nr14.75 hours = @CANNIBALISM_WENDIGO_STAGE_EVENT_HOURS }
	}
}

cannibalism_calculate_wendigo_countdown_progress_change = {
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_progress_change = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.weekly_base }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component = global.cannibalism_wendigo_active_anchor_count }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_per_anchor }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_progress_change = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component }
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_victories }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_per_winter_victory }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component
		min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_min
		max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.maximum_victory_progress
	}
	add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_progress_change = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cannibalism_larder > constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.larder_high } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_progress_change = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.larder_bonus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cannibalism_consumed_population_k > constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.consumed_population_k } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_progress_change = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.consumption_bonus }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { capital_scope = { is_controlled_by = PREV } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_progress_change = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_per_controlled_capital }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component = cannibalism_wendigo_broken_anchor_count }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.broken_anchor_penalty }
	clamp_temp_variable = {
		var = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component
		min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_min
		max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.maximum_broken_penalty
	}
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_progress_change = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_component }
}

cannibalism_complete_wendigo_terminal_lock = {
	if = {
		limit = { cannibalism_wendigo_can_lock_terminal_form = yes }
		cannibalism_clear_wendigo_prelock_operation_runtime = yes
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_locked
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_prelock
		clr_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_active
		clr_global_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_active
		set_global_flag = world_end
		set_global_flag = world_end_cannibalism_wendigo
		set_global_flag = cannibalism_world_end_wendigo
		set_variable = { global.cannibalism_global_stage = constant:cannibalism_global_stage.wendigo_world_end }
		random_faction_cleanup_after_world_end = yes
		cannibalism_activate_terminal_global_war = yes
		if = { limit = { has_idea = cannibalism_wendigo_conjoined_hunger } remove_ideas = cannibalism_wendigo_conjoined_hunger }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_feeding_network } remove_ideas = cannibalism_wendigo_winter_feeding_network }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = weaponized_zombie_counterstrain_exposed } remove_ideas = weaponized_zombie_counterstrain_exposed }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = cannibalism_wendigo_locked_terminal_form } } add_ideas = cannibalism_wendigo_locked_terminal_form }
		add_country_leader_trait = cannibalism_hannibal_wendigo_terminal_command
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cannibalism_transformation_anchor_states
			set_state_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_anchor_terminal_locked
		}
		cannibalism_trigger_wendigo_world_end_super_event = yes
	}
}

cannibalism_process_wendigo_transformation_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_locked }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
		}
		cannibalism_rebuild_wendigo_anchor_runtime = yes
		cannibalism_process_wendigo_enemy_death_receipts = yes
		cannibalism_wendigo_refresh_inherited_commander_stage = yes
		cannibalism_break_wendigo_transformation_route = yes
		cannibalism_try_start_wendigo_countdown = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_active }
			if = {
				limit = { cannibalism_wendigo_can_start_countdown = yes }
				cannibalism_calculate_wendigo_countdown_progress_change = yes
				add_to_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = cannibalism_wendigo_countdown_progress_change }
			}
			else = {
				subtract_from_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.broken_anchor_penalty }
			}
			clamp_variable = {
				var = cannibalism_wendigo_transformation_progress
				min = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_min
				max = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_countdown.progress_max
			}
			cannibalism_complete_wendigo_terminal_lock = yes
		}
	}
}

# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - EVENT 014 WENDIGO FOCUS OVERLAY EFFECTS
# ============================================================================
# Executes the 28 post-reveal original-ZZZ Wendigo Hannibal focus rewards.
# These effects preserve the live zombie country's OOB, technology, units,
# leader identity, division-template lock, and 16-battalion Wendigo Pack. The
# winter capstone uses the existing staged-idea helper. No effect grants consumed
# population or Larder or sets world-end state. The pulse remains the sole lock.
# ============================================================================

cannibalism_load_wendigo_focus_overlay = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = ZZZ
			is_cannibalism_wendigo_hannibal_country = yes
			has_global_flag = cannibalism_reveal_complete
			has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_focus_overlay_available
			has_character = ZZZ_hannibal_wendigo
			NOT = { has_global_flag = world_end }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_focus_overlay_loaded }
		}
		load_focus_tree = { tree = cannibalism_wendigo_focus_tree keep_completed = no }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_focus_overlay_loaded
	}
}

cannibalism_wendigo_focus_prepare_runtime = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_unified_authority } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_unified_authority = constant:cannibalism_unification.starting_authority }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_frenzy } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_frenzy = constant:cannibalism_meter.min }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_capacity } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_pack_capacity = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_decision.train_pack_base_cap }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_focus_pack_capacity_bonus } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_focus_pack_capacity_bonus = constant:cannibalism_meter.min }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cannibalism_wendigo_trained_pack_count } }
		set_variable = { cannibalism_wendigo_trained_pack_count = constant:cannibalism_meter.min }
	}
}

		add_ai_strategy = { type = template_prio id = zombies value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.train_pack }
		add_ai_strategy = { type = role_ratio id = zombies value = constant:cannibalism_wendigo_ai.train_pack }
		set_country_flag = cannibalism_wendigo_pack_contract_ai_applied
	}
}
